title: Importspeditör till ett internationellt industriföretag
description:
Om företaget

Detta företag möter den ökade efterfrågan på energi i över 90 länder och bidrar till att skydda vårt klimat. Med över 94 000 anställda genererar de elektricitet för 16% av världens befolkning och strävar efter hållbar, pålitlig och ekonomiskt överkomlig energi genom innovativa teknologier. De utvecklar gasturbiner och kraftanläggningar för global användning och har en omfattande serviceorganisation. Med 3000 medarbetare i Finspång och en årlig omsättning på cirka 10 miljarder kronor är detta internationella industriföretag en betydande aktör inom energiteknik.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker nu en driven och engagerad Importspeditör med inriktning tull till vårt team! Här får du möjligheten att ta dig an en nyckelroll i en dynamisk och internationell miljö där varje dag bjuder på nya utmaningar och möjligheter.

Som Importspeditör blir du en viktig kugge i vårt globala maskineri. Du ansvarar för specifika importflöden, tullhantering och transportrelaterade frågor. Det här är en roll som kräver både struktur och flexibilitet, där du får agera spindeln i nätet mellan leverantörer, transportagenter, Tullverket och våra interna avdelningar som projektledning, inköp och internlogistik.

Hos oss arbetar du med några av de mest avancerade transportlösningarna i världen, inklusive specialtransporter, i en verksamhet som täcker över 70 länder. Vi erbjuder en arbetsmiljö där innovation, samarbete och hållbarhet står i fokus – och där du är med och gör skillnad varje dag.

Hur Du kommer att påverka • Transportupphandling och bokning • Leverantörskontakter och leveransbevakning • Utfärdande av tulldeklarationer för import • Kontroll och kontering av frakt- och speditionsfakturor • Hantering av transportreklamationer • Utveckling och digitalisering av transport- och tullprocesser

Din profil

• Du har en högskoleutbildning inom logistik eller flerårig erfarenhet av import/export och tullhantering. Har du dessutom arbetat med internationella transportavtal och tullprocesser är det ett stort plus! • Du kommunicerar obehindrat på engelska och svenska, och har goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office. Erfarenhet av SAP är meriterande. • Du är lösningsfokuserad, flexibel och har en naturlig förmåga att prioritera och strukturera ditt arbete – även under press. Du är en lagspelare som är tydlig i din kommunikation och har ett genuint intresse för hållbarhetsfrågor inom transport. • Du förstår vikten av goda kundrelationer och har en utmärkt förmåga att balansera kostnadsmedvetenhet med hög servicekvalitet.

Ansökningsförfarande

Tjänsten är initialt ett konsultuppdrag via oss på Skill. Det innebär att du är anställd hos oss på Skill och har ditt uppdrag hos detta internationella industriföretag i Finspång.

Urvalet kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum så vänta inte med att skicka in CV och personligt brev till oss idag. Vid eventuella frågor eller funderingar, kontakta ansvariga rekryterare Sara Solmansson, sara.solmansson@skill.se alt 011-199471.

title: Medewerker Projectbeheersing
description:
Een project draait niet alleen om techniek en uitvoering. Goede documentatie, betrouwbare rapportages, heldere afspraken en tijdige signalering zijn minstens zo belangrijk. Als Medewerker Projectbeheersing zorg jij ervoor dat onze projectinformatie volledig, actueel en goed georganiseerd is.

Dankzij jouw ervaring weet je wat er nodig is om overzicht te houden in een dynamische projectomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met projectmanagers, projectleiders en projectbeheersers. Je zorgt dat acties worden opgevolgd, documenten op de juiste plek staan en rapportages tijdig beschikbaar zijn. Zie je dat informatie ontbreekt of dat een afspraak dreigt te worden gemist? Dan wacht je niet af, maar onderneem je actie.

Je krijgt een zelfstandige ondersteunende rol waarin je jouw kennis en ervaring direct kunt inzetten. Tegelijkertijd bieden we je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen projectbeheersing, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van planning, financiën, risico’s, kwaliteit of rapportage.


Wat ga je doen?


In deze veelzijdige functie ondersteun je één of meerdere projecten. Vanuit jouw ervaring weet je prioriteiten te stellen en zorg je voor structuur en continuïteit.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • beheren, registreren en verspreiden van projectdocumentatie;
  • bewaken van de volledigheid, kwaliteit en status van documenten;
  • bijhouden van projectdossiers, actie- en besluitenlijsten;
  • voorbereiden van project- en managementrapportages;
  • organiseren van interne en externe projectoverleggen;
  • notuleren en bewaken van afspraken en acties;
  • ondersteunen bij facturatie en voortgangsregistratie;
  • samenstellen en bijhouden van veiligheidsplannen en projectmappen;
  • rapporteren over inkomende, uitgaande en nog te beoordelen documenten;
  • signaleren van ontbrekende informatie, afwijkingen en mogelijke verbeteringen.


We zoeken bij voorkeur iemand die al ervaring heeft binnen een projectomgeving. Bijvoorbeeld als projectmedewerker, projectassistent, projectondersteuner, document controller of medewerker projectadministratie. Hierdoor kun je snel zelfstandig aan de slag en weet je hoe belangrijk structuur, nauwkeurigheid en tijdige opvolging zijn.


Daarnaast heb je:


  • mbo+ werk- en denkniveau;
  • relevante ervaring met projectondersteuning, projectadministratie of documentbeheer;
  • bij voorkeur ervaring binnen een technische, industriële of infrastructurele projectomgeving;
  • een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;
  • goede kennis van Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook en Teams;
  • bij voorkeur ervaring met SharePoint of een documentmanagementsysteem;
  • een nauwkeurige en gestructureerde werkwijze;
  • een positieve en proactieve instelling;
  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, stelt de juiste vragen en behoudt het overzicht, ook wanneer de druk toeneemt.

Omexom is het merk van VINCI Energies voor energie-infrastructuur. Vanuit Assen werken we dagelijks aan betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige energieoplossingen. Dat doen we met collega's die trots zijn op hun vak, elkaar helpen en samen streven naar het beste resultaat.

Bij Omexom geloven we dat techniek draait om mensen. Daarom investeren we niet alleen in innovatieve oplossingen, maar ook in de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers. Samen maken we de energietransitie waar. Powered By Your Energy

  • Een afwisselende functie met verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid
  • Goede opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen projectbeheersing
  • Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring
  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen
  • Een pensioenregeling volgens de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf
  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak
  • Toegang tot meer dan 100 online cursussen via GoodHabitz
  • Personeelsvoordelen, zoals korting op weekendjes weg
  • Deelname aan het CASTOR-aandelenprogramma van VINCI Energies

title: 920-Projects/Engineering 1146-920 Assistant Project Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Under direction, assists the project manager with plans, schedules, budgets, and managing construction projects and maintenance programs; coordinates and conducts research and operations analyses; inspects community facilities/projects; and performs related work as required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Assists the project manager with objectives, new or revised policies, operating problems and matters affecting the flow of work. Plans and implements new projects or maintenance programs in accordance with established objectives.

Performs research and analyses for projects. Evaluates specific issues and summarizes findings and conclusions. Develops specific recommendations; reviews data and conclusions with others; and prepares and presents reports to committees, boards or others as directed.

Assists with consultant selection by developing lists of potential Consultant firms, developing criteria and judging formats, preparing and transmitting the request for proposals, assisting in the review of written proposals, assisting in conducting interviews, evaluating candidates, and making recommendations.

Assists with the review of construction document submissions and provide written comments on the coordination by the consultant of the various disciplines, including architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical and plumbing. Develop a project schedule to include pre-construction and construction activities.

Under direction, prepares scopes of work and assists in specification preparation for request for proposals. Performs cost estimating in an effort to develop project budgetary costs; prepares reports and makes presentations on a variety of maintenance/construction related issues. Tracks project schedules and implementation processes, and assists on an as-needed basis with construction inspections.

Works closely with outside consultants and contractors who provide designs, studies, analyses and technical services for projects. Monitors contract compliance; oversees the schedule and budget for various contracted services provided to the Community relative to large programs and capital projects. Plans, organizes and supervises the upgrade, maintenance, and repair of all mutual owned facilities. Implements capital improvement projects as approved by the Board of Directors.

Maintains a variety of records including those relating to contracts, budgets, project progress, requests for information, submittals, plans, specifications, engineering records and other technical materials.

Gathers and analyzes a wide variety of organizational, financial, statistical, technical and procedural data from numerous sources. Documents data through the preparation of comprehensive work papers and performs field inspections for quality control of division activities or special projects.

Drives a vehicle to meetings, workshops, and other job related responsibilities.

Regular Attendance Required. All duties performed on site for the Community.

Works effectively with co-workers, customers and others by sharing ideas in a constructive
and positive manner; listens to and objectively considers ideas and suggestions from others; keeps commitments; keeps others informed of work progress, timetables and issues; addresses problems and issues constructively to find mutually acceptable and practical business solutions; addresses others by name, title or other respectful identifier; and respects the diversity of our workforce in actions, words and deeds.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Assist others in office with priority projects that impact the division, on an as-needed basis.

EQUIPMENT OPERATED:

Car, PC, printer, copier, fax machine, calculator, telephone and camera.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is in a climate-controlled indoor office and normal outdoor elements.

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS:

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major course works in engineering, program management or equivalent combination of education and experience which produces the following:

Knowledge of the occupational hazards and safety precautions of the job.

Knowledge of computer and applicable software programs.

Knowledge of research methods and techniques.

Knowledge of methods of report and design document presentation.
Ability to coordinate the work of contractors in a manner conducive to full performance.
Ability to analyze and interpret research findings.

Ability to write and orally present clear and concise reports, scopes of work and specifications.

Ability to maintain effective working relationships with other employees, the public, contractors and consultants, and to deal with public relations problems courteously and tactfully.

Ability to effectively interpret design and construction documents and perform quality control checks of same.
Ability to multitask, remain flexible, prioritize and delegate appropriately.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

Possession of a valid California driver’s license.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk, hear, use hands and fingers to grasp, feel and reach. Is regularly required to sit for long periods of time.
Occasionally carries, kneels, pulls, pushes, stoops, and lifts up to 30 lbs.

MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

Reading comprehension, detailed work, confidentiality, problem solving, multi-tasking, analysis, read blueprints, training, reasoning, and verbal/written communication skills.

performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of

title: Data Center Market Leader / Senior Project Manager
description:
Join a Leading National Engineering Firm with a Legacy of Innovation

Founded in 1966, LJB Inc. is a national engineering firm specializing in civil and structural engineering, with additional expertise in geospatial, safety, and environmental services. Our broad technical capabilities and diverse client base have allowed us to deliver successful projects in all 50 states and several countries.

Within our Buildings Practice, LJB’s structural engineers are widely recognized for their cost-efficient, high-performance designs, particularly in tilt-up construction and steel detailing. Our team is the trusted structural partner for architects, general contractors, and building owners across North America.

We are currently seeking a Data Center Marker Leader in our Charlotte, North Carolina office. The Data Center Market Leader and Senior Project Manager develops and executes the firm’s strategy for growing its data center portfolio while leading teams that deliver profitable, high- quality projects. This role combines market development, strategic client leadership, project oversight, and mentorship of teammates serving data center and mission-critical clients.

Annual Compensation: $110,000 - $150,000 based upon experience, certifications, and regional market standards.

Benefit Information: Here

DATA CENTER MARKET LEADER / SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Develop and execute a strategic plan to expand the firm’s presence in the data center market
  • Partner with business development executives to identify opportunities, cultivate prospective clients, and secure new work that generates revenue growth.
  • Represent the firm at industry conferences, networking events, client meetings, and business development functions.
  • Monitor market trends, industry investment, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support strategic growth.
  • Assume client manager responsibility for strategic clients

  • Work closely with owners, developers, architects, general contractors, construction managers, and specialty contractors to resolve design and construction challenges.

  • Provide technical oversight for structural systems supporting data centers and other mission-critical facilities.
  • Travel within the United States as needed for client meetings, project delivery, industry events, and visits to project sites and client locations.

DATA CENTER MARKET LEADER / SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER ESSENTIAL CREDENTIALS:

Preferred Qualifications:

Build lasting client relationships, mentor engineering teammates, and put your technical expertise and business insight to work expanding our data center portfolio.

title: System Administrator
description:
Position Summary:

Windward Risk Managers is seeking a highly skilled System Administrator to serve as the primary administrator for backup, recovery, and cloud infrastructure across the company’s on-prem and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Veeam, vCenter, and Microsoft Azure, with a focus on continuously improving, optimizing, and validating data protection and high-availability architecture. This role leads disaster-recovery planning and testing in partnership with the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams to keep business-critical systems protected and recoverable.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Continuously improve and evolve the company’s disaster-recovery environment across our data centers and Azure; lead DR planning, runbooks, and failover testing, engaging the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams; configure fault-tolerant features and maintain Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective documentation.
  • Design, implement, and optimize the Veeam Backup & Replication environment, including job architecture, repositories, replication, retention and immutability policies, and storage usage.
  • Administer the VMware vSphere / vCenter environment as it relates to data protection, including replication and recovery validation, along with the supporting SAN / NAS storage (NetApp, Tintri), deduplication appliances (ExaGrid), and immutable backup repositories.
  • Validate backup integrity through regular restore testing and automated verification; confirm all critical systems are covered, configurations follow best practices, and gaps are remediated.
  • Contribute to the company’s business continuity program, supporting business impact analysis, recovery strategies for critical business functions, and the ongoing maintenance and testing of business continuity plans as infrastructure and systems change.
  • Manage and expand the company’s Microsoft Azure footprint, building out cloud infrastructure to support business continuity, backup, and DR targets while maintaining storage, access control, and cost governance as adoption grows.
  • Monitor backup health, capacity, and SLA compliance; perform root cause analysis on failures and implement preventive measures.
  • Support compliance and audit requirements related to data protection, backup retention, and recoverability, including evidence gathering and remediation of audit findings.
  • Automate verification and reporting with PowerShell; maintain runbooks and documentation; serve as the escalation point for backup and recovery issues.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for data protection, storage management, and recovery operations.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companie
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

title: Kasselinjen, 8-15 timer pr. uge, Taastrup
description:
Derfor er vi helt vilde med dig

Elsker du at yde god service på en autentisk, ærlig og direkte måde? -Så er det dig vi leder efter!

Vi lægger vægt på følgende kvaliteter:
• Du er imødekommende og har en venlig tilgang, der inspirerer både kunder og kollegaer, selv når der er travlt
• Du trives med rutiner, er omhyggelig og lægger mærke til detaljer
• Du er god til teamwork og nyder at assistere og samarbejde med kollegaer, både i Kassen og i de andre afdelinger i Customer Experience
• Du forstår både dansk og engelsk.

En dag I dit liv hos os

I Kassen er vores fornemmeste opgave at give kunderne den bedste afslutning på deres varekøb i IKEA. I Kasselinjen, bliver du en del af vores kundeserviceteam i Customer Experience, der også består af Retur, Informationen, Småland og Vareudleveringen. I Customer Experience løfter vi gerne i flok og hjælper hinanden i afdelingerne, når der er behov.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. bestå af at:
• Møde og indgå i korte dialoger med mange nye mennesker hver dag, hvor du gerne skal have overskuddet til at relatere til kunderne og give lidt af dig selv
• Sørge for at alt bliver scannet korrekt, og på den måde sikre at kassesaldo og lagerbeholdning stemmer overens
• Besvare spørgsmål fra kunderne, der omhandler hele IKEA, og derfor have et tæt samarbejde med de andre afdelinger i varehuset.

Vores team i IKEA

Kasselinjen er en stor afdeling med et rigtig godt kollegialt sammenhold, hvor vi bakker hinanden op og løfter i flok. Hos os har du mulighed for at skabe et stærkt netværk. Vi har mennesket i fokus og bestræber os hver dag på at skabe en bedre hverdag for os selv og vores kunder, ved at være smilende og hjælpsomme. Vi kommer alle fra forskellige baggrunde. Der er derfor plads til at være lige præcis den, du er. Vi sørger for den rette oplæring, så du kan føle dig tryg og kompetent i jobbet.

Har du spørgsmål eller brug for hjælp? Lad os tale med hinanden!

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Jane Otto på jane.otto@ingka.ikea.com ved spørgsmål til stillingerne. Vi gør opmærksom på, at vi udelukkende modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem og IKKE via e-mail.

Yderligere informationer

• Stillingen er på 8-15 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit, efter reglerne for fleksibel deltid, beskrevet i HK Handels overenskomst. Dette betyder, at man er garanteret 8 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit og at arbejdstiden ikke kan overstige 15 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit, set over en periode på 16 uger. Vær opmærksom på om du opfylder betingelserne for at blive ansat på fleksibel deltid
• Din arbejdstid placeres primært i varehusets åbningstider, og du skal forvente at have 1-2 lukkevagter pr. uge i hverdage, samt arbejde hver 2. weekend, både lørdag og søndag
• Vi følger HK butiks overenskomst, men har samtidig en masse personalegoder som personalerabat, massage ordning, bonus ordning, kantineordning, helbredssikring via PFA og meget mere
• Der kan i ansættelsesprocessen blive stillet krav om fremvisning af straffeattest
• Ønsket opstart hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale
• Søg senest d. 24. november 2026
• OBS: Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og forbeholder os retten til at lukke jobopslaget, når vi har modtaget tilstrækkeligt med relevante kandidater.

Hos IKEA tror vi på mennesker – ikke perfekte CV’er. Det vigtigste er din energi og lyst til at gøre en forskel. Søg nu – uanset om du er ung, senior eller midt i mellem!

title: Director, Adult Day Services  - Bucyrus
description:
Job Title: Director, of Adult day Services - Stein

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

Job Status: Full-time, Exempt

Direct Reports: Nurses, CNA, PCW, Intake and Activities Coordinators

Pay class: Salary

St. Ann Center for Intergenerational Care We are a nonprofit organization that provides community-based health and educational services for children and frail adults and to serve as a resource and support for caregivers. The Center, sponsored by the Sisters of St. Francis of Assisi, reflects Franciscan values in meeting the spiritual, psychological, social, and physical needs of all who participate regardless of faith, culture, or ability to pay.

St. Ann Center specializes in adult and child daycare services in a safe, homelike setting where compassion, care, and dignity are key. We bring all ages together from 6 weeks old to 100+. In 2016, St. Ann Center was recognized for the Best Intergenerational Award.

"This is the closest place to heaven on earth. Everyone is loved for who they are."

-Mayor Tom Barrett

Benefits

  • Health, Dental and Vision insurance
  • 403(b) Retirement Plans
  • Paid time off
  • 9 Paid Holidays
  • Child & Adult Daycare Discounts
  • Teach Scholarship Reimbursement Program

Leadership & Program Oversight

  • Provide overall leadership and operational oversight for Adult Day Care, Respite, Bathing, Overnight Respite, and related Adult Services programs.
  • Ensure all programs operate in compliance with state, federal, and local regulations and St. Ann Center policies, while meeting the spiritual, emotional, recreational, and social needs of clients.
  • Oversee daily supervision and delegated responsibilities of the Lead Supervisor/Director.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Operating Officer to review and improve programs, policies, procedures, and job descriptions.
  • Complete and submit required operational reports and documentation to executive leadership.

Staffing, Scheduling & Workforce Management

  • Oversee staff scheduling, assignments, and coverage, including call-ins, schedule changes, and two-person assist services.
  • Approve timekeeping, time-off requests, and temporary staffing documentation; maintain accurate weekly payroll records.
  • Lead staffing processes, including interviews, onboarding, orientation, and required training completion.
  • Provide staff coaching, mentoring, corrective action, performance documentation, and hands-on unit support as needed.

Client Care Coordination & Case Management

  • Direct Adult Services program delivery and client coordination, including admissions, care planning, and discharges.
  • Lead weekly care plan and Individual Service Plan (ISP) reviews in collaboration with program staff.
  • Ensure timely implementation of nursing orders and coordinated case management with Social Workers.
  • Address and resolve client, caregiver, and staff concerns.
  • Develop and oversee Personal Hygiene services for Day Care and À La Carte clients.

Training, Licensure & Regulatory Compliance

  • Monitor and maintain licensure and certification requirements for nursing and CNA staff.
  • Coordinate required training, orientation, and ongoing in-service education, including continuing education tracking.
  • Ensure full regulatory compliance across Adult Services programs.
  • Document and report all incidents and accidents involving staff or clients in accordance with policy.

Policy, Quality Assurance & Program Support

  • Develop, update, and enforce policies and procedures; ensure consistent adherence through monitoring and review.
  • Manage staff complaints and grievances, preparing required reports for executive leadership.
  • Support student programs, internships, tours, and community engagement initiatives.

Financial & Operational Administration

  • Approve supply ordering and operational requisitions.
  • Assist executive leadership with budget development, monitoring expenditures, and recommending capital or non-budgeted purchases.
  • Coordinate and follow up on volunteer staffing need with the Volunteer Coordinator.

Communication & Interdepartmental Coordination

  • Maintain regular communication with administrative and program leadership to support coordinated operations.
  • Serve as a liaison among staff, administration, clients, families, volunteers, and external partners.
  • Ensure accurate and timely submission of all operational, staffing, and compliance documentation.

title: Staff CPU RTL Engineer, Silicon - Austin, Mountain View or Portland
location: Austin, TX, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Portland, OR, USA
description:

You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

  • Participate in developing CPU subsystem. Develop CPU subsystem front-end designs, emphasizing on microarchitecture and RTL design for the next generation CPU.

title: Quality Assurance & Compliance Manager
description:
Benefits:
  • 401(k) matching
  • Bonus based on performance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
Position Summary

The Quality Assurance & Compliance Manager (QA) is responsible for ensuring Helpful Hearts Health Services Inc’s compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations including those established by the Maryland Developmental Disabilities Administration (DDA), the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), COMAR 10.22, and other governing and accrediting bodies while driving continuous quality improvement across operations. This role provides strategic leadership over the agency's Quality Assurance program, overseeing internal audits, compliance monitoring, incident and risk management, and quality improvement initiatives to ensure regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and the safety, dignity, and satisfaction of individuals served.

Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Compliance & Monitoring
  • Maintain expert, up-to-date knowledge of DDA regulations (including the COMAR 10.22 series), applicable Medicaid waiver requirements, HIPAA, incident reporting standards, participant rights regulations, and other accreditation/organizational standards.
  • Stay current on Maryland DDA policies, guidance, and transmittals.
  • Design, implement, and monitor quality assurance systems and processes to ensure adherence to policies, procedures, and service delivery standards.
  • Conduct regular compliance reviews of programs such as Residential Services, Meaningful Day/Day Habilitation, Personal Supports, etc.
Internal Audits & Chart Reviews
  • Conduct comprehensive operational audits, including site reviews, record reviews, and quality improvement assessments.
  • Perform routine and random audits of participant records (PCPs, BSPs, nursing documentation), staff training and credential files, and Medication Administration Records (MARs).
  • Identify deficiencies, trends, and areas of risk; produce accurate, timely, and detailed documentation of all QA activities and audit findings.
  • Lead the development and execution of corrective action plans (CAPs) and Quality Improvement Plans (QIPs) in collaboration with leadership, and track completion.
Incident & Risk Management
  • Lead the Critical Incident Reporting review process to ensure accuracy, transparency, timeliness, and compliance with DDA requirements.
  • Ensure proper documentation and follow-up actions are completed.
  • Analyze incident data to identify patterns and implement preventative strategies.
  • Coordinate and oversee internal investigations, ensuring timely completion and compliance with regulatory standards.
Quality Improvement (QI) Initiatives
  • Drive continuous quality improvement (CQI) initiatives to enhance service quality, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collect, track, and analyze quality metrics and outcomes; develop data-driven reports summarizing quality trends, risks, and improvement opportunities for leadership.
  • Chair the Quality & Safety Committee, present findings at Quality Assurance Committee meetings, and contribute to cross-functional committees as needed.
  • Analyze satisfaction survey data, identify trends, and implement targeted improvement strategies.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to leadership to mitigate risk and improve overall program performance.
Policy & Procedure Development
  • Assist in developing, updating, and implementing policies and procedures to ensure compliance with DDA and CMS standards and reflect person-centered planning principles and best practices.
Staff Training, Supervision & Technical Assistance
  • Deliver training, coaching, and support to staff on documentation standards, compliance requirements, incident reporting, and person-centered practices to promote a culture of quality, compliance, and accountability.
  • Support onboarding and ongoing education initiatives.
  • Supervise and mentor QA staff, fostering professional development and performance excellence.
External Audit & Accreditation Readiness
  • Serve as the primary liaison during external audits, regulatory reviews, inspections, and surveys (including in the absence of the CEO).
  • Lead organizational readiness for accreditation and external reviews, ensuring sustained compliance.
  • Oversee and maintain all regulatory documentation, ensuring timely submission and compliance with reporting requirements.
Data Management & Reporting
  • Maintain QA dashboards and tracking systems.
  • Generate reports on compliance, trends, and performance indicators, and utilize data to inform leadership decisions.
Additional Duties
  • Perform additional duties as assigned, including travel across service locations.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
·
  • 95% compliance rate on internal audits
  • 100% timely completion of corrective action plans within designated timeframes
  • Reduction in repeat deficiencies by a target 20% quarterly
  • 100% incident report submission within DDA-required timelines
  • Staff training completion rate 98%
  • Audit readiness score (internal mock audits) 90%
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in human services, Healthcare Administration, Social Work, or a related field (master’s preferred, or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in quality assurance, compliance, auditing, or performance improvement within a DDA or similar human services/residential setting, including experience working with adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state (including Maryland DDA regulations, COMAR 10.22, and waiver services), and local regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience with audits, investigations, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to determine whether an incident is reportable under Maryland DDA requirements and accurately select the applicable reporting category.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-compliance, and confidential environments.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and analytical communication skills.
  • Valid driver's license with reliable transportation and current insurance.
  • Supervisory and case management experience preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) or similar certification.
  • Experience with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Familiarity with behavior support plans and nursing oversight requirements.
Core Competencies
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Regulatory knowledge and compliance expertise
  • Data analysis and critical thinking
  • Ethical decision-making and confidentiality
  • Communication and training skills
  • Problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset
  • Leadership and staff development
Working Conditions
  • Office and field-based role, with visits to residential, support services, and day program sites.
  • Requires travel within the state of Maryland.
  • Respond promptly to after-hours calls or texts regarding urgent incident reporting.
  • Occasional evening or weekend work during audits, incident investigations or time-sensitive incident reporting.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to travel between program sites.
  • Ability to sit, stand, and review documents for extended periods.
Benefits:
  • 401(k)
  • Paid time off
  • Opportunity for Advancement
Work Location: In person

title: Avonova Hälsa söker Hälsocenterchef till Göteborg
description:
Vi leder vägen till ett hållbart arbetsliv – varje dag

Avonova är Nordens ledande aktör inom företagshälsa och ledarutveckling. Med bred kunskap och stort engagemang hjälper Avonova organisationer och dess medarbetare att bli mer hållbara, kommunicera effektivare och må bättre. Hälsa och arbetsmiljö är avgörande faktorer för att skapa långsiktigt framgångsrika organisationer. Våra 1300 medarbetare på 170 orter levererar varje dag hälsotjänster över hela Norden. Våra kunder finns inom såväl offentlig som privat sektor.

Är du vår nya hälsocenterchef?

Avonova söker chef till vårt hälsocenter i område Göteborg på Mölndalsvägen.

På hälsocentret får du chansen att arbeta med ett engagerat och kompetent team av specialister. Du får möjligheten att arbeta kundorienterat och affärsmässigt i en miljö som präglas av driv, innovation och gemenskap.

Du har ett genuint intresse för människor, deras hälsa och arbetsmiljö och erfarenhet av arbete i ledande befattning med liknande verksamhet. Du har mycket goda ledaregenskaper och förmåga att skapa förutsättningar att öka motivationen hos medarbetarna. Vi sätter stort värde i professionalism, integritet och drivkraft.

Arbetet är mångsidigt och innefattar bland annat att coacha medarbetare, säkerställa att de har rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas i sina uppdrag, samt att bygga och utveckla relationer med enhetens kunder. Du kommer att ha en nyckelroll i att driva verksamhetens utveckling och skapa långsiktiga, hållbara affärsrelationer.

Tillsammans med ledningsgruppen och säljorganisationen arbetar du för att identifiera och utveckla nya och befintliga affärsmöjligheter. Du stöttar även medarbetarna på hälsocentret så att de får en aktiv roll i kundarbetet.

En av våra viktigaste målsättningar är att arbeta med helhetssyn och ett konsultativt förhållningssätt i alla våra uppdrag. En central del i rollen är också att koordinera leveranser inom Stockholm i samverkan med andra hälsocenter, för att säkerställa kvalitet och effektivitet i våra leveranser.

Du kommer att

  • Ha fullt ansvar för personal, budget och resultat
  • Hantera kvalitets-, miljö- och arbetsmiljöfrågor och skapa en effektiv verksamhetsplanering
  • Tillsammans med säljare, kollegor och områdeschef ha en aktiv roll i kundarbetet för att skapa och utveckla befintliga och nya affärsmöjligheter
  • Ingå i ledningsgruppen för område Göteborg och rapportera till områdeschef
  • Genom samarbete med närliggande hälsocenter optimera beläggningen, resultat och kundnöjdhet
  • Tillsammans i teamet stärka kundupplevelsen och vara en proaktiv partner för våra kunder
  • Vara en nyckelperson i arbetet att utveckla vårt arbetssätt i målet att vara Nordens bästa företagshälsa

Vi söker dig som har

  • Chefs- och ledarerfarenhet av att leda specialister
  • Erfarenhet av coachande ledarskap med goda resultat
  • Erfarenhet av att leda tvärprofessionellt team
  • Kunskap inom och erfarenhet av ekonomistyrning

title: Data Center Market Leader / Senior Project Manager
description:
Join a Leading National Engineering Firm with a Legacy of Innovation

Founded in 1966, LJB Inc. is a national engineering firm specializing in civil and structural engineering, with additional expertise in geospatial, safety, and environmental services. Our broad technical capabilities and diverse client base have allowed us to deliver successful projects in all 50 states and several countries.

Within our Buildings Practice, LJB’s structural engineers are widely recognized for their cost-efficient, high-performance designs, particularly in tilt-up construction and steel detailing. Our team is the trusted structural partner for architects, general contractors, and building owners across North America.

We are currently seeking a Data Center Marker Leader in our Houston, Texas office. The Data Center Market Leader and Senior Project Manager develops and executes the firm’s strategy for growing its data center portfolio while leading teams that deliver profitable, high- quality projects. This role combines market development, strategic client leadership, project oversight, and mentorship of teammates serving data center and mission-critical clients.

Annual Compensation: $110,000 - $150,000 based upon experience, certifications, and regional market standards.

Benefit Information: Here

DATA CENTER MARKET LEADER / SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Develop and execute a strategic plan to expand the firm’s presence in the data center market
  • Partner with business development executives to identify opportunities, cultivate prospective clients, and secure new work that generates revenue growth.
  • Represent the firm at industry conferences, networking events, client meetings, and business development functions.
  • Monitor market trends, industry investment, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support strategic growth.
  • Assume client manager responsibility for strategic clients
  • Lead proposal development, including scope of work, terms, schedule, fees, limitations, and other issues within corporate policy guidelines
  • Mentor project manager teammates executing work in market
  • Establish project scope, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and deliverables in coordination with clients and internal teams.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects, ensuring delivery within established budgets, schedules, and quality expectations.
  • Coordinate structural engineering activities with architectural, civil, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and other design disciplines.
  • Ensure that project teams follow the firm’s quality assurance procedures and satisfy applicable regulatory, code, permitting, and professional practice requirements.
  • Work closely with owners, developers, architects, general contractors, construction managers, and specialty contractors to resolve design and construction challenges.
  • Oversee project financial performance, including fee management, resource allocation, project profitability, and change management.
  • Provide technical oversight for structural systems supporting data centers and other mission-critical facilities.
  • Travel within the United States as needed for client meetings, project delivery, industry events, and visits to project sites and client locations.

DATA CENTER MARKET LEADER / SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER ESSENTIAL CREDENTIALS:

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 10 years of structural engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years of project management responsibility in a consulting or engineering environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field.
  • Professional Engineer (PE).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in engineering or related field.
  • Structural Engineer (SE).
  • Ability to secure work in industrial, health care, cold-storage, or manufacturing markets through existing relationships.

Core Skills:

  • Plan and prioritize work across multiple teams and concurrent projects, balancing client commitments, staffing needs, project risk, schedule, quality, and financial performance.
  • Make decisions that have an impact on a department’s credibility, operations, and/or services.
  • Desire to innovate and solve difficult problems from inception to final deliverable.
  • Ability to react quickly and calmly to high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to work independently and in team settings.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Why Join LJB?

At LJB, you’ll combine the reach of an established national engineering firm with the opportunity to shape our data center market strategy and lead complex, mission-critical projects. Build lasting client relationships, mentor engineering teammates, and put your technical expertise and business insight to work expanding our data center portfolio.

LJB Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and have the opportunity to succeed. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other protected status under applicable law. If you are a self-starting individual who wishes to join an established team that believes in excellence in the workplace, this opportunity is for you.

Recruiters or staffing agencies: LJB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resume submitted without a signed agreement will be considered the property of LJB, and no fees will be paid. Please direct all communications to the HR team.

title: Planning Director
description:
Stakeholder Management • Manage stakeholder expectations by providing accurate reporting on project status, risks, delays, and recovery actions. • Build trust and credibility with stakeholders through data-driven insights, and solution-focused recommendations. • Develop stakeholder engagement strategies for complex projects ensuring alignment throughout the project lifecycle. • Provide expert planning advice during negotiations, contractual discussions, and project performance reviews. • Collaborate with project directors, commercial, engineering and procurement to ensure effective project delivery. Project Scheduling & Monitoring • Oversee the preparation of project baseline programmes, ensuring alignment with contractual requirements. • Ensure effective utilization of planning tools, including Primavera P6 and other project management systems. • Monitor project progress, identify critical activities, and provide recommendations for corrective actions. • Review project forecasts and mitigation strategies to minimise delays and improve delivery outcomes. • Challenge project teams on programme performance and productivity levels to ensure delivery commitments are achieved. Risk, Delay & Change Management • Provide strategic oversight of programme risks, ensuring potential impacts on project completion dates, milestones, cost, and contractual obligations are proactively managed. • Provide strategic planning input for extension of time (EOT) submissions, delay analysis, and contractual matters. • Establish governance processes to ensure consistent assessment and management of project risks across the portfolio. • Review contractor and subcontractor performance to identify recurring delays and implement improvement actions. Tender & Pre-Construction Support • Provide strategic planning leadership during the tender and pre-construction phases to support successful project bids and effective project mobilization. • Review tender documentation, contract requirements, specifications, scope of works, and client requirements to develop realistic and achievable project programmes. • Support bid submissions through realistic programme development and resource planning. • Provide planning expertise during client and consultant discussions. • Collaborate with Estimation, Commercial, Engineering, Procurement, and Operations teams to ensure alignment between the tender programme, pricing strategy, and construction methodology. Performance Management & Reporting • Develop and implement robust project performance management frameworks to ensure consistent monitoring, measurement, and reporting of project delivery performance. • Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to schedule performance, productivity, progress achievement, resource utilization, and project efficiency. • Provide executive-level performance dashboards and reports to senior management, highlighting project status, key risks, trends, and strategic recommendations. • Analyze project performance data to identify deviations from approved programmes, assess root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. • Lead periodic project performance reviews with Project Directors, Project Managers, and key stakeholders to evaluate progress against contractual milestones and business objectives.

• Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related field (Master’s preferred). • Minimum of 15 years’ experience in planning and project controls within the construction/contracting industry, with at least 10 years in a senior leadership role. • Professional certification in project controls, planning, or project management (PMP, AACE, PSP, or equivalent) is preferred. • Proven track record in managing large-scale projects from pre-construction to handover. • Strong knowledge of planning software such as Primavera P6, MS Project, and Power BI. • Solid understanding of FIDIC contracts and delay analysis techniques. • Exceptional leadership, communication, and analytical skills. • Strategic Thinking; Risk Management; Decision Making; Contractual Awareness; Technical Planning Expertise & Leadership & Team Management are key competencies required. • Experience in earned value management (EVM), progress measurement, and productivity analysis. • Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret complex project data. • Proficiency in project reporting tools and digital project management platforms. • Development and capability enhancement of the planning team • Contribution to successful tender submissions and business growth

title: CRO Project Manager-Brazil
description:
CRO Project Manager
• Job title: CRO Project Manager (PM)
• Hours: Required availability 8AM–5PM ET


We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Project Manager to join our full-service CRO agency. As
a CRO PM, you'll keep our clients' testing programs running smoothly from start to finish — owning
timelines, dev tickets, implementations, and day-to-day client follow-through.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, loves keeping projects moving, and owns
details big and small. You'll partner with your CRO Lead, who owns strategy and client
presentations, and with our analytics team, designers, developers, and QA to make sure every test
and implementation ships on time and at high quality.

ResponsibilitiesProject & task management
• Keep client trackers, dashboards, and Wrike projects up to date, with every tracker current
before each client call.
• Check client dashboards and active tickets daily so every project has the correct status, is on
track for that month, and Back of House has a clear path.
• Make sure all action items are completed between calls and every deliverable is clearly
assigned and on schedule.
• Close out winning tests: personalization, tracker updates, and implementation
documentation.
• Monitor client implementations and prepare the implementation slide for each call.
• Incorporate automated workflows and processes to execute job duties quickly and
efficiently.
Dev, QA & test execution
• Submit dev tickets for approved tests and implementations, making sure each ticket reflects
the latest updates and Back of House has what they need.
• Do a final review of developer tickets before they move forward.
• Keep all dev tickets on schedule: attend dev standups, set up scoping calls ahead of time,
respond in tickets, and advocate for client work on dev calls.
• Review tests when ready, before they go to the client (with your Lead, depending on the
client), including live QA across devices.
• Share preview links, manage client approvals, and adjust tests based on client feedback.
• When a live test or personalization breaks, make sure the issue is resolved and fixed quickly.
• Make minor HTML/CSS edits for quick adjustments.
Test planning & copy
• Rework test plans and designs based on client feedback, and communicate changes clearly
to Back of House.
• Draft compelling test copy as needed, including headlines and descriptions, following the
client's brand guidelines and marketing strategy.
• Partner with the analytics team to make sure event requests and test results are ready on
schedule.
• Support the CRO team on other projects and tasks as needed.
Client communication
• Monitor client Slack channels and inboxes, and respond to every message within 1 business
day -even if it's an acknowledgement and a handoff to the right team member.
• Assemble call decks and agendas for your Lead to review.
• Support your Lead on client calls and make sure next steps are clearly documented.


Skills & abilities • Extremely detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills.
• Excellent communicator — clear, professional, and client-centered.
• Self-directed and proactive; takes ownership of tasks without close supervision.
• Comfortable pushing work forward with developers and escalating blockers early.
• Tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools; basic HTML/CSS a plus.
• Familiarity with GA4, Wrike, Slack, Shopify, Figma, and common testing tools (Monetate,
Convert, VWO, etc.) preferred but not required.

title: Head of Customer Engineering
description:
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — conglomerates with diversified businesses, both B2B and B2C, in verticals spanning manufacturing, automotive, retail, energy and utilities, mining and pharmaceuticals, education — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes using technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Head of Customer Engineering (CE), you will deploy a team of subject matter experts responsible for working alongside our customers to provide trusted technical and AI-first solution advice.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Lead a team of CE Managers and extended teams, focusing on team culture, talent strategy, and skills development to deliver successful cloud transformation outcomes for customers and accelerate value realization.

  • Balance technical leadership with operational excellence; lead workload and opportunity review meetings with Sales and CE teams and provide insight into how to achieve technical agreements and migration strategy, working directly with customers, partners, and prospects.
  • Work cross-functionally across Google, partners, and your team to resolve technical roadblocks.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience managing a quota-carrying team.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience as a manager leading teams in a technical customer-facing role within professional services or Sales Engineering.
  • Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
  • Experience leading technical conversations, demos, prototyping, or workshops with customers.

Du arbetar primärt inom en butikskedja och ambulerar mellan kedjans olika butiker vid behov. Du bokar dig själv snabbt och enkelt via vår app på de arbetspass som passar dig och ditt schema. Vi arbetar med butiker såsom MQ, Hemtex och Lindex. OBS! Eftersom butikerna nu går in i sin högsäsong så har de inte möjlighet att lära upp vår personal. Därför kan rekryteringsprocessen dra ut på tiden och det kan dröja till i början av 2027 innan vi hör av oss. Som säljare är du delaktig i butikens alla ordinarie arbetsuppgifter såsom försäljning i kassan och på golvet, kundservice, lager samt plock. Som säljare ger du alltid en god kundupplevelse. Du är utåtriktad och arbetar aktivt med kundmöten. Du tar personligt ansvar och arbetar i team med dina kollegor i butiken. Viktig information: För att vara aktuell för tjänsten behöver du enligt kollektivavtal ha en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50%. Du kan antingen vara student eller deltidsarbetande på minst 50%, alt. egenföretagare med aktiv F-skatt. Vi kommer dessvärre inte kunna ta dig vidare i denna rekryteringsprocess om du ej uppfyller något av dessa krav. Beskriv gärna din sysselsättning tydligt i din ansökan. Erfarenhet/kvalifikationer:
  • Du har en fullgjord gymnasieutbildning
  • Du har tidigare arbetat som butikssäljare med personlig försäljning inom detaljhandeln
  • Du kan arbeta minst 2 pass på vardagar dagtid per vecka, utöver detta finns även möjlighet att jobba helg- och kväll
  • Du kan arbeta oregelbundna tider och kan hoppa in med kort varsel
  • Du har goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska
Personliga egenskaper:
  • Du är driven och motiveras av försäljning och kundmöten
  • Du tycker det är utvecklande att arbeta i olika butiker
  • Du är en lagspelare som trivs bra i nära samarbete med kollegor
  • Du är flexibel och trivs med att inte ha ett fast schema
  • Du trivs med att arbeta i högt tempo
Vi erbjuder:
  • Ett utvecklande extrajobb med möjlighet att arbeta i flera olika butiker inom samma butikskedja
  • Flexibla arbetstider, då vi arbetar med en app där du själv bokar in dig på pass
Ansökan: Vi värdesätter de kvaliteter som en jämn ålders- och könsfördelning samt etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten. Pga GDPR kan vi endast ta emot ansökningar via denna annons eller vår hemsida retailstaffing.se. Ansökningar skickade via mail registreras inte. Vänta inte med din ansökan då vi intervjuar och anställer löpande. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! I samband med rekryteringen till tjänsten som säljare kan en bakgrundskontroll via extern part komma att genomföras för att säkerställa att kandidatens profil överensstämmer med Retail Staffings och våra butikskedjors värdegrund. Vi samarbetar med flera butikskedjor inom rekrytering och bemanning av butikssäljare och har idag pooler på olika orter i Sverige. Vi erbjuder våra kandidater att arbeta i världens bästa bransch som uthyrd via vår butikspool. Retail Staffing Sverige AB är medlem i kompetensföretagen Almega och följer alla gällande kollektivavtal. Retail Staffing - "We love retail"

title: Senior Security Engineer, Incident Response
description:
There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

  • Coordinate and drive resolution on a range of incidents.
  • Analyze root causes, trends, and systematic issues.
  • Improve the security and privacy of Google’s products and services.
  • Develop excellence in Incident Management through tools and infrastructure, and preparing teams across Google through exercises and training.
  • Manage relationships across the company including Legal, Engineering, Communications, etc.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with incident or emergency response coordination.
  • Experience in a technical role in systems administration, software engineering, digital forensics, security engineering, or privacy engineering.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science.
  • Experience with Python, Go, C/C++, or Java.
  • Experience with Digital Forensic analysis.
  • Understanding of legal, information security, and privacy frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001 and Safe Harbor Frameworks).
  • Ability to lead teams of people in ambiguous situations through influence and not authority.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and multitasking skills.

title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student), Vibration and Control (Energy Technology)
description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The position is offered initially for two (2) years starting as earliest possible date as agreed mutually agreed between both parties. The position is located in the School of Technology and Innovation, in Efficient Powertrain Solutions (EPS) Research Group, within energy technology discipline, with close co-operation with the VEBIC Research Platform.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will be part of an international team working in multiple challenging projects, at the forefront of research and development of novel combustion engine technologies. The focus is on developing and implementing powertrain control solution to support our cooperation with industrial partners in conforming to straightening emissions regulation in marine and off-road sectors. Our goal is to have ultra-efficient, silent large-bore gas engines meeting restrictive Tier III/Stage V emission norms demonstrated in a relevant environment by 2026. We realize this goal by heavily relying on model-based hardware and control development verified on state-of-the-art experimental facilities. To this end, we are seeking motivated researchers with experience in the listed fields:

- Advanced Vibration and NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness),
- Advanced Control system design and implementation,
- Signal Analysis and Processing,

The following skills are highly desirable and will be considered a strong advantage:

- Engine/Powertrain Control Commissioning, Testing, and Troubleshooting,
- Engine/Powertrain Control Design and Implementation.

All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

- You have a Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant field.
- Strong knowledge of advanced vibration and control theory is required.
- You have very good Skills with MATLAB /Simulink. Develop and test control system.
- Systematic know-how of control development routine and laboratory testing.
- High-level expertise in NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness) would be a significant advantage.
- Demonstrated experience in signal analysis and processing is required.
- Very good analytical skills in addition to good academic writing skills are highly advantageous for your candidature. A proven track record in relevant projects and high-quality journals/conferences/projects, on the topics related to the position, is an additional advantage.
- You enjoy developing innovative solutions to technically challenging problems and have the right mix of intellectual curiosity and practical pragmatism.
- You have good communication skills and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are open to sharing your knowledge with colleagues and ambitious to develop yourself as a researcher.
- Specialization in powertrains/automotive industry is seen as an advantage, such as applications of diesel pressure control, injection control, combustion phasing control etc.
- FPGA and Model-based control design experience are seen as a plus. Knowledge of different sensor techniques and AutoCAD electrical design are a bonus.
- Experience with rapid control prototyping is seen as a plus.

Fluent written and spoken English language skills are mandatory in the position.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required later to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Inspirational work environment

The position is situated in the School of Technology and Innovations within the team of Energy Technology, Efficient Powertrain Solutions (EPS) team.

EPS is an innovative team, focused on modern technology that has a high level of significance in international business operations. We need open-minded, creative and skilled individuals to explore and develop the future energy solutions, decentralized electrical energy distribution systems, smart electricity grids, flexible hybrid energy production, modern fuel combustion engine technology and related bio fuels, energy storages and power electronics. We continuously develop all of our operations in cooperation with companies and other partners. We are strongly networked and responsible actors in research, education and public relations. As a work community, our team is diverse, international and encouraging. The cooperation and support of colleagues promotes well-being and inspires working. title: Senior Data Engineer (Copenhagen or Remote, CET ±1)
description:
This role is open to candidates living within one hour of Danish time, all year round: Western, Central or Eastern European Time (WET, CET or EET). Applications from outside these timezones will not be considered.

About Linkfire and the team

Linkfire is the marketing platform the music industry uses to connect fans with the music they love. Every click on our smart links runs through our platform, millions of times a day, and artists and labels rely on our reporting to understand how their campaigns perform.

Our data platform turns that traffic into analytics inside the product, reporting for major labels, and the numbers the business runs on. Data here is part of the product, not a by-product of it.

Engineering is small and distributed, so you get a wide surface area and real ownership. The platform is still taking shape, and you will have a real say in where it goes next: architecture, tooling and the standards we hold ourselves to. You will work alongside the engineers who built this platform, and they will bring you into how it all fits together.

What you will do

  • Help steer how the platform evolves, and grow into owning it end to end.
  • Build and maintain our production data pipelines on Snowflake and Airflow, along with the Python services that power them.
  • Build quality in from the start: everything you ship comes with tests and monitoring, rather than having them added later.
  • Help build the AI agents that take repetitive data questions and investigations off the team's plate.
  • Work with Product Managers and stakeholders early, so data is designed into features rather than added afterwards, and explain your choices to people who are not engineers.
  • Take requests or roadmap items from idea to production, including challenging concepts and decisions early.
  • Own the day-to-day flow of data work: requests from product and customer-facing teams, changes to existing pipelines, and new sources and feeds.
  • Model data so analysis and reporting are easy. Dashboards stay with our analyst, but you know what they need and you build for it.
  • Leave the platform better than you found it: documentation, tests, standardisation, and retiring what we no longer need.

What we are looking for

  • Five or more years building production data pipelines.
  • Strong Python. You have built services from scratch, with automated tests, sound design patterns and code that stays easy to maintain and scale.
  • Deep experience with a cloud data warehouse in production, ideally Snowflake. If your depth is in BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, we will give you room to go deep on Snowflake in your first months.
  • Hands-on with Airflow or a similar orchestrator, and comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes and Argo CD.

How you work

  • Product at heart. You see data end to end, from how it is collected to who uses it and why.
  • Curiosity beyond your own stack. We work T-shaped: deep in data, interested in everything around it.
  • You spot problems and bring solutions, and you find the balance between doing it right and getting it done.
  • You use AI daily and have opinions on where it helps. Tell us about it when you apply.
  • You communicate clearly and directly, mostly in writing.

The stack

This is what we run today. You don’t need experience with all of it, and we’ll help you get up to speed on the rest.

  • Snowflake, with production pipelines in Python on an in-house framework.
  • Airflow on Amazon MWAA for orchestration.
  • Weld for ELT and reverse ETL, Metabase for internal and embedded dashboards.
  • AWS (SNS, S3), Docker, Kubernetes and Argo CD.
  • GitHub Actions, Terraform and Atlantis for CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with parts of our stack beyond Snowflake and Airflow, such as Terraform, Weld or Metabase.
  • Event-driven ingestion on AWS.
  • Building with LLMs, for example tooling that automates investigations or answers questions about data.

Location

Copenhagen office if you want one, fully remote if you do not, as long as you live within one hour of Danish time all year round: UTC+0 to UTC+2 in winter, UTC+1 to UTC+3 in summer. That covers WET, CET and EET, from Portugal in the west to the Baltics and Finland in the east. Full-time, permanent.

Why join Linkfire

  • Six weeks' paid holiday. Wherever you are based, plus a 4% company pension contribution if you are in Denmark, and competitive compensation.
  • Room to grow. Clear, defined roles and a career framework, with the explicit goal of helping every engineer progress, whether that means going deeper or taking on more scope.
  • Experienced peers. Engineers who have built and run this platform for years, and who will treat you as a peer from day one.
  • Scale you can see. Your pipelines turn every click on the platform into the numbers artists and labels act on.
  • Work you can point at. A small team and a large platform, so what you build matters.
  • Remote-first. Flexibility, and colleagues across several countries.

Linkfire is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and identity, and we hire on skills, experience and how you work.

title: Misa söker en arbetskonsulent till Misa Döbelnsgatan
description:
Misa ingår i WiljaGruppen som ägs av den allmännyttiga Stiftelsen Includia. Vår vision är att med rätt stöd kan alla som vill delta i arbetslivet.

Misa Döbelnsgatan startade sin verksamhet 2009 och idag är vi ett erfaret och engagerat team på 15 medarbetare. Hos oss värdesätter vi samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och engagemang.

Vi arbetar med personer inom autismspektrumet och erbjuder individuellt anpassat stöd på vägen mot arbete, praktik eller studier.

Vi tror att mångfald berikar vår verksamhet och välkomnar särskilt sökande med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och perspektiv.

Om tjänsten

Som arbetskonsulent har du en central roll i att stötta personer mot arbete eller studier. Du fungerar som en vägledande och samordnande länk mellan deltagare, arbetsgivare och övriga samarbetspartners. Rollen präglas av relationsskapande, individuellt stöd och ett lösningsfokuserat arbetssätt där du bidrar till att skapa hållbara vägar till arbetslivet.

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Ge individuellt anpassat stöd till deltagare inom autismspektrumet.
  • Planera och genomföra individuella möten med deltagare i våra lokaler och ute i samhället.
  • Arbeta enligt Supported Employment (SE) med fokus på deltagarens styrkor, behov och önskemål.
  • Söka, etablera och följa upp praktikplatser som matchar den enskilda deltagarens mål och förutsättningar.
  • Ha ett utåtriktat arbete och skapa kontakter och samarbeten med arbetsgivare.
  • Vara delaktig i och ta ansvar för kompletterande aktiviteter inom verksamheten.

Kompetenskrav

  • Akademisk examen som socionom, arbetsterapeut, studie- och yrkesvägledare, beteendevetare, stödpedagog eller motsvarande utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
  • Kunskap om och erfarenhet av att arbeta med personer inom autismspektrumet.

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av att hantera kontakter med arbetsgivare.
  • Kunskap om och erfarenhet av att arbeta enligt Supported Employment (SE).
  • Erfarenhet att hålla i och leda gruppverksamhet.

Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta i team, samtidigt som du är trygg i att arbeta självständigt och ta eget ansvar. Du är utåtriktad och har lätt för att skapa nya kontakter, samtidigt som du är lyhörd och inlyssnande i mötet med deltagare. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du även vara strukturerad, flexibel och lösningsorienterad.

Det är viktigt för oss att du delar vår värdegrund om att alla kan delta i samhället och arbetslivet med rätt stöd.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos Misa får du ett nära och tillitsbaserat ledarskap och en stor delaktighet i verksamhetens utveckling. Vi erbjuder ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, gedigen introduktionsutbildning och kompetensutveckling, extern/intern handledning samt tjänstepension.

Tillsvidaretjänst, heltid 100%, som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Planerat tillträde i april 2027. Utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister (Lag 1998:620) ska uppvisas innan du erbjuds anställning. Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och sista ansökningsdag är 2026-12-01. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, då vi hanterar ansökningar löpande. För frågor kring tjänsten hör av dig till enhetschef Lotta Bodén Bruzelius, lotta.boden.bruzelius@misa.se

För mer info: www.misa.se

title: Rakennusaputyöntekijä
description:
Oletko kokenut rakennusalan osaaja tai vasta urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva tulevaisuuden tekijä? Viihdytkö tiimityössä ja arvostat vaihtelevia työtehtäviä? Jos vastasit kyllä, haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää!

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme rakennusapulaisia Savonlinnan alueelle. Rakennusapulaisen työtehtäviin kuuluu monipuolisesti erilaisia avustavia tehtäviä työmaalla. Työnkuvaan kuuluu perustöitä, kuten siivouksen ja järjestyksen ylläpitoa, haalausta ja purkutöitä. Lisäksi työnkuvaan kuuluu avustavat rakennustehtävät tulevia työvaihteita silmällä pitäen, kuten esimerkiksi muottien asettaminen valuja varten, tukirakentaiden asentaminen tai alustojen valmistelu.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan alkuvuonna tammi-helmikuussa ja projektin arvioitu kesto on pari kuukautta.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

* Hyvä asenne ja oma-aloitteinen työote: olet ajoissa paikalla, teet sen minkä lupaat, uskallat kysyä apua ja olet valmis ottamaan vastaan ohjeita ja uusia oppeja

* Voimassaoleva työturvakortti
* Fyysistä kuntoa, sillä työtehtävät voivat olla fyysisesti kuormittavia.

* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
* B-luokan ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta



Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:

* Rakennusalan koulutus ja/tai aiempaa työkokemusta rakennusalan töistä



Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 13,79-15,55 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet

* Mukavan ja rennon työporukan

* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa



Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.
