title: Technical Program Manager II, Spares Readiness, Data Center Operations
location: Midlothian, TX, USA; Lithia Springs, GA, USA
description:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

At Google, we own and operate the most advanced fleet of data centers and core technical infrastructure to power services and features used by billions of people around the world. Data Centers Central Operations is responsible for keeping these sites operating efficiently and safely.

Within the Data Centers Central Operations function, you will be a part of the Spares Readiness team and will be accountable for improvement/sustainment projects/programs that support our mission of assuring that data centers have their spare parts available to them when they need them.

You specifically will focus on Third-Party Data Centers, and will focus on developing programs focused on the facility stocking strategy for maintaining Google's compute, storage and network infrastructure outside of Google-owned buildings.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Analyze, identify, and publish opportunities based on topological equipment similarities between various envelopes within the data center design catalogue, using available data and by researching data across partner organizations and site operations.
  • Drive efficiencies with knowledge sharing and develop process for managing critical part escalations and tracking optimizing part management and availability across envelope types.
  • Establish incident monitoring reporting and analytics in relation to spare part consumption within third-party data centers.
  • Learn key tactical tools and maintenance procedures used across YAWN and third-party data centers sites and develop insights to guide new processes and programs.
  • Collaborate with site leaders, site teams, and cross-functional partners across our fleet, understanding key gaps, pain points, and opportunities that exist across third-party data centers, while providing support, recommendations, and building robust relationships with the site teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience in supply chain management (e.g., infrastructure operations, supply chain operations, data center operations or manufacturing).
  • Experience with advanced data analytics/statistical analysis (e.g., SAP, SQL, dashboard creation).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Lean or Six Sigma certification.
  • 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Experience coordinating projects or programs across global teams, spanning multiple offices, time zones, and regional environments.

title: Time Keeper
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Time Keeper to support construction-site operations by accurately recording employee attendance and working hours. You will maintain reliable timekeeping records, coordinate with site teams and HR, and help ensure payroll and labor reports are completed on schedule. Responsibilities: - Record daily attendance, work hours, overtime, leave, and absences for site employees and subcontractor personnel, as applicable. - Maintain accurate timesheets and timekeeping records using approved systems and procedures. - Verify attendance entries against site registers, access records, supervisor reports, and approved work schedules. - Follow up with supervisors and employees to resolve missing, inconsistent, or disputed time entries. - Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly attendance and labor reports to HR, payroll, and project management. - Track shift assignments, overtime approvals, and leave records in line with company procedures and applicable UAE requirements. - Protect the confidentiality of employee information and maintain organized records for audits and reference. - Coordinate with site administration, HR, payroll, and project teams to support timely and accurate payroll processing. - Report attendance patterns or timekeeping issues to the appropriate manager. - Comply with site safety rules and company policies while working in construction-site environments.

- High school diploma or equivalent; additional training in timekeeping, administration, or HR is an advantage. - Previous 3 years experience in timekeeping, attendance administration, payroll support, or site administration—preferably in construction. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling numerical and employee information. - Comfortable using spreadsheets and attendance or timekeeping systems; proficiency in Microsoft Excel is an advantage. - Good communication and coordination skills, with the confidence to follow up on discrepancies professionally. - Able to organize records, meet reporting deadlines, and handle confidential information responsibly. - Familiarity with construction-site shifts, timesheets, and overtime procedures is preferred. - Working knowledge of UAE employment and payroll practices is an advantage. - Able to work effectively with site teams in a fast-paced environment; knowledge of English is required, and additional languages are beneficial.

title: Testledare & Releaseplanerare SJ IT - Stockholm
description:
Senior Testledare & Releaseplanerare – SJ IT

Vill du leda testarbete och releaseplanering i ett av SJ:s viktigaste digitala förändringsprojekt? Kraftsam Rekrytering & Bemanning söker nu en erfaren Testledare & Releaseplanerare för ett konsultuppdrag hos SJ i Stockholm.

I denna roll blir du en del av projektledningen för ReFORD, ett strategiskt initiativ som syftar till att genomföra en kontrollerad övergång till en ny lösning för fordons- och underhållsinformation. Uppdraget innebär att säkerställa kvalitet, samordning och leveransförmåga i ett komplext integrationslandskap med flera system, leverantörer och intressenter.

Placering är i Stockholm. Uppdraget omfattar heltid med start enligt överenskommelse.

Om företaget

SJ är en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom persontransporter på järnväg och bedriver en omfattande verksamhet med höga krav på säkerhet, kvalitet och tillgänglighet. Inom ramen för digitalisering och modernisering genomförs flera strategiska IT-initiativ för att stärka verksamheten och framtidssäkra bolagets systemstöd.

Om rollen

Som Testledare & Releaseplanerare ansvarar du för att etablera, driva och utveckla testarbetet inom projektet ReFORD. Rollen ställer höga krav på struktur, samordningsförmåga och förmågan att omsätta komplexa krav till testbara scenarier.

Du kommer att arbeta i en miljö där testning genomförs av verksamhetsresurser och projektmedlemmar snarare än av dedikerade testteam. Därför blir din förmåga att skapa tydliga processer, instruktioner och beslutsunderlag avgörande för projektets framgång.

  • Säkerställa att testfall, instruktioner och underlag möjliggör effektiv testning.

  • Säkerställa go-live readiness inför produktionssättning.

  • Identifiera och hantera risker kopplade till test och release.
  • Samverka med verksamhet, projektgrupp, leverantörer och övriga intressenter.

Kompetenskrav

1. Dokumenterad erfarenhet som testledare i större IT-initiativ eller program.

2. Erfarenhet av att leda testarbete i miljöer utan dedikerade testteam.

3. Erfarenhet av komplexa integrationsmiljöer med flera system och externa parter.

4. Erfarenhet av release management eller releaseplanering.

5. Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och driva arbetet framåt.

6. Förmåga att bryta ned krav till testbara scenarier och tydliga instruktioner.

7. Mycket god struktur- och dokumentationsförmåga.

8. Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Mervärdeskrav

1. Erfarenhet från transportsektorn eller järnvägsbranschen.

2. Erfarenhet av arbete med externa underhållsleverantörer.

3. Erfarenhet av EAM- eller underhållssystem.

4. Erfarenhet av förändringsledning i samband med systeminföranden.

5. Erfarenhet av miljöer med flera parallella lösningar och övergångsstrukturer.

Kraftsam Rekrytering & Bemanning hjälper företag och offentliga verksamheter att hitta rätt kompetens för både specialist- och ledande roller. title: Kotisiivooja, Kotileena Oy, Jyväskylä
description:
Etsitkö päivätyötä Jyväskylän seudulta? Haluatko työssäsi nähdä oman käden jäljen ja asiakaspalveluosaamisesi saa hymyn ihmisten huulille? Oletko aidosti kiinnostunut siivousalan tehtävistä? Mikäli vastasit kyllä, kannattaa jatkaa lukemista!



Etsimme asiakkaamme Kotileena Oy:n toiminnan kasvaessa heille pitkäaikaista

KOTISIIVOOJAA

monipuolisiin tehtäviin Jyväskylään.



Millaisesta tehtävästä on kyse?

Työkohteet sijaitsevat Jyväskylässä ja lähiympäristössä. Kotisiivouksessa työkohteet ovat toisistaan poikkeavia, joka tuo vaihtelua työhön. Työssä et tarvitse omaa autoa, mutta ajokortti tulee olla. Työpäivät sijoittuvat arkipäiviin ma-pe välille. Työpäivien pituudet vaihtelevat painottuen klo 7-16 välille (pääasiassa aloitus klo 8) ja viikkotunteja kertyy 20-40 h. Töitä tekevälle töitä löytyy aina!

Palkkauksessa noudatetaan kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta ja tuntipalkka on alkaen pr 2 mukaisesti 12,59 €/h.

Aikaisempi osaaminen on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä. Tärkeintä on halu tehdä siivousalan työtä. Työhön saa kattavan perehdytyksen, johon huolellisuus, luotettavuus ja oma-aloitteisuus tuovat tarvittavan pohjan. Työtä tehdään pääasiassa parityönä.

Työsuhde solmitaan valitun henkilön ja Kotileena Oy:n välille.

Toivomme sinulta

- B-ajokorttia

- Positiivista ja reipasta asennetta työhön

- Hyvää fyysistä peruskuntoa

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen osaamista

Tarjoamme sinulle

- Tilaisuuden kehittyä siivousalan osaajana

- Vakituisen työsuhteen alan arvostetulla toimijalla

- Hyvät työsuhde- ja palkkaedut

- Kattavan perehdytyksen

- Mukavan työyhteisön tuen

Arvostamme

- Aikaisempaa työkokemusta siivousalalta



Kiinnostuitko?

Lisätietoja hausta antaa StaffPointilla rekrytointikonsultti Hanna Linnas, hanna.linnas@staffpoint.fi.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksen ainoastaan hakujärjestelmämme kautta GDPR-ohjeistuksia noudattaen.




Kotileena Oy

Kotileenan tarina alkoi vuonna 1992, kun yrityksemme perustaja Leena alkoi tarjota siivouspalveluita kotitalouksille helpottaakseen ihmisten arkea. Leenan periaatteisiin kuului tehdä työ laadukkaasti ja luotettavasti ja nämä periaatteet ovat toimintamme kulmakiviä edelleen.

Olemme kotisiivouksen kokeneita ammattilaisia ja ylpeita osaamisestamme. Meille on karttunut kokemusta kotisiivouksesta 90-luvun alusta saakka ja teemme vuosittain yli 60 000 siivouskertaa tuhansissa kodeissa ympari Suomen. Kotileenalla työskentelee lähes 150 siivousalan rautaista ammattilaista.

Sähköposti: hanna.linnas@staffpoint.fi

title: Policy Enforcement Manager, YPP, YouTube Trust and Safety
description:
Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust & Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.

As a Policy Enforcement Manager (PEM) dedicated to enforcing the policies of YouTube’s Partner Program (YPP), you will help drive the overall strategy and enforcement approach for all policies in this area. You will work with a cross-functional team across Policy Development, Product, Engineering, Legal, Ads Policy and Scaled Abuse to operationalize scalable policies that minimize brand risk to the platform while also educating Creators. You will think through the unique challenges of a broad array of policy areas (e.g. Reused content, Inauthentic Content, Misleading content, Adult, Kids etc.) while developing processes that are consistent and resilient to protect the ecosystem. You will review graphic, controversial, and offensive video content at times.

This role will also require on-call work on weekends and holidays on a rotational basis.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of how our YPP policies impact YouTube users, platform changes and new product launches.
  • Be responsible for specific areas of vertical performance for YPP operations, including quality.
  • Generate ideas for policy changes to improve quality and reduce operational burden.
  • Manage sensitive escalations end-to-end, partnering with key cross functional and executive stakeholders to drive solutions.
  • Prepare presentations and clearly communicate initiatives to management and to the broader organization.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in operations such as in data analytics, trust and safety, policy, cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • 2 years of experience with data analysis.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of prior work experience, ideally in content policy, anti-abuse or customer support operations; reviewing content or answering user questions and working with vendors.
  • Experience with identifying abuse trends or working in policy.
  • Experience with SQL and spreadsheets, with the ability to build relationships with cross-functional partners across geographies, and use data to drive strategy and business action.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation, including non-standard working hours, night shifts, weekends and holidays.

title: DevOps engineer til dataanalyse i PET
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre, at PET’s analytikere og efterforskere har stabile og effektive værktøjer til at analysere store og komplekse datamængder? Som DevOps engineer kommer du tæt på både udviklingen og den operative anvendelse af vores analyseplatforme. Dit arbejde er med til at sikre, at nye funktioner og forbedringer hurtigt og sikkert kan tages i brug, når behovet opstår.

Få teknikken sikkert fra udvikling til anvendelse


I Sektionen for Analyseværktøjer i PET søger vi en DevOps engineer til vores platforme til dataanalyse. Vores produkter gør det muligt for PET’s medarbejdere at udføre avanceret analyse, herunder ved hjælp af AI, på tværs af mange typer data som geospatiale data, tidsserier, tekst, billede, video, lyd og grafdata.


I vores sektion er vi tæt på PET’s operative virke, og nogle gange skal tingene gå stærkt. Som DevOps engineer i vores sektion bidrager du derfor til Danmarks sikkerhed ved at gøre processen fra commit til produktion så hurtig og friktionsfri som muligt. Du vil også spille en central rolle i et etablere både DevOps tooling og kultur i PET. Du kommer samtidig til at spille en vigtig rolle i at videreudvikle vores værktøjer og arbejdsmetoder. Du vil også bidrage med din tekniske faglighed i dialogen med leverandører om implementering af nye systemer og platforme.


Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Holde vores systemer sunde, tilgængelige og sikre i produktion. Det dækker over frontend, backend-processering, databaser og integrationer.
  • Udvikle tooling der gør det enkelt og sikkert for udviklerne selv at deploye og drive deres ændringer. Det indebærer blandt andet arbejde med CI/CD pipelines, rollback, observability og guardrails.
  • Gennemføre root cause-analyse, når noget går galt, skrive målrettede bug fixes i applikationskoden og genoprette stabil drift sammen med resten af teamet og vores samarbejdspartnere i organisationen.
  • Migrere et af vores systemer til Kubernetes i samarbejde med vores on-prem Cloud-team, der vedligeholder clusteret.
  • Arbejde på tværs af platform-grænser. Vores produkter integrerer bl.a. op imod vores dataplatform og vores AI platform. Derudover samarbejder vi tæt med vores Cloud-team. Derfor handler en del af jobbet om at navigere i grænsefladen mellem vores og deres systemer. Det vil fx sige at triagere, hvor et problem er opstået og kommunikere præcist på tværs af grænsefladen.

Inddrag gerne i din ansøgning, hvis du er i stand til og har lyst til at skrive software, ikke bare script, samt hvis du har interesse for og evnerne til lejlighedsvist at bidrage til udviklingsopgaver. Det kan fx være ved at gøre vores systemer i stand til at modtage og udstille en ny type data, når ballonen går op.

Vi forventer ikke, at du har erfaring med det hele. Vi hjælper dig med at lære det, du ikke allerede kan. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du trives med at løfte opgaver, synes det er sjovt at være tæt på udvikling og omsætte det idérige til det driftsstabile. Det er vigtigt, at du kommer med en motivation til at videreudvikle dig, og har lyst til at angribe komplekse opgaver, som kræver, at du tilegner dig viden på et nyt teknisk felt.

Du skal samtidig kunne lide spændet mellem udvikling og drift. Du får mulighed for både at automatisere det manuelle, løse de fejl, der uundgåeligt opstår, og bruge erfaringerne til at gøre løsningerne mere robuste næste gang.

Du trives med ansvar og samarbejde


Vi lægger vægt på, hvordan du går til dit arbejde, samarbejder med andre og tager ansvar for de løsninger, du er med til at skabe. Derfor ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Automatiserer dig ud af manuelt arbejde. Du foretrækker at udvikle værktøjet, som fjerner det manuelle arbejde, frem for selv at udføre opgaverne i hånden.
  • Håndterer fejl uden at placere skyld. Incidents er læringsmuligheder og input til mere robuste systemer.
  • Samarbejder godt. Vi har mange samarbejdspartnere. Du kan navigere i snitfladerne mellem din egen rolle, tech leads i og uden for sektionen samt kommercielle leverandører.

Bliv en del af et team med forskellige fagligheder

Du bliver en del af Sektionen for Analyseværktøjer, hvor vi udvikler og driver de værktøjer, som PET’s analytikere og efterforskere bruger i deres arbejde med data. Teamet består af kolleger med forskellige fagligheder og perspektiver, og vi bruger hinanden til at finde gode løsninger. Som DevOps engineer får du både mulighed for at bringe din egen faglighed i spil og for at blive klogere sammen med kolleger, der kan noget andet end dig.

Vi tjener et alvorligt formål, men har en uformel omgangstone og plads til at have det sjovt. Det er plads til at udfordre hinandens idéer, spørge om hjælp og dele det, man selv ved. Og derudover har vi et fællesskab, hvor humor og godt kollegaskab er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Du får med andre ord et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi tager teknikken og vores fælles ansvar alvorligt, men hvor der samtidig er plads til forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på. Vi tror på, at det både giver bedre løsninger og gør det sjovere at gå på arbejde.

Det kræver IT -profiler at værne om frihed, mennesker og demokrati og PET er en stor IT-arbejdsplads. Her arbejder java-udviklere, infrastrukturspecialister, netværksteknikere, hackere, firewallspecialister og mange andre med en baggrund inden for IT. Nogle har valgt PET for at arbejde med store og komplekse opgaver. Andre faldt for, at vi selv designer mange af vores løsninger fra bunden, udvikler og implementerer dem. Vores kollegaer skal bruge vores arbejde, og vi er med fra start til slut. Endelig har mange af os valgt jobbet for at arbejde med en sag, der er større end profit og timefakturering.

Vores arbejdsplads er som ingen andre. Som ansat i PET bliver du en del af en hverdag, der er præget af opgaver, som ikke findes andre steder, og hver dag byder på nye udfordringer, som ikke fandtes i går. Vi har en hverdag, der aldrig bliver hverdag, og det kan du også få.

Ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelsesstart pr. 1. marts eller hurtigst muligt derefter. Du kan læse mere om hele PET’s ansættelsesproces på www.PET.dk/job .

Et ansættelsesforhold i PET skal behandles med diskretion, hvilket du som ansøger skal være opmærksom på. Det betyder, at du som udgangspunkt godt kan fortælle tætte og fortrolige relationer, som du har tillid til, at du har søgt en stilling i PET, men ikke hvad jobbet indebærer.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse i PET, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til yderst hemmelig, ligesom du skal kunne opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse. Som sikkerhedsgodkendt forventes det, at du er særlig opmærksom på din tavshedspligt i forhold til klassificeret information.

Har du en akademisk baggrund, bliver du ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til de til enhver tid gældende aftaler mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikernes Centralorganisation. Har du en anden uddannelsesmæssig baggrund, bliver du ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer i staten mellem Finansministeriet og HK/STAT samt OAO-S-fællesoverenskomst

Du indplaceres som fuldmægtig, specialkonsulent eller chefkonsulent på AC-overenskomsten eller i løngruppe 2 eller 3 på HK-overenskomsten afhængigt at din erfaring og faglige kompetencer. Som IT-medarbejder på HK-overenskomsten tildeles du desuden et EDB-tillæg på 2.090,18 kr. pr. måned eksklusiv pension. For begge overenskomster gælder, at der eventuelt kan forhandles tillæg på baggrund af en individuel vurdering.

Dit arbejdssted bliver på Klausdalsbrovej 1 i Søborg, lige ved siden af Buddinge station, hvor både S-tog og bus kører lige til døren. I PET arbejder vi på interne systemer og med fortrolige opgaver, og derfor møder vi også på arbejde hver dag for at løse vores opgaver.

Yderligere information

Du kan lære meget mere om PET som arbejdsplads på www.PET.dk/job , hvor du bl.a. kan læse mere om alle de fagligheder, der arbejder i PET og deres hverdag. Du kan også lytte til vores podcastserie ’Tjenesten og truslerne’.

Når du søger en stilling hos PET, giver du lov til, at vi må indhente dit CPR-nummer via CPR-registeret med henblik på identifikation af dig i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen. Vi indhenter dit CPR-nummer, så vi sikkert kan fremsende relevante og nødvendige dokumenter til dig via Digital Post.

Det er vigtigt for os, at PET afspejler den mangfoldighed, som vi arbejder for. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede, uanset køn, alder, religion, seksualitet og etniske tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Træd ind i en lukket verden, der åbner nye døre, hvor vi udvikler os, træner og bygger videre på det, vi kan. Om vi udvikler nye systemer, analyserer data eller finjusterer fodstillingen til skydetræning, så er vi altid på tæerne. Det skaber gode muligheder for, at du kan rykke dig med os, vokse med opgaverne og åbne nye døre i dit arbejdsliv.

title: Software Engineer III, Cloud TPU Compiler
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google’s revolutionary Cloud TPUs were designed from the ground up to accelerate machine learning workloads, providing the computational power to train and run cutting-edge machine learning models in a fraction of the time and cost conventionally required. TPUs have been wildly successful internally at Google. With our Cloud TPU service, it's easy to take your existing ML workloads (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) and move them to the cloud to take advantage of this great capability.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Work on AI framework development to successfully enable PyTorch models to run on Google Cloud's TPUs and GPUs and tune for peak performance.
  • Provide comprehensive support for ML frameworks and compilers on Cloud TPUs and GPUs, enabling the training and deployment of the most advanced machine learning models, driving innovation and breakthroughs.
  • Collaborate with other Google teams and leading researchers across the industry to continuously bring cutting-edge ML capabilities to our PyTorch-in-Cloud offering.
  • Help with design, development, testing deploying and maintaining software.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
  • 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).
  • Experience in C++.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • Experience with ML frameworks, such as PyTorch/XLA/Pallas/GPU/TPU programming.
  • Experience with compilers, machine learning optimization, distributed machine learning.

title: Technical Business Analyst - Priority Programs
description:
Bring clarity to the national health programs that help Australians get the care they need

  • Turn big ideas and business priorities into clear requirements for a national health platform• Be part of a purpose-driven team helping all Australians get the care they need• Enjoy hybrid working from our Haymarket office, a short walk from Central station

About us
At Healthdirect Australia, we help Australians access trusted health information, advice and care through our national virtual health services.About the opportunity
Every day, Australians turn to us for trusted health advice and care. Behind those services is a lot of careful thinking, and that's where you come in.As our Technical Business Analyst, you'll be at the heart of our Priority Programs Division, helping turn national, state and territory health programs from good ideas into services that work. You'll connect government partners, technology teams, vendors and frontline operations, uncovering what people really need and shaping practical requirements that technical teams can build with confidence.It's a varied role in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, with plenty of perspectives around the table and important deadlines to meet. If you enjoy making complex things clear, bringing people with you and seeing your work make a difference to the health of Australians, you'll feel right at home.
Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:

  • Draw out, analyse and communicate business and technical requirements so solutions deliver real value to stakeholders and the people who use our services• Create clear, practical artefacts, from requirements, business rules and acceptance criteria to process models, wireframes and integration and API data analysis• Lead workshops, discovery and review sessions that bring government, vendors, technology teams and operations onto the same page• Build strong relationships and manage expectations across internal and external stakeholders, raising risks early and keeping communication open and transparent• Keep change well controlled while helping to evolve our business analysis framework, tools and ways of working

About You

  • A curious, analytical thinker who asks the right questions to get to the heart of what stakeholders need• A confident facilitator who can cut through differing opinions and build agreement• Comfortable working across government, vendor, technology and operations teams in a multi-stakeholder environment• A clear communicator who explains complex technical ideas in plain, jargon-free language• Outcomes-focused, adaptable and energised by fast-paced work and critical deadlines

What you'll bring to the role

  • 5+ years' technical business analysis experience, with good working knowledge across most areas of business analysis as defined by the IIBA• Strong problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and teamwork skills• Proven experience using Jira and Confluence, and working in an agile delivery environment• Experience working in, and enjoying, complex matrix environments• Tertiary qualifications in information technology, business or commerce, or equivalent experience• Preferred: knowledge of FHIR standards, experience in healthcare and government, and delivering complex online tools with third-party data sources and integrations

Why join Healthdirect
Your work will contribute to nationally significant virtual health services that support Australians to access trusted health advice and care. You will help shape quality, safety and experience outcomes in a committed, consumer-centred organisation.We are committed to creating a culture where you can bring your whole self to work.
Our benefits include:

  • Flexible work arrangements (2 days per week in office, pro-rated for part time employees);• 14 weeks company Paid Parental Leave for both parents;• Multi-dimensional wellbeing program that is run by our people for our people;• Individual curated learner journeys to support you to expand your capabilities and unlock your talent.

title: Energy Storage - Technical Leader
description:
EPRI is seeking an Energy Storage Technical Leader to apply EPRI research and expertise to cost effective, reliable, and safe utility-scale battery energy storage (BESS), solar PV, and hybrid plants across the Gulf region and beyond. The role requires strong experience in design, construction inspection, commissioning, and grid integration, with the ability to engage developers, EPCs, utilities, and off takers. Key Responsibilities: •Review and optimize BESS designs: architecture, sizing, equipment, augmentation, controls, and safety • Review PV and hybrid (PV plus BESS) designs, including interconnection •Assess specifications, layouts, equipment selection, and plant configurations against relevant standards and for cost and efficiency •Validate performance, yield, and dispatch models (e.g. PVsyst, Homer) and propose corrections • Evaluate EPC deliverables, test plans, engineering studies, FAT, and SAT • Identify risks and recommend technical improvements • Conduct site visits and support inspections and commissioning • Track regional project activity and engage key stakeholders •Communicate findings to technical and executive audiences through reports and deliverables •Develop replicable solutions that improve plant affordability, reliability, performance, safety, and circularity •Represent EPRI research at technical conferences and in meetings with stakeholders and member companies

Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's degree in electrical, mechanical, or power systems engineering; Master's preferred Experience: •10+ years in design, inspection, commissioning, or operation of utility-scale solar PV and BESS, of which 5+ years in BESS is a must; wind experience is a plus •Multiple demonstrable projects with a developer, EPC, inspection and commissioning provider, or utility •Evaluating compliance with international standards and local grid codes (UL, NFPA, IEC, ISO) • Exposure to applied research in BESS or solar through technology, modeling, or testing Required Skills: • Strong understanding of BESS, PV, and hybrid plant design • Familiarity with HV/MV systems, lines, substations, SCADA, and plant controls • Experience with plant control strategies (e.g. AGC, curtailment, storage dispatch) • Competence in interpreting performance models and system studies • Clear written and verbal communication for technical and executive audiences • Regional focus with ability to apply global best practices Additional Qualification: Must be eligible to obtain visas for travel within the GCC, China, the EU, and the United States.

title: Säljare inom Information, Processhantering & Automatisering till Citedo
description:
Tjänstebeskrivning & erbjudande

Vill du arbeta med försäljning där du hjälper företag att effektivisera sina processer, automatisera manuella arbetsflöden och skapa bättre struktur i sin informationshantering? Då kan det här vara nästa steg för dig. Citedo är en IT-tjänsteleverantör med verksamhet över hela Sverige och Norden. Bolaget fortsätter att växa och erbjuder lösningar inom bland annat IT, Information, Processhantering & Automatisering, Print och AV teknik. Nu söker Citedo en affärsdriven säljare till området Information, Processhantering & Automatisering. Här arbetar du med lösningar som hjälper kunder att digitalisera och automatisera arbetsflöden, minska manuellt och repetitivt arbete samt skapa en säkrare och mer strukturerad informationshantering. Det här är en roll för dig som vill sälja mer än en färdig produkt. Du sätter dig in i kundens verksamhet, identifierar utmaningar och affärsmöjligheter och arbetar tillsammans med Citedos specialister för att hitta rätt lösning. Vi erbjuder dig: • En viktig roll i ett växande affärsområde • Möjlighet att sälja moderna lösningar inom digitalisering, automatisering och informationshantering • Nära samarbete med affärsutvecklare, tekniska specialister och konsulter • Stor möjlighet att påverka och utveckla din egen affär • Fast lön i kombination med en attraktiv provisionsmodell • Hybrid arbetsplats med möjlighet till flexibilitet Arbetsuppgifter Som säljare ansvarar du för att identifiera och utveckla affärsmöjligheter hos både nya och befintliga kunder. Du driver säljprocessen från första kontakt och behovsanalys till lösningsförslag, offert och avslut. En viktig del av rollen är att förstå hur kunden faktiskt arbetar idag. Det kan exempelvis handla om manuella och tidskrävande administrativa processer, information som ligger utspridd i olika system eller arbetsmoment som skulle kunna digitaliseras och automatiseras. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innebär att: • Aktivt prospektera och bearbeta nya kunder • Utveckla affären hos befintliga kunder • Genomföra kundmöten, behovsanalyser och presentationer • Identifiera processer och informationsflöden som kan effektiviseras • Driva affärer genom hela säljcykeln • Ta fram lösningsförslag tillsammans med Citedos specialister • Bygga långsiktiga relationer med beslutsfattare och andra nyckelpersoner hos kunden Citedos erbjudande omfattar bland annat digitala arbetsflöden och informationshantering, automatisering, fakturahantering, digitalisering av arkiv samt intelligent och AI-driven dokumenttolkning.

Personprofil

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning av mjukvara, IT-lösningar eller andra verksamhetsnära digitala lösingar. Du är van vid att arbeta konsultativt och tycker om att sätta dig in i kundens verksamhet för att förstå var det finns potential att skapa affärsvärde. Erfarenhet av försäljning inom exempelvis Information Management, ECM, DMS, workflow, processautomation, RPA, fakturahantering eller närliggande mjukvarulösningar är särskilt relevant. Det viktigaste är dock att du har förmågan att förstå kundens affär och kan omsätta ett verksamhetsproblem till en konkret lösning. Som person är du: • Affärsdriven och resultatorienterad • Nyfiken och duktig på att förstå kunders verksamheter • Självgående och bekväm med att skapa nya affärer • Strukturerad och van att driva längre säljprocesser • Förtroendeingivande och skicklig på att bygga långsiktiga relationer • Bekväm med att samarbeta med tekniska specialister och andra kompetenser Du behöver inte själv vara teknisk specialist. Däremot behöver du vara tillräckligt nyfiken på teknik, digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling för att kunna förstå kundens behov och se vilka möjligheter som finns. Citedos arbetssätt bygger på att först förstå verksamheten och dess processer, därefter genomföra workshop/förstudie, ta fram lösning och affärsvärde och slutligen gå vidare mot implementation och uppföljning. Varför Citedo? Hos Citedo kommer du in i ett område som ligger högt på många företags agenda. Organisationer vill effektivisera sina processer, minska manuellt arbete, få bättre kontroll över sin information och skapa rätt förutsättningar för automatisering och AI. Lösningarna kan exempelvis bidra till snabbare processer, mindre personberoende, kostnadsbesparingar, högre kvalitet och möjlighet att växa utan att administrationen behöver växa i samma takt. Här får du därför möjlighet att arbeta med försäljning där lösningen kan få konkret effekt på kundens vardag och verksamhet. Vi värderar dina personliga egenskaper högt och ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom idrotts- eller föreningslivet. Berätta gärna vilken aktivitet du utövat, hur den har format dig som person och hur du tror att det påverkar dig i din yrkesroll.

Övrigt

Plats: Stockholm Omfattning: heltid och tillsvidare Start: enligt överenskommelse Körkort är ett krav. PerformIQ – rekrytering av personal med egenskaper från idrott/föreningsliv, är vår samarbetspartner och vi hänvisar eventuella frågor om tjänsten till Rekryteringskonsult Mattias Söderberg på telefonnummer 072-157 27 76 eller mattias.soderberg@performiq.se Skicka in din ansökan redan idag då intervjuer sker löpande. title: Suuhygienisti, Suun terveydenhuolto, Kaarina
description:
Meillä Varhalla pääset osaksi mukavaa ja kehittymismyönteistä työyhteisöä, jossa arvostamme osaamistasi ja tuemme ammatillista kasvuasi. Tule mukaan!

Tehtäväsi

Suuhygienistinä työskentelet itsenäisesti suun terveyden edistämisen ja hoidon parissa. Toimit oman alasi asiantuntijana ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä suun terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten sekä muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämistä ja opiskelijoiden käytännön harjoittelun ohjaamista.

Pääasiallinen työpisteesi sijaitsee Kaarinan suun terveydenhuollossa, mutta työskentelet tarvittaessa myös Varhan muilla vastaanotoilla. Halutessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä työskentelemään myös liikkuvissa palveluissamme, mikä tuo mukavaa vaihtelua ja monipuolisuutta työhösi.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Meillä pääset osaksi energistä ja toimintaansa aktiivisesti kehittävää moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Varhan suun terveydenhuollossa työskentelee yli 700 alan ammattilaista, joten ympärilläsi on laaja joukko osaavia kollegoita, joiden kanssa voit jakaa kokemuksia ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.

Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kollegoiden ja esihenkilöiden jatkuvan tuen. Pääset hyödyntämään omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja osallistumaan myös toimintamme kehittämiseen. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi, voit hyvin ja saat mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokenut suuhygienisti. Tärkeintä meille on, että suhtaudut työhösi innostuneesti ja haluat olla mukana tarjoamassa potilaillemme mahdollisimman hyvää hoitoa.

Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, joustavaa työskentelyotetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Monipuolinen kokemus suuhygienistin työstä tukee tehtävässä onnistumista, mutta ennen kaikkea toivomme sinulta sitoutumista työhösi, oma-aloitteisuutta ja myönteistä suhtautumista yhteiseen tekemiseen.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen laillistus (suuhygienisti AMK tai aikaisempi vastaava tutkinto).

Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme hyvää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kehittyvään työyhteisöömme! Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Leipuri osa-aikainen
description:
Haemme leipureita helmikuussa avattavaan K-Citymarket Porvoon uuteen leipomoon.

Leipomo Juuri on myymäläleipomoihin erikoistunut yritys, jolla on leipomot Riihimäellä, Hyvinkäällä, Keravalla, Tampereella, Salossa, Espoossa, Vantaalla, Helsingissä, Kirkkonummella, Porissa, Oulussa, Naantalissa, Turussa, Mäntsälässä, Lahdessa, Nokialla, Valkeakoskella sekä Kuopiossa ja ensi vuoden alussa myös Forssassa ja Porvoossa. Valmistamme laadukkaat juureen leivotut artesaanileivät sekä herkulliset kahvileivät käsityönä. Haluamme olla Suomen ykkösleipomo niin työnantajana, yhteistyökumppanina, kuin asiakkaille tuotteiltamme.

Etsimme nyt Porvoon leipomoomme osa-aikaisia leipureita. Leipurinamme pääset tekemään korkealaatuisia tuotteita alusta loppuun, aina taikinasta esille laittoon asti.

Edellytämme leipurin koulutusta ja hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Saat meiltä kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään.

Leipomon työvuorot sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti ma-su klo 5:00-18:00.

Työaika: osa-aikainen 0 - 64h/kk.

Työ alkaa helmikuussa 2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Työssä työskennellään pääosin tiiminä, välillä työ vaatii yksinoloa. Odotamme sinulta kykyä toimia itsenäisesti sekä kantaa vastuu omista tehtävistäsi. Tueksesi saat erinomaiset kollegat ja hyvän perehdytyksen leipomomme toimintaan. Meillä tärkeintä on hyvä asenne.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi 22.11.2026 mennessä sivuillamme olevalla lomakkeella tai sähköpostilla rekry@leipomojuuri.fi.

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, joten haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian. Tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Government Affairs and Public Policy Manager
description:
As a Public Policy Manager for Platforms & Devices (P&D) External Engagement EMEA, you will play a leading role in shaping Google’s external advocacy and public policy positions for Android, Google Play, Chrome, and emerging hardware and computing platforms. You will be focused on developing proactive policy positions, representing Google directly before external stakeholders, and conceptualizing and executing creative, high-impact external campaigns. You will act as a primary interface between Google’s product teams and external key opinion formers, including EU and national policymakers, industry coalitions, civil society groups, and digital safety advocates. You will collaborate closely with Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) colleagues across EMEA, as well as an extensive cross-functional work spanning Communications, Marketing, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Trust and Safety.
Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Poland: zł364000 - zł373000 (PLN) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Formulate and drive proactive public policy positions and external engagement strategies for P& D across EMEA, aligning regional initiatives with global product goals.
  • Represent Google externally in bilateral meetings, policy roundtables, parliamentary hearings, industry association working groups, and public thought leadership forums.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement on digital responsibility and safety files, building constructive dialogues with youth safety advocates, child protection organizations, online security experts, and public authorities.
  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert for EMEA on the public policy environment affecting platform governance, child protection, age assurance, content policy, and mobile security, while partnering cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure consistent, forward-leaning 'One Google' positioning across legislative files and public moments.
  • Provide project oversight and strategic direction on major external engagement milestones.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in policy analysis and campaigns, working on technology issues or the policy environments that surround them.
  • 7 years of experience working within government, think tanks, public interest groups, technology industry groups, or corporate public policy organizations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Demonstrated understanding of European and national digital policy frameworks and policymaking processes.
  • Knowledge of or direct professional experience in public policy issues relating to youth safety, child online protection, content policy, and online safety/security.
  • Exceptional verbal and written advocacy skills, with the ability to distill complex technical and platform architectures into persuasive, accessible narratives.
  • Proven track record of building and managing coalitions or multi-stakeholder initiatives that successfully influence public debates.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership capability, with experience guiding complex policy campaigns andor working with marketing, communications and brand teams on creative policy campaigns.

title: Technical Product Lead
description:
At Whitbread, we're investing in the future of data and analytics to help drive smarter decisions, operational excellence and business performance. We're looking for a Technical Product Lead to join our Data & Analytics team and play a pivotal role in shaping and evolving the data products that support teams across the business.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a commercially minded data professional who can bridge the gap between business needs and technical delivery, ensuring our data products deliver measurable value, support compliance and help stakeholders make better decisions faster

Role: Technical Product Lead
Contract Type: Full time, Permanent
Location: Whitbread Court, Dunstable
Level: 4

What you’ll be doing:
As a Technical Product Lead, you'll support the development and operation of data products that enable teams across Whitbread to make data-driven decisions that improve efficiency, compliance and performance. Working closely with senior stakeholders, Heads of Department and delivery teams, you'll help define data strategies, identify opportunities for improvement and build product roadmaps that align with both business and data priorities.
You'll drive the adoption and effectiveness of data products by ensuring they continue to evolve in line with stakeholder needs, while identifying opportunities to improve data quality, reporting accuracy and business outcomes.
You'll collaborate with colleagues across Data & Analytics, including Data Science, Engineering and BI teams, championing best practice and helping maximise value from shared tools such as Power BI and Databricks. You'll also provide technical leadership, coaching and support to engineers and developers where required, helping build capability across the wider team.
What you’ll need:

Strong project management and programme management prioritisation capabilities.
Experience coordinating and delivering technical projects/programmes.
Strong stakeholder management experience.
Ability to develop business cases, identify opportunities and translate complex concepts into compelling data-driven recommendations.
Experience managing backlogs and delivering priorities through agile ways of working.
Experience designing and operating impactful data products

Be part of our Technology Team at Whitbread

Through collaboration, passion and hiring the smartest minds, our Technology team builds products and services that are used by 38,000 of us at Whitbread and millions of guests. Everything from an eCommerce website that handles £2 billion in transactions per year, applications that are scalable across our 1,200 hotel and restaurants, devices that enable our teams and guests to have a seamless experience, all whilst keeping data secure. Together we’re building the hotel of the future.

title: Service Manager - Learning Disabilities - Supported Living
description:
An exciting opportunity for a full-time role as Service Manager is available to oversee a number of Supported Living Services with Milestones Trust.
We’re looking for a driven and proactive person to lead, manage and inspire a team of Service Coordinators and Personal Assistants who will provide support to people across Bristol and South Gloucestershire, living in a mix of independent and shared settings.
Every person we support, and their service, is unique and we aim to work collaboratively with people to develop strategies to manage as much of their lives as possible by:

Supporting with life skills to become as independent as possible
To make the most of opportunities to have meaningful roles and relationships
To live their best lives

Previous experience of service management is desirable and the expectation you will be successful in a CQC registration in due course.
You’ll be responsible for all aspects of your services, involved in assessment of prospective tenants, working with key stakeholders including local authorities, social work teams and primary and secondary healthcare teams in addition to building and fostering excellent relationships internally across Milestones Trust whilst achieving key objectives and financial stability for each service.
You will also lead your team to ensure all support plans, risk assessments and records are regularly reviewed and relevant, as well as leading team and 1:1 meetings with your staff.
The successful Service Manager will:

Be able to role model a person-centred approach to support, putting the people living in your services at the centre of what you do, focusing on successfully achieving agreed outcomes.
Be able to inspire and lead a team, demonstrating excellent people-management skills together with enthusiasm and dedication.
Be able to manage budgets and strategic priorities effectively, ensuring all key objectives are met.
Be able to work innovatively to find bespoke solutions where necessary whilst ensuring standards met are those expected within a CQC regulated environment.
Be passionate about citizen rights, inclusion and community, with an understanding of the Mental Capacity Act, Safeguarding Adults, and other relevant legislation.
Be an excellent communicator, confident liaising with families, professionals and other agencies involved in peoples' lives.

Here at Milestones Trust, we recognise that without the hard work, commitment and passion of our staff, we wouldn’t be the charity we are today. That’s why we are committed to rewarding you with a competitive pay and benefits package:

34 days’ annual leave, including recognised public holidays

title: Vikariat Lärare i Sv/SvA och Eng
description:
Burlöv är en spännande kommun i tillväxtregionen mellan Malmö och Lund. Vi har en nära organisationskultur som möjliggör och betonar samarbete, innovation och ett hållbart arbetsliv. Tillsammans utvecklar vi verksamheten och skapar värde för våra medborgare. 

Vill du vara med och bygga det attraktiva, tillgängliga, hållbara och trygga Burlöv? 

Burlöv är en utbildningskommun där vi med kreativitet och glädje för lärandet skapar goda förutsättningar för framtiden. 

Vi har ett nära samarbete med sverigeledande forskare gällande undervisningsutveckling i både förskola, grundskola och vuxenutbildning.

Vi är modiga och testar nya innovativa idéer såsom VR i undervisningen. Vi tänker rörelse vid både nybyggnation, utveckling av utemiljöer och erbjuder rörelseanalys till vår personal.

Vi genomför tidiga insatser tillsammans med socialtjänst och har ett gemensamt mobilt team för att hjälpa elever med problematisk frånvaro.

Vi följer upp måluppfyllelsen på riktigt och agerar på våra resultat.

Vi arbetar för att bli duktiga på det tillitsbaserade ledarskapet och har ett nära ledarskap med få medarbetare per chef.

Åkarp har fem skolenheter i F-9.Dalslundskolan 7-9 är en av skolenheterna och har 260 elever fördelat på tio klasser.  Vi är 30 engagerade medarbetare på skolan.

Skolans vision är att samtliga elever att vi strävar efter utvecklar goda kunskaper och att undervisningen ska vara av god kvalité och variation.           Skola ska vara trygg för samtliga elever och lärare med respekt mot andra människor. 

Vi har även ett ständigt pågående utvecklingsarbete för att säkerställa god kvalité på undervisningen.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vi söker en lärare i svenska/svenska som andraspråk och engelska.

Undervisningen är på 7-9 och ska ansvara för svenska och engelska. Du ingår i ett ämneslag som genomför utvärderingar och uppföljningar tillsammans. Ämneslaget även inspirerar och delger varandra planeringar och lektionsinnehåll. 

I samtalsgrupper resonerar vi kring lektionsupplägg och undervisningshandlingar och hur vi kan förändra och förbättra undervisningen. Grunden för vår undervisning utgår från elevaktiva arbetssätt och att använda eleverna som lärresuser till varandra.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Du är legitimerad lärare med bred kompetens. Du är flexibel och har lätt för att samarbeta med dina närmsta kollegor och andra yrkeskategorier. Du är lösningsfokuserad och bidrar i verksamheten med ett salutogent perspektiv. Du ser varje situation tillsammans med barnet som en unik möjlighet till lärande. Du arbetar lågaffektivt och uppvisar tålamod i olika situationer. 

Du ska ha lätt för att skapa relationer och gilla att arbeta i team.

Vi behöver dig som är beredd att satsa helhjärtat på barnen/eleverna och är flexibel och lyhörd för både barn och föräldrar. Du bör kunna använda ett lösningsfokuserat arbetssätt och ha förmåga att locka fram elevernas och föräldrarnas tillit.

Den psykosociala arbetsmiljön skall bygga på öppenhet, samarbete och nyfikenhet.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-03-01, upphör: 2028-03-01  .

Burlövs kommun ser mångfald som en styrka i vårt gemensamma uppdrag. 

Vi erbjuder utvecklingsorienterade arbetsplatser som kännetecknas av trivsel och arbetsglädje. Våra medarbetare är engagerade och i högsta grad delaktiga i att steg för steg realisera kommunens mål och uppdrag utifrån vår värdegrund. 

Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. 

Enligt skollagen krävs uppvisande av utdrag ur polisens misstanke- och belastningsregister vid anställning inom förskola, skola och skolbarnomsorg. Blankett för att beställa utdraget finns på: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/

Observera att den normala handläggningstiden hos polisen är cirka två veckor. Har du inget aktuellt utdrag så beställ gärna utdraget i samband med att du söker tjänsten.

title: Technical Solutions Engineer Associate II, Infrastructure, Networking, Google Cloud
description:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

Our Technical Solutions Engineers own our large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to our other support teams. You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud.

In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make our products easier to adopt and use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Our Technical Solutions team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for our customers’ issues.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Poland: zł176000 - zł180000 (PLN) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Work as part of a team of engineers/consultants that globally ensure 24 hour customer support. This will include a need to sometimes work non-standard hours/shifts, and may include weekends as needed.
  • Manage the customer’s problem through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
  • Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in Engineering, Sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of Google Cloud networking technologies, including internal implementation details.
  • Improve the supportability of Google Cloud networking technologies by working with product engineering teams. Collaboration includes working with product engineering teams on product launches and to help product teams understand customer issues to improve existing products.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).

title: NASAB - Payment Settlement Specialist
description:
NASAB - Payment Settlement Specialist
Position Summary:
This position is primarily responsible for the monitoring and operation of the Payment Program. The incumbent performs activities associated with the processing of outgoing wires and checks (USD and FX) for MUSA, MSI, MCM, MSD, MUSAF and Canada. Interacts with FSCA/P providing “Proposals” and “Payment Runs” throughout the day. Responsibilities also include operation of CitiDirect for wire transfer data entry and analysis and the extraction program for the preparation of the daily outgoing Citibank and Toronto Dominion file of “wires and checks”. Creates outgoing ACH files to Citibank. Monitors incoming yen and communicates such with Business Departments. Interacts with NYCAF to insure proper coordination and use of FX contracts. When there are discrepancies researches and resolves the problem. Keeps records and compiles metrics. Complies with departmental record retention guidelines. Works under general supervision.
Position will also serve as back up to Margin Settlement team when the coordinator is on PTO or unavailable to fulfill their responsibility.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

Generates payment requests / proposal (USD, non-USD).
Resolves discrepancies in payment proposals.
Enters manual payments (CitiDirect) for payment authorization by PS manager.
Liaisons with FX desk on non-USD payments to determine if FX contract is in place.
Liaisons with bank to send payment instructions, receive confirmation of conversion rate, arrange transfer of FX currency.
Posts payment details and executes extraction program in SAP R/3.
Liaisons with banks over errors in wire transfers, resolves discrepancies and conducts bank accounts reconciliation.
Monitors outgoing file of checks and wires to Citibank and Toronto Dominion Bank.
Monitors outgoing funds in cash position.
Obtains payment authorization from Business Departments.
Liaisons with appropriate individuals in cash management, trade finance, treasury and other areas as required to resolve cash discrepancies and void checks.
Voids vendor checks.
Runs reports related to Payment Program.
Processes special tax payments (ACH).
Manages incoming foreign currency receipts.
Train and learn margin settlement work to support operations
Assist margin settlement manager is areas required
Understand margin settlement process and serve as liaison with brokerage firms to settle commission payments.

Required Skills/Competencies:
Knowledge Areas:

AP/AR accounting principles and banking knowledge.
Accounting related to bank accounts and cash management,
Administration for Checks, Bank accounts, Bank master record requirements.
Procedural and documentation requirements of Mitsui USA's bank accounts.
Paying and receiving administration, including Foreign currency payment/receipt.
Discrepancy resolution, Inquiry resolution, Problem-solving skills.

Technical / Communication Skills:

SAP R/3 TR-CM modules.
CitiDirect and other bank software.
Intermediate PC application skills (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint)
Communicate effectively within the TSC, with other business departments and external parties.

Experience:

1-3 years experience or a combination of training and experience that indicates the ability to do the job.
Experience with cash management.
Experience with reporting requirements.
Experience with Mitsui USA’s banking arrangements, banking structure and requirements.
Banking structure and G/L accounting experience.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Develop, implement, and lead strategies to enforce YouTube policies at scale, providing data-driven insights for effective abuse prevention using machine learning.

Om oss A-Assistans Leimir AB är ett privat företag som anordnar personlig assistans till assistansberättigade i hela landet. Semesterersättning, OB-ersättning och andra lönetillägg tillkommer enligt avtal.

title: Employment Specialist - Maryland DDA Employment Service
description:
Benefits:

  • Bonus based on performance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
  • Training & development
Helpful Hearts Health Services
Location: Columbia, MD and Multiple Locations
Employment Type: Full Time

Helpful Hearts Health Services Inc. is a Maryland Developmental Disabilities Administration (DDA) provider seeking an experienced Employment Specialist to help adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities explore careers, secure paid jobs in their communities, and succeed at work.

You’ll work directly with participants to identify their strengths, interests, and employment goals. You’ll also build relationships with local employers, develop job opportunities that match each person’s goals, and provide individualized coaching and follow-up to help participants build independence and stay employed.

Position Overview
The Employment Specialist will help participants identify their strengths, interests, skills, and support needs and develop individualized pathways to competitive integrated employment. Assigned services may include Discovery, Job Development, Ongoing Job Supports, Follow-Along Supports, Co-Worker Supports, and Self-Employment Development Supports.

Key Responsibilities
Employment Planning and Discovery
  • Identify participants’ interests, abilities, experiences, communication preferences, and employment goals.
  • Conduct authorized Discovery activities and develop vocational profiles and individualized employment plans.
  • Arrange career exploration opportunities, employer conversations, and workplace visits.
  • Support participants in making informed choices and advocating for their employment preferences.
Job Development and Employer Relationships
  • Build partnerships with local businesses and identify employment opportunities that match participants’ strengths and goals.
  • Assist with résumés, applications, interview preparation, and hiring paperwork.
  • Work with employers to explore customized job duties, workplace accommodations, and effective support arrangements.
  • Promote inclusive hiring while protecting participant privacy and confidentiality.
Job Coaching and Retention
  • Provide individualized job coaching and instruction in authorized settings.
  • Break job duties into manageable steps and use teaching strategies that build independence.
  • Support workplace communication, time management, problem-solving, and professional skills.
  • Assist with transportation planning and travel training when appropriate.
  • Develop natural workplace supports and reduce paid coaching as appropriate to each participant’s needs.
  • Address workplace concerns and provide follow-up to support job retention and career advancement.
Documentation and Compliance
  • Complete accurate, timely service notes, assessments, vocational profiles, required deliverables, and progress reports.
  • Document services provided, participant progress, support strategies, and employment outcomes.
  • Track job placements, wages, hours worked, and job retention.
  • Deliver services within approved authorizations and staff qualifications.
  • Follow participant-specific plans, health and safety procedures, incident reporting requirements, and agency policies.
  • Protect participant rights, dignity, choice, and confidential information.
Collaboration
  • Coordinate with participants, families or authorized representatives, Coordinators of Community Services, employers, and agency staff.
  • Collaborate with the Division of Rehabilitation Services and other employment resources as appropriate.
  • Participate in planning meetings, supervision, required training, and quality improvement activities.
Required Qualifications
  • At least 21 years old.
  • At least three years of experience in employment services; three to five years of relevant experience is sought, including job development, job coaching, supported employment, or customized employment.
  • Must have up-to-date ACRE training and current Certified Employment Support Professional (CESP) certification are required.
  • Successfully complete required criminal background investigations, other applicable screenings, and credential verification.
  • Maintain current CPR and First Aid certification.
  • Complete required DDA orientation and training.
  • Complete participant-specific training needed to implement each person’s PCP and safely meet their support needs before implementing job services.
  • Hold a valid driver’s license with appropriate insurance coverage for vehicles used.
  • Demonstrate strong communication, organization, documentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Work independently in community settings and manage multiple participant schedules and priorities.
  • Use computer systems for documentation, scheduling, and communication.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to person-centered services, informed choice, inclusion, and participant independence.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience providing employment services to adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
  • Familiarity with Maryland DDA services, PCPs, service authorizations, and documentation requirements.
  • Experience conducting Discovery and developing customized employment opportunities.
  • Established relationships with local employers and community workforce resources.
  • Relevant education in human services, rehabilitation, psychology, education, or a related field.
Work Environment
Work takes place at community businesses, participant job sites, agency locations, and other authorized settings. Local travel is required, and schedules may vary to meet participants’ work schedules and support needs.
Helpful Hearts Health Services is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

Experience:
  • Job coaching/employment : 3 years (Required)
License/Certification:
  • ACRE training and CESP certification? (Required)
Work Location: In person

Benefits

  • Paid holidays
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan
  • Professional development and training
  • Supportive, mission-driven work environment

title: Emulation Operations Engineer
description:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As an Emulation Operations Engineer, you will help maintain and improve existing systems, while helping develop next-generation solutions for future projects. You will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and optimal performance of our emulation lab, which involves managing and maintaining the lab's IT infrastructure, but also implementing optimal “cloud to lab” data transfer mechanisms, continuous integration flows, schedulers and dashboards. You will help drive efficiencies and resilience by adopting novel techniques, in part driven by AI tooling.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving channel behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Design, implement, maintain and automate the IT infrastructure for the emulation lab, including servers, storage, networking equipment, and workstations.
  • Explore and implement novel emulation workflows and methodologies including data transfer, schedulers and automated end-to-end regression flows.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and monitor production distributed computing infrastructure, troubleshooting advanced technical issues within a Linux environment.
  • Manage relationships with vendors for hardware, software, and support agreements.
  • Automate systems management with code.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience with emulation CAD operations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • 6 years of experience with emulation CAD operations.
  • Experience in IT infrastructure management and Cloud systems design (including VMs), preferably in an emulation lab or high-performance computing environment.
  • Experience writing code (e.g., Python, Bash) to automate monitoring and data analysis.
  • Proficiency with batch job schedulers such as Slurm, LSF, or PBS.
  • Knowledge of Emulation/Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) compilation and runtime flows.

title: Price Analyst
location: Northampton, Northamptonshire, England; London, Greater London, England
description:
Better places, thriving communities.


Job Overview

The Price Management team are the custodians of all knowledge around price for our customers. They support teams with accurate pricing records and projections, keeping systems up to date to underpin financial reporting and customer budgets. This position will be responsible for the management of key customers and their complex flexibly energy supply contracts.

As part of this role, you will seek to understand all tariff charges across power, gas and water commodities, understanding their impact on billing and our customers, and ensure our Energy system is updated to reflect the charges accurately. You will drive continual improvement across the team and strive for exceptional customer service through the highest standard of service delivery.

Role Responsibilities

  • Prepare and deliver customer energy budgets and forecasts, ensuring accuracy and supporting customer queries.
  • Act as the lead on pricing matters for the Energy team and customers across all utilities, covering non-commodity charges, industry charges, supplier tariffs and reconciliations.
  • Analyse complex financial models for customers and provide actionable insights to both internal and external teams
  • Interpret both flexible and fixed price contracts within our internal systems making sure that all systems are fully aligned
  • Improve the efficiency and governance of analytical outputs by developing and enhancing models, including algorithms in Python and other systems.
  • Work with the trading desk to analyse risk management performance and deliver hedging reviews, volume tolerance analysis and other reports as required.
  • Work closely with the Invoice Management team to understand and manage supplier outputs, coordinating tariff receipt and updates to avoid disruption to billing schedules.
  • Support allocated customers with energy accruals reporting, shape fee analysis and RO certificate management, responding to related energy-cost queries.
  • Manage all PPA price analysis for our customers including generators.
  • Work closely with the research team to maintain awareness of changes in the energy market that will impact billing and forecasting.
  • Any other duty which reasonably falls within the scope of this role

What we're looking for

  • Proven background in working in an energy services team with strong knowledge in at least two of the commodities across power, gas, and water
  • Experience analysing large data sets and complex customer financial models to produce actionable insights, with an appreciation of data visualisation.
  • Strong knowledge of non-commodity charges and their impact on customer energy costs. Including tariff structures, industry regulation and reconciliations, alongside an understanding of fixed and flexible supply contracts and PPA price analysis.
  • Proven ability to use Excel and other data analytic tools to analyse data and support financial reporting.
  • Strong quantitative, writing, communication, and analytical skills
  • Programming experience in Python and SQL desirable
  • Experience in energy budgeting and forecasting, alongside knowledge of energy accruals reporting would be desirable
  • An organised, accurate approach with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure, meet tight deadlines and adapt to a dynamic environment.
  • Self-motivated and self-reliant, with the ability to manage time and prioritise multiple tasks.
