title: KEN - Programs - WASH Officer
description:
Position: WASH Officer – Engineer
Reports to: Roving WASH Manager
Location: Samburu
Level: BG 6
Last updated: November 2024

Summary of position

The WASH officer shall take charge of technical aspects of Emergency WASH and Community based water supply system and Hygiene promotion on behalf of the program under the supervision of the Roving WASH Manager for Isiolo and Samburu Projects. His/her main roles and in consultation with the WASH HOD and the county government technical teams shall include designing, planning, implementation, (technical oversights), monitoring and evaluation of high quality, innovative WASH projects.

Purpose:
The WASH officer shall be responsible for the daily implementation, monitoring, and regular consultation with program partners on WASH program components. Ensure linkage, synergies and complementarity with other sectorial interventions, i.e. Nutrition, Food security and livelihood as well as proper coordination, consultation and information sharing with partner’s communities and other stakeholders.

Engagement:
Represent Action Against Hunger in all coordination forums at county and sub county level, collaborate with other implementing partners, INGO, UN bodies and the local communities to ensure successful implementation and smooth running of the projects

Delivery:

Successful implementation of WASH interventions in target areas in line with internationally/Nationally accepted standards and ACFs /national technical guidelines as well as the donor requirements.

II Essential job functions

WASH project implementation and management (50%)

Identify and conduct technical assessments of feasible water sources at the community level.
Work in Partnership with government line ministries (county department of water) to prepare technical designs of feasible water supply projects.
Ensure the construction of water systems (groundwater or surface water), protection, abstraction, storage, treatment, and distribution for new systems or rehabilitation of existing systems as well as the construction of the most appropriate form of sanitation systems, in consultation with the beneficiaries and line ministries.
Prepare bidding documents, materials and technical work specifications.
Regular monitoring of ongoing WASH construction activities to ensure all the activities are as per the design, specifications and work schedule and also Verify the work done at site and recommend for payments to contractors.
Ensure integration of Water, sanitation and hygiene promotion components of projects
Capacity Building and strengthening of water management committees and linking with private sector service providers for post construction support.
Ensure that procurement is timely initiated, monitored and prioritized by the logistics team.
Support water quality testing and monitoring at communal water points and household level and recommend remedial

Support implementation of sanitation and hygiene promotion activities (25%)

In collaboration with the MEAL team and WASH Head of Department, conduct quantitative and qualitative assessments to identify priority hygiene behaviours, sanitation needs and progress against project indicators.
Coordinate with the WASH Manager, MEAL team and county public health teams to plan and conduct baseline assessments, Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices (KAP) surveys and follow-up assessments, and use findings to inform implementation.
Work with county and sub-county public health teams to implement hygiene and sanitation activities within approved budgets, timelines and technical standards.
Plan and facilitate community mobilization and behaviour change activities, including CLTS pre-triggering, triggering and post-triggering follow-up.
Provide technical guidance to communities on constructing, using and maintaining appropriate household latrines and handwashing facilities, considering local conditions, accessibility and available materials.
Support communities, natural leaders and public health teams to achieve and sustain Open Defecation Free (ODF) status, including supporting verification and post-ODF follow-up.
Organize hygiene item distributions, demonstrate correct use and coordinate post-distribution monitoring to assess appropriateness, usage and beneficiary feedback.

Reporting and Program Development. (15%)

Compile program reports on a timely basis in liaison with other program staff; Weekly SitRep, Monthly (statistical and narrative), Quarterly and annual donor reports
Maintain full qualitative and quantitative records and reports of activities, disaggregated by age, gender where appropriate
In collaboration with the Roving WASH Manager, HOD WASH prepare progress reports, quarterly and final donor reports, project procurement plan and contributes to survey reports.
In liaison with the program manager develop project proposal to address County specific gaps
In liaison with the County MOH/MOW and other partners, develop joint work plans for key activities as stipulated in the project document.
Support MOH focal persons on information, data management and reporting through the KHIS and CLTS HUB
Participate in the planning, organizing and implementation of surveys, assessments and research studies including post distribution monitoring

Information exchange, Coordination and cooperation with Action Against Hunger interventions and stakeholders (5%)

Collaborate with all other Action Against Hunger departments and sectors to ensure the projects are integrated.
Coordination with other Partners, Department of water, INGOs, NGOs, CBOs, communities, local leaders and the UN working in this area to ensure smooth running of projects.
Represent Action Against Hunger in internal and external coordination meetings and any other forum
Document key lessons learnt to inform future project design.

Branding, Communication and Visibility 5%

Ensure all project activities at community level are well branded with Action Against Hunger and donor visibility as per the project visibility and communication guidelines.
Ensure capturing of quality images/photos and videos for activities at the community and share with the project team and communications officer.
Document key lessons learnt to inform future project design
In collaboration with Communication department, support documentation of success stories and community voices

Supervisory Responsibilities

Supervise Interns in the Base

Fiscal Responsibility

Prepare cash forecast in liaison with the other program staff in line with the work plans
Ensure the expenditure is as stipulated in the budget lines and strict adherence to the budget limits
Propose anticipated budget realignment in discussion with program manager
In liaison with the Program Manager Monitor budget spending in line with spending plan; ensure diligence in grants utilization including timely spending and value for money.
Support the Program manager in monthly budget reviews and suggesting amendments to Finance

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to sit for long periods and to concentrate on work, including typing, and turn out heavy volumes of work accurately, within short time frames under stressful situations in the context of a moderately noisy office with many interruptions. Must be able to proofread own work accurately so that only minor corrections are needed on an infrequent basis.
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Working Conditions, Travel and Environment

The duties of the job require regular job attendance for five days per week with eight hours per day. Must be available to work outside normal office hours or on the weekends as required.
Must be able to travel as required for standard domestic based on the office needs. While visiting the field, the employee may be exposed to precarious settings under high security risks and/or very basic living conditions and outside weather conditions, as well is to infectious diseases.

Gender Equality Commitments & Zero Tolerance to Abuse

At all times, Action against Hunger commits to:

Foster an environment that reinforces values of people of all genders equal access to information.
Provide a work environment where people of all genders can be evaluated and promoted based on their skills and performance.

Respect beneficiaries’ women, men, children (boys and girls) regardless of gender, sex orientation, disability, religion, race, color, ancestry, national origin, age, or marital status.
Value and respect all cultures

Experience from both private and INGO sectors is an advantage.
Knowledge of main donor requirements including UNICEF, ECHO, EU,USAID,OCHA donors

3 years’ experience in a similar position.

Proven ability to work in a team and proven skills in capacity building and community development (including community participation)
Good level of spoken and written English and Kiswahili.
Ability to work under minimal supervision and have impact on input on program indicators
Demonstrate capacity in constructively engaging local authorities and local partners.
Excellent organization, coordination, report writing skills

Team player and Keen to details

title: Aviation Technical Writer - Dangerous Goods
description:
The Technical Writer develops, maintains and controls the Dangerous Goods Manual and associated compliance documentation to ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and operational practices. The Technical Writer authors, reviews and revises Dangerous Goods procedures, instructions and supporting documentation to ensure content remains accurate, standardised, auditable and suitable for operational use across the organisation Job Duties: • Accuracy, consistency and usability of Dangerous Goods documentation. • Ensure Dangerous Goods manual and procedures remain aligned with applicable ICAO Technical Instructions, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations and the UAE GCAA requirements. • Implement Safety Management System processes and promote a positive reporting culture by identifying and reporting safety risks, unsafe conditions and procedural deficiencies. • Comply with the requirements contained within the Safety and Compliance Monitoring Manual and participate in compliance and safety initiatives. Maintain document control standards including revision status, amendment tracking and records retention. • Coordinate with subject matter experts to obtain technical and operational information required for documentation development. • Author, revise and maintain Dangerous Goods manual, procedures, forms and guidance material. • Recommend amendments to existing procedures where operational, regulatory or compliance gaps are identified. • Escalate conflicting, unclear or incomplete regulatory or procedural requirements for management determination. Participate in document review activities with operational stakeholders and compliance personnel • Develop, review and maintain the Dangerous Goods Manual and associated compliance documentation. • Translate regulatory requirements into clear operational procedures and work instructions. • Ensure documentation reflects approved operational practices and current regulatory requirements. • Maintain consistency of document structure, numbering, formatting and cross-referencing. • Support document review, approval and publication processes. • Coordinate with Cargo, Ground Operations, Flight Operations and other stakeholders to capture and validate technical content. • Monitor changes to GCAA CAR PART VI, ICAO Technical Instructions, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations and applicable national regulations and incorporate required amendments.

• Knowledge of Dangerous Goods regulations including ICAO Technical Instructions and IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations. • Minimum 3 years' experience producing technical documentation within aviation, logistics or other regulated industries. Previous Dangerous Goods or aviation compliance experience preferred. • Knowledge of aviation compliance and document control principles. • Familiarity with operational manuals and regulated documentation systems. • Technical writing and document development skills. • Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and convert them into operational procedures. • Strong attention to detail and document control practices. • High standard of computer literacy including Microsoft Office applications.

title: Corona Campus Administrator
description:
Patria Church is looking for a detail-oriented Campus Administrator to help build the administrative systems and structure our Corona campus needs to run smoothly.

You'll establish scheduling, documentation, and day-to-day operational processes for the campus, working closely with the Campus Pastor to make sure every process runs with excellence and care.

If you love building structure from the ground up, thrive on creating systems where none exist yet, and want your work to support a growing, mission-driven organization, we'd love to hear from you.


What You'll Do

  • Build and implement administrative procedures and systems that bring consistency and structure to campus operations
  • Help plan and support weekend services, special events, and community outreach efforts that connect people to Patria Church
  • Establish organized filing, documentation, and record-keeping systems from the ground up
  • Coordinate with ministry leaders, volunteers, and departments to bring structure to day-to-day workflows
  • Support budget tracking, requisitions, and expense processes with accuracy
  • Serve as the go-to point of contact for congregants, visitors, vendors, and partners


What You'll Bring

  • Associate's degree in administration, business, or a related field preferred (equivalent experience welcome)
  • Experience building or improving operational systems, administrative workflows, or campus-based environments
  • A builder's mindset, comfortable creating structure and processes where they don't yet fully exist
  • A sharp eye for detail and solid follow-through
  • Nonprofit, ministry, or church experience is a plus, not required

Why Patria

You'll join a Corona-based campus team that genuinely cares about doing good work for a good reason. Supporting a faith-based community focused on strengthening families throughout our city. It's a close-knit team where your organization and follow-through directly help our campus.

We're looking for someone who shares that heart along with the skills to back it up.

title: Vårdcentralen Snabbdoktor söker allmänspecialist
description:
Vårdcentralen Snabbdoktor Eskilstuna öppnade sin första vårdcentral den 21 november 2022.

Vi är belägna i nybyggda och moderna lokaler i K43 i Eskilstuna. Snabbdoktor är en privatägd vårdcentral med ett starkt fokus på kvalitet och tillgänglighet.

Idag har vi närmare 6 000 listade patienter och verksamheten fortsätter att växa i stadig takt.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi söker nu en specialist i allmänmedicin som vill vara med och utveckla Eskilstunas modernaste vårdcentral tillsammans med oss. Hos oss finns goda möjligheter till professionell utveckling, inflytande över arbetet och eget ansvar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som specialist i allmänmedicin arbetar du med sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter inom primärvård, såsom mottagningsarbete, patientbedömningar, diagnostik och behandling.

Du följer upp patienter med både akuta och kroniska besvär samt bidrar till en trygg och kvalitativ vård.

Rollen innebär även samarbete med övriga professioner och möjlighet att vara delaktig i verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling.


Kvalifikationer

  • Legitimerad läkare med specialistkompetens i allmänmedicin
  • Erfarenhet av arbete inom primärvård
  • Goda kunskaper i journalsystemet Cosmic
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av digital patientkontakt
  • Erfarenhet av arbete i multiprofessionella team
  • Erfarenhet av handledning av AT- eller ST-läkare
  • Intresse för eller erfarenhet av kvalitets- och förbättringsarbete
  • Erfarenhet av arbete med kroniska sjukdomar och långsiktig patientuppföljning
  • Språkkunskaper utöver svenska och engelska


Personliga egenskaper

Vårdcentralen Snabbdoktor Eskilstuna är en verksamhet där olika professioner arbetar nära varandra med en gemensam målbild och ett starkt patientfokus.

Vi söker dig som är lyhörd, samarbetsorienterad och initiativtagande i ditt arbete.

Sedan starten har vårdcentralen haft en snabb och stabil utveckling och är idag en växande verksamhet med tydligt fokus på kvalitet, långsiktighet och en god arbetsmiljö.

Vi värdesätter ditt engagemang och ser gärna att du bidrar med idéer och förbättringsförslag som skapar mervärde för både patienter och kollegor.

Förmåner

  • Vi tar hand om dig genom tjänstepension och trygga försäkringar
  • 5 000 SEK i friskvårdsbidrag per år – för hälsa, energi och återhämtning
  • Möjlighet att växa professionellt genom kompetensutveckling
  • Tillgång till vårt nya gym – en möjlighet att prioritera din egen hälsa mitt i arbetsdagen


Rekrytering sker löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt kontakt från annons- och rekryteringsföretag i denna rekrytering.

title: Software Engineer, Android System UI, Laptops and Tablets
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google software and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

  • Design, develop, and maintain core Android System UI components and framework integrations in Kotlin and Java (including Jetpack Compose) for large-screen laptop and tablet form factors.
  • Build and polish desktop-class system UI surfaces such as the lockscreen (Keyguard/Bouncer), system bar, quick settings, notification tray, and multi-user/profile switching experiences delivering responsive keyboard, mouse, trackpad, and touch interactions.
  • Optimize UI rendering performance, animation smoothness, startup latency, and memory footprint across system UI surfaces to meet strict system-health standards.
  • Establish robust hermetic unit, integration, and automated UI tests to safeguard end-to-end user journeys and prevent regressions across releases.
  • Partner closely with UX Designers, Product Managers, and Global Android System UI and Platform Engineering teams to take features from early prototyping through production launch.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in Kotlin or Java, and data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience building Android UI applications, Android system UI, or Android framework components.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience developing with Android system UI (AOSP), Window Manager, multi-user/profile frameworks, or Jetpack Compose/Kotlin Coroutines/Flow.
  • Experience designing desktop or large-screen UI interactions (keyboard/trackpad navigation, adaptive layouts, smooth transitions, and UI performance profiling).
  • Demonstrated ability to debug complex cross-process Android system issues and ship high-quality features across distributed global teams.

title: Team Lead Powder Coat
description:
OBJECTIVE

The Powder Team Lead is responsible for coordinating the daily activities of the powder coating team to ensure products are prepared, coated, cured, inspected, and completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with Formaspace quality standards and production schedules.

This is a hands-on leadership position. The Team Lead works alongside production employees while directing workflow, assigning daily priorities, monitoring quality and productivity, troubleshooting coating and equipment issues, training team members, and communicating production concerns to supervision.

The ideal candidate has practical powder coating experience, strong attention to finish quality, and the ability to lead employees in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Daily Production

  • Lead and coordinate daily activities within the powder coating area.
  • Review the production schedule and establish priorities based on production requirements, deadlines, and downstream needs.
  • Assign employees to powder coating, preparation, masking, hanging, unloading, inspection, and related activities.
  • Monitor workflow throughout the shift and adjust assignments to prevent bottlenecks.
  • Provide hands-on support to the team as production demands require.
  • Conduct shift-start communication covering production priorities, safety concerns, quality expectations, equipment issues, and special jobs.
  • Communicate schedule delays, staffing concerns, material shortages, equipment problems, and quality issues to the appropriate supervisor.
  • Support overtime, shift coverage, and workload planning as required.

Powder Coating Operations

  • Set up and operate manual or automated powder coating equipment.
  • Verify correct powder color, finish, material, and job specifications prior to coating.
  • Ensure parts are properly cleaned, prepared, masked, plugged, hung, grounded, coated, cured, and handled.
  • Monitor coating application to achieve appropriate coverage and a consistent finish.
  • Ensure proper powder changeover and booth-cleaning procedures are followed to minimize contamination.
  • Verify oven settings, cure temperatures, line speeds, and processing requirements as applicable.
  • Troubleshoot common coating defects such as:
    • Poor coverage
    • Orange peel
    • Fish eyes
    • Pinholes
    • Contamination
    • Excessive or insufficient film thickness
    • Color or gloss variation
  • Coordinate rework when finished parts do not meet quality requirements.

Quality

  • Inspect coated products for appearance, coverage, color, finish, adhesion, and other established quality requirements.
  • Ensure nonconforming material is properly identified, segregated, and communicated.
  • Assist with root-cause identification and corrective actions for recurring powder coating defects.
  • Monitor handling practices to prevent scratches, chips, contamination, or damage after coating.
  • Reinforce first-pass quality and minimize scrap, rework, and unnecessary powder consumption.

Safety & Environmental Compliance

  • Promote and enforce safe work practices throughout the powder coating area.
  • Ensure employees use required PPE, including appropriate eye, hand, respiratory, hearing, and other protection based on the task.
  • Ensure employees follow established procedures for powder handling, housekeeping, equipment operation, compressed air, chemical use, and oven/booth operation.
  • Maintain clean work areas and reinforce established housekeeping and 5S practices.
  • Immediately report unsafe conditions, equipment hazards, injuries, spills, and other safety concerns.
  • Participate in safety meetings, incident investigations, and corrective actions as requested.
  • Support compliance with applicable OSHA requirements, Safety Data Sheet procedures, and company Environmental, Health & Safety policies.

title: Lead Specialist, Modularization and mass customization
location: Espoo, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Tampere, Turku, Vantaa, Finland
description: Configure the standard, engineer the exception and build Etteplan's Advisory business along the way.Etteplan Engineering Services is building its Advisory Services. Advisory Services brings deep expertise into the customers first strategic conversations: we frame the business challenge, build a realistic roadmap and turn it into implementation together with our engineering teams. We are now looking for an experienced expert to deliver and develop our flagship service, From Project to Product.From Project to Product helps product-oriented technology companies break free from the project model, where every order is engineered almost from scratch. Modularity is the foundation, but the business value comes from mass customization: the standard is configured, and only the exception is engineered. You have a clear view of how to make this change happen in the product, in engineering and across the whole delivery chain.We are looking for someone who understands product development and the entire order-to-delivery chain. At the core is deep expertise in product architecture, modularity and mass customization. The role combines top-level expertise with pre-sales. You support Etteplan's solution sales at the customer interface, facilitate workshops and drive transformations through. You get to influence both Etteplan's offering and the competitiveness of our technology customers.What you will doGuiding the customer's transformation - Together with the customer, you create the product architecture, including modules, interfaces, MaxBOM / 150% BOM and configuration rules, and significantly strengthen the customers delivery capability. - You lead the customer through the From Project to Product transformation, from current-state assessment to product vision and roadmap, all the way to PLM and the supply chain. - You take a stand on how roles and ways of working in sales, engineering, sourcing, production and service change after the transformation, and how that change is led.Workshops and change leadership - You plan and facilitate workshops from the management team to the engineering floor: a shared goal, shared terminology and shared decisions. - You speak your mind even when your view differs from the customer's current thinking, and you back it up with facts. - You get people excited and make sure the new way of working sticks.Benefit calculation and end-to-end optimization - You break down sub-optimization and show how to optimize the whole chain from sales to service, not just one phase or component.Pre-sales and solution sales support - You work alongside solution sales in the customer's first strategic conversations and help sell the Advisory entry offer. - You frame the customers business challenge and help shape the roadmap into a delivery deal for Etteplans engineering teams, defining its value and scope.Developing Advisory Services and the offering - You develop and productize the From Project to Product service and other advisory services: methods, workshop formats, materials and benefit models. - You bring the needs you hear from customers into the development of Etteplan's offering and Productized Service Solutions. - You help build the Engineering Services Advisory business from the ground up.We believe you will succeed in this role if you have: - Deep understanding of modularity and mass customization: product architecture, functional modules and interfaces, configurability and variant management. - Experience in engineering multidisciplinary products (mechanical, electrical, automation, software) and strong expertise in PLM, PDM and CAD systems and product structures (150% BOM, EBOM, MBOM). - A full view of product development and the order-to-delivery chain from sales to service, and the ability to calculate benefits and optimize the whole rather than its parts. - The ability to lead change and bring people along. - Experience in facilitating workshops and fluent, credible communication in Finnish and English. - A commercial and entrepreneurial mindset: you spot new opportunities, act proactively and want to see a good conversation turn into business.We consider it an advantage if you have: - Systems Engineering and requirements management expertise, for example facilitating requirements workshops and using Polarion or a similar tool. - A view on how data and AI are changing product development and PLM. - Experience in leading transformation programs and productizing services.You see the big picture and have a point of view. You speak your mind, get people on board and get things done.What we offer - A chance to build Advisory Services within Etteplan Engineering Services and shape both Etteplans offering and the competitiveness of our technology customers. - Demanding and meaningful customer relationships with product companies in the technology industry. - Advisory colleagues and an international network. - Etteplans experts, who put the roadmaps into practice. - Hybrid work is possible, with the rhythm set case by case by customer needs.SalaryWe want to make sure your salary at Etteplan is fair and transparent. Your salary is based on your skills and contribution in line with Etteplan's practices. In this role, the typical monthly salary is 4400€ – 5900€ depending on your experience.Interested?Submit your application by 13 December 2026. In your application, tell us about yourself and about a time you helped turn a project-based product into a modular and configurable one.For more information, contact Jyri Lyytikäinen, Director, ES Advisory Services, +358 50 3296413, by 2 December 2026. Please note that I am not available from 3 to 13 December.Location: Espoo, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Tampere, Turku or Vantaa, hybrid work. The role requires travel to customer sites.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Er du specialist i Azure, Databricks og PowerBI – og klar til at gøre en forskel for store kunder? Så er du måske vores nye Senior Data Engineer.

Stillingen ønskes besat på Frederiksberg kontoret ved Flintholm Station.

Solitas danske Data & AI-team vokser, og vi søger derfor flere Data Engineers med solid erfaring i Microsoft Azure, Databricks og Power BI, som vil være med til at designe og bygge moderne dataplatforme og analytics-løsninger for store kunder på tværs af brancher.

Med en kundeportefølje, der inkluderer nogle af Danmarks største offentlige og private virksomheder, oplever Solita i Danmark en betydelig vækst – særligt inden for data og kunstig intelligens.

Hos Solita skaber vi digitale løsninger, der gør en forskel. Vi kombinerer dyb teknisk ekspertise med stærk forretningsindsigt og arbejder tæt sammen med vores kunder for at levere skræddersyede løsninger fra strategi til implementering.

Vores kultur er præget af tillid, samarbejde og høj faglighed, og vores teams består af passionerede specialister.

Hvad bliver din rolle?

Som Senior Data Engineer hos Solita bliver du en central del af vores datateam, hvor du er med til at udvikle og optimere avancerede dataplatforme for vores kunder.

Du bidrager gennem hele projektforløbet – fra analyse og design til implementering af robuste data pipelines og dataprodukter, der skaber reel forretningsværdi.

Som Senior Data Engineer i vores Data/AI-team indgår du i en udadvendt konsulentrolle, hvor en del af arbejdet foregår on-site hos kunden. Her deltager du blandt andet i presales-aktiviteter og yder teknisk rådgivning, hvor du anvender din faglige ekspertise til at omsætte forretningsbehov til effektive og værdiskabende dataløsninger.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Analyse, design og implementering af data pipelines
  • Udvikling af ETL-processer, data warehouses og lakehouses
  • Implementering og vedligeholdelse af dataplatformsteknologier som Databricks, MS Fabric eller Snowflake
  • Arbejde med teknologier som Databricks, MS Fabric, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Spark, Python/Scala

Hvem er du?

Du har erfaring som konsulent og trives i en udadvendt rolle med flere samtidige projekter. Du har solid erfaring med moderne teknologier og dataplatforme og motiveres af faglig udvikling i et innovativt miljø, hvor kvalitet og forretningsværdi er i fokus.

Vi forestiller os, at:

  • Du har min. 5-7 års erfaring med data engineering og dataløsninger
  • Du har mange års erfaring med teknologier som Databricks, Data Factory, MS PowerBI og Azure
  • Du kender til datamodellering, ETL, analytics, BI, AI/ML arkitektur
  • Du har erfaring med Python, SQL og PL/SQL

Du arbejder selvstændig, struktureret og samarbejdsorienteret, og du kommunikerer flydende på både dansk og engelsk – såvel mundtligt som skriftligt.

Om Solita

Solita er en AI-drevet, teknologi-, data- og softwarevirksomhed dedikeret til digital transformation og softwareudvikling.

Vi hjælper virksomheder og samfund med at gentænke deres fremtid gennem avanceret teknologi, datainnovation og menneskelig indsigt. Vores ydelser spænder over technology consulting, AI og analyse, data og softwareudvikling samt application management, leveret som services og projekter.

Solita blev grundlagt i 1996 og beskæftiger i dag over 2.200 medarbejdere i ni lande: Finland, Danmark, Sverige, Norge, Belgien, Tyskland, Schweiz, Polen og Storbritannien.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt, og afholder derfor samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Rikke Meng, Director TA – tlf. /

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, og lære dig bedre at kende!

Työvuorosi ovat arkisin pääsääntöisesti klo 16-22. Tehtävä on osa-aikainen (30 h / vk). Tämä työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan
Tehtävästä maksetaan Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 2 mukaista palkkaa (12,59 €/h) sekä mahdolliset lisät.

- paikan, jossa voit kasvaa: meillä voit rakentaa oman urapolkusi ja hyödyntää monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksiamme.

- laadukkaat työterveyshuollon palvelut ja työhyvinvointiohjelmat.
- turvalliset työolosuhteet: suojavarusteet, työvaatteet, perehdytyksen työtehtäviin, ennakoivaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin ja säännölliset turvavartit.
- liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun vapaa-ajallesi.


Meillä viihdytään, koska täällä voi kasvaa, vaikuttaa ja onnistua. Tutustu taitaviin tekijöihimme: ISS töISSä

Sinulta me odotamme
- aiempaa kokemusta toimistosiivouksesta vähintään 1 vuoden ajalta. Siivouskoneiden (Phantas, Whiz, iMop, Taski) käyttökokemuksen katsomme eduksesi.
- sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa voidaksesi kommunikoida tiimisi ja asiakkaan kanssa. Suomen kielen taidon katsomme eduksesi.
- erinomaista palveluasennetta sekä ymmärrystä edustustason siivouksen ja palvelukulttuurin velvoitteista ja vaatimuksista.
- tarkkaa ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa.
- hyvää fyysistä kuntoa.


Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät. Tule meille rakentamaan omaa ISS urapolkuasi ja tekemään kanssamme tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!

Rekrytointijärjestelmämme on poissa käytöstä pe 20.11. klo 22 – ma 23.11. klo 1 huoltotöiden takia. Käyttökatkon aikana työhakemuksia ei voi jättää, joten huomioithan katkon hakemuksesi lähettämistä suunnitellessasi. Pahoittelemme katkosta aiheutuvaa haittaa.
Täytä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 27.11.! Voit kertoa osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi joko liittämällä hakemukseesi cv:n tai kirjoittamalla tiedot hakulomakkeen tekstikenttään. Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.

Me, ISS Suomi, olemme osa maailman johtavaa kiinteistö- ja toimitilapalveluyhtiötä, joka toimii yli 30 maassa. Suomessa meitä ISS:läisiä on yli 7 000 ja toimimme valtakunnallisesti. Toimintamme tarkoituksena on luoda tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla. Luomme näitä tiloja siivous-, kiinteistö-, ravintola- ja työpaikkapalveluillamme. Siivous on palvelualoistamme suurin. Olemme luoneet puhtaita ja siten turvallisia, viihtyisiä ja tuottavia tiloja yli 100 vuoden ajan. Nykyisin siivoamme yhä useammissa kohteissamme kemikaalivapaasti, moderneja siivouskoneita käyttäen. Työparinasi saattaa olla robotti!
Ilmastotavoitteenamme on olla hiilineutraali vuonna 2040 – ISS:läisenä pääsetkin vaikuttamaan merkittävästi tämän tavoitteen toteutumiseen ja yhteisen ympäristömme hyvinvointiin!

title: Simulerad patient till Metodikum Jkpg – vi söker dig som talar flera språk

Du får information och tid att förbereda dig inför uppdraget. I vissa uppdrag kan du också få ge återkoppling till studenterna efter övningen. Vid behov erbjuder vi dramaträning.

Vi söker dig som

  • kan förstå, tala och skriva svenska så att du kan följa manus och instruktioner
  • talar minst ett annat språk flytande utöver svenska och engelska
  • är intresserad av att spela patient eller anhörig i olika vårdsituationer
  • har grundläggande kunskaper i att använda dator och digitala verktyg
  • är bra på att kommunicera och samarbeta
  • är flexibel och kan anpassa dig till olika situationer och roller.

Det är bra om du

  • har utbildning eller erfarenhet inom teater
  • har arbetat som simulerad patient tidigare.

Din arbetsplats

Du kommer att tillhöra Clinicum vid Linköpings universitet. Clinicum arbetar med praktisk träning för studenter vid Medicinska fakulteten. Här får studenter bland annat träna olika färdigheter och delta i simuleringar.

Simuleringsverksamhet finns på Campus US i Linköping, Campus Norrköping & Vingården i Norrköping, Metodicum Ryhov i Jönköping och Kompetenscentrum i Kalmar.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är intermittent. Det betyder att du arbetar när verksamheten har behov av simulerade patienter. Du har därför inte ett bestämt antal arbetstimmar varje vecka.

Anställningen gäller i högst ett år med möjlighet till förlängning.

Uppdragen genomförs på dagtid under universitetets terminer.

Inom ramen för anställningen har du tystnadsplikt.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Vi går igenom ansökningar och gör urval under hela ansökningstiden. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Lön och förmåner

Du får lön enligt Linköpings universitets centrala avtal för simulerade patienter.

Du får ersättning per timme efter genomfört uppdrag.

https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/formaner.

Fackliga kontaktpersoner

Information om fackliga kontaktpersoner finns på sidan https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/hjalp-for-sokande.

Ansökan

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan med CV och ansökningsbrev senast 7 december 2026.

Du söker anställningen genom att klicka på knappen Ansök. Ansökningar som kommer in efter sista ansökningsdagen kommer inte att behandlas.

https://liu.se/artikel/lika-villkor/.

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv, det berikar och utvecklar vår verksamhet. För oss är det självklart att värna om allas lika värde, rättigheter och möjligheter. Läs om vårt arbete med https://liu.se/artikel/lika-villkor/.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Linköpings universitet har upphandlade avtal och undanber oss direktkontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Offensive Security Consultant
description:
Ready to turn your passion for breaking things into a career that protects them?

At Exploit Security, we don't just find vulnerabilities, we help organisations understand their weaknesses, challenge their assumptions and build stronger defences against the threats that matter.

We're looking for an Offensive Security Consultant who is curious by nature, thinks outside the box and loves the challenge of looking at technology from a different perspective.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, thinking like an attacker and helping businesses stay one step ahead, we'd love to meet you.

What makes Exploit Security different?

Working in cyber security should be more than running tools, ticking boxes and writing reports.

At Exploit Security, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on interesting challenges: Assess a diverse range of environments, technologies and organisations. No two engagements are exactly the same.

  • Make a genuine impact: Help clients uncover security weaknesses before someone with malicious intent does.

  • Keep learning and evolving: Cyber security never stands still, and neither should you. Explore new techniques, develop your skills and stay ahead of emerging threats.

  • Work with great people: Be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing and a healthy dose of curiosity.

  • Have your ideas heard: Bring your perspective, experiment with new approaches and contribute to how we deliver exceptional security outcomes.

What you'll be doing

As an Offensive Security Consultant, you'll:

  • Conduct penetration testing and security assessments across web applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud environments and other technology platforms.

  • Identify, validate and demonstrate security vulnerabilities in authorised testing environments.

  • Think creatively to uncover weaknesses that automated tools might miss.

  • Develop clear, practical reports that help clients understand and address security risks.

  • Work closely with clients to communicate findings and provide actionable recommendations.

  • Continuously research emerging threats, vulnerabilities and offensive security techniques.

  • Collaborate with the team to share knowledge and continually raise the bar.

What we're looking for

We're interested in people who are passionate about security, enjoy solving problems and aren't afraid to ask questions.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience in penetration testing, offensive security or a related technical security role.

  • A solid understanding of networking, operating systems, web applications and common security vulnerabilities.

  • Knowledge of penetration testing methodologies and industry frameworks.

  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.

  • The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A genuine curiosity about how things work and how they can be broken.

  • A commitment to ethical hacking, professionalism and responsible disclosure.

Additional certifications and specialist technical experience are welcome, but OSCP is the minimum mandatory certification.

More than just a job

We believe great security work comes from great people.

We want you to enjoy what you do, challenge yourself, learn from others and have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.

Whether you're an experienced consultant looking for your next challenge or an ambitious security professional ready to take the next step, we want to hear from you.

Ready to think differently?

If you're passionate about offensive security and want to work alongside people who share that passion, let's talk.

Join Exploit Security. Find the weaknesses. Strengthen the future.

title: IT Manager
description:
Join TUI Hotels & Resorts as an IT Manager in TUI BLUE Medina Gardens hotel in Morocco, where you will be responsible for maintaining IT infrastructure, supporting hotel systems and colleagues, troubleshooting technical issues, monitoring system availability and security, and supporting IT projects and improvements.

Due to local employment restrictions we may only consider local candidates who already have the right to live and work in Morocco.

We welcome applications until 20th of November 2026.

ABOUT OUR OFFER

  • A competitive salary package with additional benefits.

  • Meals and soft drinks provided during working hours.

  • Paid training days, plus free access to the TUI Learning Hub, TUI Skills Academy, and language lessons to support your personal and professional growth.

  • Contract provided in accordance with local legislation and entity of employment. Shape your career with development opportunities tailored to your unique skills and ambitions.

  • Collaborate with colleagues from diverse cultures, work on international projects, and build a global professional network.

ABOUT THE JOB

  • Managing and overseeing all IT operations across the resort, ensuring the reliability, security, availability and efficiency of all IT systems, infrastructure and services.

  • Planning, implementing and maintaining the hotel's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, hardware, software and communication systems, in line with business requirements and company IT standards.

  • Managing and maintaining network infrastructure, including wired and wireless networks, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, connectivity and network security.

  • Overseeing server administration and core IT services, including Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file services, storage, backups and system updates.

  • Ensuring the proper functioning and integration of hotel technology systems, including PMS, POS, IPTV, digital signage, telephone/PBX systems, electronic door locks, CCTV and other hospitality-related technologies.

  • Leading IT support operations, ensuring timely and effective technical assistance for hotel colleagues and the prompt resolution of hardware, software, network and system-related issues.

  • Implementing and monitoring IT security measures, including cybersecurity policies, data protection, access management, endpoint protection, system patching and regular security checks.

  • Managing IT projects and technology upgrades, including infrastructure improvements, new system implementations, equipment installations and technological developments.

  • Managing relationships with IT suppliers, vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality, contractual compliance and timely resolution of technical issues.

  • Managing IT budgets, equipment inventories and software licences, ensuring cost efficiency and appropriate resource allocation.

  • Maintaining accurate IT documentation, including system configurations, technical procedures, maintenance records, inventories and incident reports.

  • Ensuring business continuity and disaster recovery procedures, including regular data backups and contingency plans to minimise disruption to hotel operations.

  • Collaborating with the General Manager, department heads to identify technology needs and implement solutions that improve operational efficiency and the overall guest experience.

ABOUT YOU

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field.

  • Previous experience in IT management or a similar supervisory position is mandatory, preferably within a 5-4-stars hotel, resort or international hospitality environment.

  • Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, cybersecurity and systems administration.

  • Practical experience in managing and maintaining wired and wireless networks, servers, IT equipment and communication systems.

  • Good knowledge of hospitality technology and hotel management systems, including PMS, POS, IPTV, electronic door locks, CCTV, PBX and system integrations.

  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage technical incidents and prioritise tasks effectively.

  • Good understanding of IT security, data protection, backup management and business continuity procedures.

  • Experience in managing IT projects, suppliers, service providers and technical budgets.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues at all organisational levels.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work independently and under pressure.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and committed to continuously improving IT services and technological standards.

  • Flexibility to provide technical support outside regular working hours when required by hotel operations.

  • You must have a strong understanding of French and English both written and verbal.

TUI Group is the world’s number one integrated tourism business. TUI Hotels & Resorts comprises over 400 hotel properties with 12 core brands that cover all areas of the leisure hotel market from price-conscious to luxury brands.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless. We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

title: Senior Management Trainee - Finance
description:
Life is too short for a boring career, so build an extraordinary one with us. We believe your career should spark the same thrill and curiosity as your personal interests. Creativity drives everything we do, turning ideas into meaningful impact. With opportunities across brands, markets, and divisions, your growth knows no boundaries.


At L’Oréal. We're not just building brands; we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.


A Day in the Life

Are you ready to skip the boring career path and grow into something extraordinary? Our L'Oréal Senior Management Trainee - Finance Program is a 12-month journey where, like a seedling in a nursery, you'll be nurtured, challenged, and supported to bloom into a future leader of Beauty. You won't just observe the business—you'll rotate through it, taking on real missions with real performance objectives at every stage.

  • Rotate Across the Business: You will undertake a 12-month rotational program across different business functions, gaining hands-on exposure to key areas of the beauty business
  • Own Your Missions: You'll be assigned specific projects for each rotation, complete with performance objectives, giving you real ownership from day one.
  • Build Your Foundation: Through on-the-job training and classroom learning, you'll develop both the technical and professional competencies needed to thrive in the Beauty business.
  • Grow With Guidance: You will be paired with an assigned Buddy and Mentor who will support and guide you throughout your journey, alongside exposure to our leadership teams.
  • Join a Global Community: You'll become part of a whole community of Management Trainees from around the world, with the chance to become a young talent ambassador for the Company.


We Are Looking For

We are searching for a future leader with an entrepreneurial spirit and the drive to shape the future of Beauty. Beyond your skills, we want to see your potential and ambition. You're a great fit if you have:

  • A Bachelor's/Master's Degree with minimum 3 years of work experience.
  • A minimum GPA of 3.00 (or equivalent).
  • Proficiency in English, with high potential in leadership and management.
  • Strong business acumen and excellent analytical and numerical skills.
  • An adventurous, driven, entrepreneurial spirit paired with creative problem-solving and an open mind.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to undergo program rotations outside of Jakarta.


What's in it for You

  • A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
  • Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal.
  • An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
  • A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal/environmental causes to make a concrete difference.


Who We Are

Join us at L’Oréal, the world's #1 beauty company present in over 150 markets. For over a century, we have been transforming; fueled by data, tech, innovation, and science. Together, we tackle big challenges while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone & our planet.

We’re committed to guaranteeing inclusive recruitment processes and to advocating for hiring and promoting each candidate in an ethical and equitable way. The Group strictly prohibits discrimination against any applicant for employment because of the individual’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, visible and/or invisible disabilities, socio-economic and/or multicultural origins, health conditions, age, religion, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Asbestos Surveyor
location: Durham, County Durham, England; Leeds, West Yorkshire, England; Newcastle upon Tyne, Tyne and Wear, England; Yorkshire Region, England
description:
Better places, thriving communities.

title: Program Director, Medical Laboratory Technology
description:

Health Science

PAY RANGE:

Salary is based on education and experience, full-time, benefit-eligible

Unlock Exceptional Benefits at FVCC (Worth ~$25K)! You'll receive generous employer contributions towards your Health/Vision & Dental, Personal Leave, Sick Leave, and Holidays. Plus, build your future with the Montana Teachers' Retirement System and a 403(b) match up to 7%. And that's not all - Public Loan Forgiveness plus invest in your continued education when you explore Tuition Waiver benefits for you and your dependents!

FLSA:

Exempt

Open Until Filled

SUMMARY

Flathead Valley Community College is an outstanding public community college located on a beautiful campus in Kalispell, Montana, with panoramic views of the northern Rocky Mountains and Glacier National Park. Our vision is to improve lives through learning, and the trustees, faculty and staff are dedicated to values that foster and preserve the spirit of our college and promote and support the well-being and economic development of the communities we serve. Anticipated start date of January 2027.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Organizes, administrates, instructs, evaluates, continuous quality improvement, curriculum planning and development, directs other program faculty/staff, and general effectiveness of the program.
  • Teaches and conveys knowledge of medical laboratory technology. Courses may include urinalysis and body fluids, hematology, immunology and serology, immunohematology, clinical chemistry, microbiology, phlebotomy, and medical laboratory technology clinical courses at freshman and sophomore levels in an effective manner for successful student learning outcomes
  • Engages in a minimum of 36 hours of documented continuing professional development every three years
  • Works professionally with college faculty and staff to aid with the educational process and fulfills all academic responsibilities
  • Maintains NAACLS accreditation of the program.
  • Conducts regular and consistent contact with students, faculty, and program personnel.
  • Teaches content material using a variety of instructional methods to facilitate student learning
  • Teaches and conducts duties over the fall, spring, and summer
  • Participates in the budget preparation process.
  • Facilitates distance education courses such as online and hybrid
  • Maintains and submits instructional records in accordance with requirements and participates in assessment activities
  • Advises students according to established guidelines
  • Serves as an ambassador for the College and fosters positive student and community relations
  • Facilitates the hiring of adjunct faculty
  • Attends meetings and participates in student and/or program assessment as directed
  • Remains current in practices, trends, and research related to areas of assignment
  • Fosters positive student and community relation
  • Actively participates in the development of a climate that promotes and supports innovation and efforts to continuously improve services to students, faculty, and the College
  • Creates and maintains a collaborative and collegial environment with colleagues and maintains effective working relationships
  • Maintains professional ethics and confidentiality of students in accordance with applicable laws and policies
  • Advances the mission of FVCC by serving on or convening committees and contributing in the community in college-related activities
  • Reports to the Vice President of Academic and Student Affairs
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree from a regionally accredited institution.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a NAACLS approved program in Clinical Laboratory Science
  • ASCP BOC or ASCPi BOC generalist credential as a medical laboratory scientist.
  • Three years of teaching experience.
  • Knowledge of education methods and administration as well as current NAACLS accreditation procedures and certification procedures. Description

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience as an MLT or MLS instructor.
  • Experience in differentiated instruction for diverse student populations
  • Experience working with instructional technology and/or distance education courses
  • Experience in curriculum development and program assessment
  • Experience in using a variety of instructional methods to facilitate student learning

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Ability to work within policies and procedures of FVCC
  • Ability and willingness to serve as an ambassador for the College by interacting appropriately with the college community and community

  • Ability to follow and issue directions
  • Demonstrated communication, technology, presentation, customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively with people from a variety of culturally diverse backgrounds
  • Ability to intermittently work non-traditional schedules including evenings, weekends, etc.
  • Ability to maintain regular and acceptable attendance levels
  • Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality
  • Ability to successfully pass a criminal background check
  • Ability to respond in the event of an emergency
  • Ability to perform a Medium Duty job, according to the Selected Characteristics of Occupations Defined in the Revised Dictionary of Occupational Titles, U.S. Department of Labor and Industry. Medium Duty involves exertion of 20-50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10-25 pounds frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds continuously to move objects.

In order to be considered for this position, applicants must apply online at ; paper submission of applications or resume materials are not accepted for open positions. FVCC does not retain application materials for future consideration. Additionally, applicants are required to submit the following documents by uploading them to the online application:

Professional references must be individuals most familiar with applicant's work experience, skills, and work behaviors and supervisory experience. Do not list family and friends for professional references.

These protections extend to all management practices and decisions, including recruitment and hiring practices, appraisal systems, promotions, and training and career development programs, as required by federal and state laws.

VETERANS' PREFERENCE ACT: Preference applies in hiring and provides a uniform method by which special consideration is given to qualified Veterans. Veterans’ Preference laws do not, however, guarantee Veterans a job, nor do they give Veterans’ preference in internal actions such as promotion, transfer, reassignment, and reinstatement. title: Project Verification & Validation Manager - 531177
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Project Verification and Validation Manager in Stockholm we’re looking for?

Your future role

You'll be the technical interface between the solution and the project with the aim to provide fluidity in the implementation of the delivered systems.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Develop the project Verification Plan
  • Check the adequacy of the documented evidence from review, integration and testing with the specified verification objectives
  • Identify anomalies, evaluate these in risk (impact) terms, record and communicate these to the project change management body for evaluation and decision
  • Manage the verification process (review, integration and testing) and ensure independence of activities as required

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Degree or passion in engineering.
  • Experience or understanding of software requirements, data and code.
  • Knowledge of various verification approaches/methodologies.
  • Able to identify the most suitable method or combination of methods in a given context.
  • Familiarity with deriving the types of verification from given specifications.
  • Understanding of CENELEC standard EN 50128.
  • Analytical thinking ability and good observation skills.
  • Very good English skills. Swedish is an advantage.

Things you’ll enjoy:

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
  • Contribute to innovative projects
  • Utilise our agile working environment
  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
  • Progress towards senior roles.
  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja liikkuvaan työhön Tokap Service Oy:lle
description:
Kiinnostavatko kunnossapidon monipuoliset työtehtävät? Etsitkö mielenkiintoista työtä teollisuuden sähköasennusten parista?

Etsimme nyt asiakkaallemme kunnossapitoasentajaa liikkuvaan työhön teollisuuden sähkökunnossapitoon pääkaupunkiseudulle pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tokap Service Oy on vuonna 2009 perustettu suomalainen perheyritys, jonka ammattilaiset pitävät teollisuuden koneet käynnissä ja tuotannon liikkeessä. Yrityksen monipuolinen osaaminen ulottuu mekaanisesta kunnossapidosta sähkö- ja automaatiotöihin sekä koneiden kunnostukseen ja tuotannon kehittämiseen. Erityisen vahvaa osaamista yrityksellä on elintarviketeollisuudesta, jossa toimintavarmuus, laatu ja turvallisuus ovat ratkaisevassa roolissa.

Noin 30 ammattilaisen joukossa yhdistyvät kokeneiden osaajien tietotaito ja uusien tekijöiden into kehittyä. Yrityksen toimintaa ohjaavat ammattiylpeys, luotettavuus ja halu uudistua. Työntekijälle tämä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan monipuolisten teknisten tehtävien parissa ja nähdä oman työnsä merkitys asiakkaiden tuotannon sujuvuudessa.

Työpäiväsi

Työsi tukikohtana toimii Vantaalla sijaitseva verstas, jossa pääset tekemään monipuolisia sähkö-, automaatio- ja mekaanisia asennuksia sekä huolto- ja korjaustöitä. Vaihtelua arkeen tuovat asiakkaiden tuotantolaitoksissa tehtävät lomatuuraukset ja muut sijaisuudet eri puolilla Uuttamaata. Näiden aikana työskentelet suoraan asiakaskohteessa, joten tehtävässä tarvitset oman auton.

Työpäiviisi kuuluu tuotantolaitteiden vianetsintää, häiriönpoistoa, ennakkohuoltoja ja korjauksia sekä erilaisia tilaustöitä. Työskentelet sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä kunnossapitotiimin kanssa ja varmistat omalla osaamisellasi, että asiakkaiden koneet pysyvät käynnissä. Monipuoliset tehtävät ja vaihtuvat kohteet tarjoavat mahdollisuuden tutustua erilaisiin tuotantoympäristöihin ja kehittää osaamistasi kunnossapidon eri osa-alueilla.

Työ on kokoaikaista päivätyötä, ja työaika on maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7–15.30, yhteensä 40 tuntia viikossa. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimusta.

Arvostamme

* Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. sähköautomaatioasentaja, kunnossapitoasentaja, sähköasentaja)
* Kokemusta sähköpuolen kunnossapitotöistä
* Motivoitunutta työasennetta sekä halua oppia uutta
* Valmiutta 2-vuorotyöhön, mutta myös yhdessä vuorossa työskentely onnistuu

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle pitkäaikaisen työpaikan monipuolisten kunnossapidon tehtävien parissa, jossa saat vastuullisen työnkuvan ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan tekemiseesi sekä työn sujuvuuteen. Töiden alussa saat hyvän perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi, ja tukenasi ovat osaavat kollegat sekä esihenkilöt. Työ alkaa puolen vuoden määräaikaisella työsuhteella WorkPowerin kautta, jonka jälkeen Tokap Service toivoo sinun jatkavan työskentelyä heidän omilla kirjoillaan.

WorkPowerilla pääset työskentelemään kotimaisessa, vakaassa yrityksessä, joka on toiminut alalla yli 20 vuoden ajan ja jatkaa kasvuaan. Saat työntekijänämme nelihenkisen HR-tiimin tuen koko työsuhteesi ajalle. Aidosti välittävän tiimimme tavoittaa eri kanavissa sujuvasti ja vastaukset kysymyksiin saa nopeasti. Lisäksi WorkPowerin kautta saat erilaisia henkilöstöetuja esimerkiksi liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin.

Hakuprosessi

Kuulostaako tämä työ juuri sinulle sopivalta? Hieno homma! Haastattelemme ehdokkaita jo hakuajan aikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi meille suoraan kotisivujemme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Haku päättyy heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Kyseessä on rekrytointitoimeksianto, joten asiakkaamme pyynnöstä toivomme, että hakemukset lähetetään WorkPowerin verkkosivujen kautta. Voit olla meihin yhteydessä, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää tehtävään liittyen.
