title: Community Engagement Practitioner
description:
• We are Hestia. We make a difference.

At Hestia, we are guided by our core values and are dedicated to fostering an equitable, diverse, and inclusive organisation. Our mission is to empower individuals to rebuild their lives and achieve independence. Right now, we are looking for a Community Engagement Practitioner to play a pivotal role in our Voluntary Community Sector service in Islington, London

Sounds great, what will I be doing?

You will work as part of a multidisciplinary NHS team alongside clinicians, social workers, and community partners to support adults with moderate to severe mental illness. Holding a caseload of service users, you will act as their key contact, contributing to care planning, monitoring progress, and supporting safe discharge using the RiO clinical records system. Together with service users, you will develop person-centred recovery plans focused on social goals and community integration, building strong therapeutic relationships through trauma-informed and strength-based approaches. You will help individuals access local resources, attend appointments, and engage in wellbeing activities, peer support, and psychoeducational groups. Collaboration is central to the role, as you will liaise with statutory and voluntary organisations, attend clinical meetings and community events, and advocate for recovery-focused, jargon-free communication. You will ensure accurate documentation, uphold safeguarding and health & safety standards, and actively participate in supervision, training, and professional development.

What do I need to bring with me?

You'll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires as well as match our values and mission. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you're willing to learn. We also value lived experience of the areas we support, so if you feel comfortable, please do mention this on your application.

Here's what the team will be looking for

We are looking for someone with NVQ Level 4 in Care (or equivalent) or at least three years' experience in a mental health setting. You will bring a strong understanding of mental health issues, recovery, and co-production principles, alongside experience of working collaboratively with professionals, services, and communities. Knowledge of care planning, risk assessment, recovery tools, and the Mental Health Act is essential, as are excellent communication, relationship-building, and group facilitation skills. You should be confident using IT systems, resilient and adaptable, able to work independently or as part of a team, and committed to person-centred, trauma-informed practice.

Interview Steps

We keep our interview process simple, so you know exactly what to expect.

    • Shortlisting call: We have a team of dedicated recruitment specialists who will speak to you about your experience, motivations and values. They will also tell you about all the great work we do!
    • Face to face interview: Now you will have face to face interview with the hiring manager. Our interviews are value and competency based.

Don't be alarmed if there are other stages in the process, it's all part of the plan for some of our roles.

Our commitment to Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Our services users come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds because it makes us stronger. We are committed to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive workforce and value the skills, abilities, talent and experiences, different people and communities bring to our organisation.

We are a disability confident employer

Hestia is proud to be a disability confident employer, dedicated to the employment and career development of individuals with disabilities. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for all applicants with disabilities who meet the minimum criteria for the role they have applied for. We also provide reasonable adjustments during the selection and interview process, and throughout your employment with us.

Safeguarding Statement

Hestia is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults, children and young people who are potentially at risk, and we therefore expect all staff and volunteers to do the same. We require all staff to undertake internal and external safeguarding training throughout their employment with Hestia.

Important Information for Candidates

If your application is successful, please be aware that you will be required to undergo pre-employment checks before a formal offer of employment can be confirmed.

We reserve the right to close this job advert early should we receive a high volume of applications or if the position is filled before the closing date. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible to ensure their application is considered.

title: Data Engineer Consultant
description:
Are you a recent graduate or in the early stages of your career, and would you like to turn data into useful knowledge? And would you like to work directly with clients while keeping up to date with new technologies within data engineering? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools.

Work Assignments

This is a hands-on coding role focused on turning complex data challenges into production-ready solutions while talking with our clients to ensure we deliver according to their needs.

Specifically, you will:

  • Build robust data pipelines and models that streamline the ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data.
  • Implement and develop modern data platforms through DevOps & CI/CD practices.
  • Collaborate with our clients’ engineers, analysts, & business users to solve business issues and ensure lasting value.

You will be guided by and learn from our many senior data engineers.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Either recently completed (or soon to complete) a Master’s degree in a relevant field or worked as a Data Engineer but still in the start of your career.
  • Proficiency in either Python, PySpark, SQL, or APIs.
  • It’s a plus if you have experience with Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, or AI technologies, but if you don’t have it, no worries - we will teach you!
  • An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.
  • Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.
  • A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still highly encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with great colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

  • Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our core technologies. We are sure you’ll thrive by being inspired and inspiring others across our global network of data experts.
  • Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited self-paid time off when you want it.
  • Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year with all sorts of fun activities outside of work. We have committees that plan sports, cultural and party events which you are more than welcome to participate in.

Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our recent work:

  • Migrated Novo’s global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using DBT, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.
  • Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.
  • Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service landscape to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Stockholm
description:
Om företaget

Valcon är ett internationellt konsultbolag som arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affär och teknik, med fokus på att skapa datadrivna lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för sina kunder. Bolaget kombinerar strategisk rådgivning med teknisk implementation och hjälper organisationer att ta nästa steg inom digitalisering, data och AI.

Här får du arbeta i en miljö där innovation, samarbete och kunskapsdelning står i centrum. Teamet består av erfarna specialister inom data, analytics och machine learning som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt och skapar värde i allt från tidiga koncept till produktionssatta lösningar.

Som medarbetare erbjuds du stora möjligheter att påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du får arbeta i varierande projekt hos välkända kunder. Kulturen präglas av entreprenörsanda, nyfikenhet och en vilja att ständigt utvecklas – både som individ och som team.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som Machine Learning Engineer arbetar du nära både teknik och verksamhet för att utveckla skalbara och robusta ML-lösningar. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och nyfikenhet står i fokus.

I denna roll kommer du bland annat att:

  • Utveckla och träna machine learning-modeller i Python (t.ex. med NumPy, Pandas och scikit-learn)
  • Arbeta med feature engineering, datamodellering och statistisk analys
  • Utvärdera och optimera modellprestanda genom tester och experiment
  • Bygga, underhålla och vidareutveckla ML-pipelines
  • Sätta modeller i produktion och säkerställa stabil drift över tid
  • Arbeta med MLOps, inklusive CI/CD, modellversionering och automatiserad retraining
  • Exponera modeller via API:er och integrera dem i affärsnära system
  • Arbeta med moderna teknologier såsom Azure Machine Learning, vektordatabaser och embeddings
  • Utveckla lösningar inom generativ AI, exempelvis RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Samarbeta med andra utvecklare, data engineers och stakeholders för att skapa värde från data

Du kommer att arbeta genom hela ML-livscykeln – från experiment och prototyp till produktionssatta lösningar och kontinuerlig förbättring.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har minst 3 års erfarenhet inom Machine Learning eller liknande roll
  • Har goda kunskaper i Python och ML-bibliotek
  • Har erfarenhet av att utveckla, testa och sätta ML-modeller i produktion
  • Har förståelse för statistik, sannolikhetslära och modellvalidering
  • Har arbetat med ML-pipelines, CI/CD och MLOps
  • Har erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Azure
  • Är van att arbeta i team och kommunicera med både tekniska och icke-tekniska stakeholders
  • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Övrigt

Anställningen är på heltid med en inledande provanställning på sex månader. Lön och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Valcon med Kraftsam Rekrytering och Bemanning. Externa rekryteringsbolag och säljare undanbedes vänligen men bestämt.

Har du frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Kristina Maksimovic på (https://kraftsam.ponty-system.se/assignment/1789/patricia.contreras@kraftsam.se)kristina@kraftsam.se

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Join us as a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products
description:
Would you like to put your studies into practice in an AI-first engineering environment and work with data engineering and AI-assisted development that creates real business value? Would you like to build your technical skills while contributing to solutions used across Nykredit? Then you might be our new Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products.


As a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products, you will play an important role in our team, helping us build reports, automate processes and develop the data flows and platforms that support fund valuation, alternatives and fund accounting.


Nykredit is investing heavily in AI, and our team takes an AI-first approach. We actively consider how AI can help us code, test and solve problems more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the results.


You will also become part of the Nykredit Group, where we offer opportunities and development for those who are curious and eager to learn. Through our student network, Nykredit Youth, you will be invited to professional events and networking opportunities with other students and young colleagues across the Group.


Are you motivated by data engineering and new technologies?


Then you have come to the right place. Your focus will be on reports, data processing, event-driven streaming pipelines and the platforms supporting our business domains.


You will work with technologies such as Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark, Azure and Kafka, alongside colleagues using GitHub, Terraform and Grafana for development, deployment and monitoring. These are technologies you will have the opportunity to work with and learn about, not a checklist of things you need to know before applying.


Tasks



  • Developing and improving reports used by the business.

  • Preparing, transforming and validating financial data.

  • Automating manual tasks using Python and SQL.

  • Helping build and test event-driven streaming pipelines and integrations using Kafka. Working with SimCorp Dimension and bringing its data into our Wealth Data Hub.

  • Improving monitoring and automation of data flows and operational tasks.

  • Exploring how AI can help us modernise legacy code, automate operations and improve data quality.

  • Investigating data quality issues and improving existing solutions.


You will start with well-defined tasks and gradually take on more responsibility as you learn, working alongside experienced engineers on real deliveries.


The position is 10–15 hours per week at our headquarters, Nykredit Huset, Sundkrogsgade 25 in Nordhavn, where most of the team is based.


AI as part of your everyday work


We work with an AI-first approach: when tackling a task, we actively consider how AI can help us solve it better and more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the result.


You will get hands‑on experience with AI‑assisted tools and platforms for coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting. Together with experienced colleagues, you will explore how AI can help modernise legacy code, automate repetitive work and improve data quality.


We encourage you to experiment and bring your own ideas while learning to understand, review and validate AI-generated output. You do not need experience with specific AI tools before joining us. We will help you get started.


Are you the one we are looking for?


We imagine that you:



  • are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field,

  • have some experience with Python and SQL from coursework, personal projects or a previous student job,

  • enjoy solving problems and working carefully with data,

  • are comfortable asking questions and sharing what you learn,

  • are curious about AI-assisted development and keen to use it in practice,

  • are willing to experiment with AI while questioning, reviewing and understanding the output and code you work with.


We know you are still studying, so we do not expect you to know everything from day one. No financial background is needed, and familiarity with Git, cloud platforms or reporting projects is useful but not required.


What matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn alongside experienced colleagues. In your application, we would therefore like to hear about a project or assignment you have worked on, how you approached it and what you learned.


Your new team


You will join Fund Accounting Products in Nykredit Wealth Technology, where engineers and specialists work closely with the business.


We are modernising our solutions through the re‑implementation of SimCorp Dimension, new SaaS solutions and the replacement of existing in-house systems. You will contribute to both existing solutions and new deliveries, with guidance from experienced colleagues and opportunities to learn how financial requirements translate into working code and reliable data.


We look forward to welcoming you as our new colleague.


Want to know more?


You are welcome to contact Development Manager Søren Valther Rasmussen at +45 44 55 51 42 if you have any questions about the position.


If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.


We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

title: Sr Cat Modelling Analyst - Reinsurance
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.


Skills and Competencies

  • 3–6 years of CAT modeling experience, including hands-on expertise with Moody's RMS risk platforms such as Risk Link, Risk Browser, and Risk Modeler
  • Demonstrated experience in catastrophe risk modeling and exposure and loss analytics, including end-to-end account modeling and portfolio or cedant analysis
  • Prior project or team management experience is desirable
  • Proficiency in Excel, Access, and SQL; knowledge of VBA or VB.Net is an added advantage; familiarity with Python and R is desirable
  • Strong team player with mentoring and coaching capabilities, and excellent written and verbal communication skills to present findings to sophisticated stakeholders and clients
  • Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency
  • Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use

Education

  • Graduate degree from a reputed college or university with an excellent academic record

Responsibilities

  • Analyze exposures and losses using RMS catastrophe models and databases; conduct end-to-end account modeling and portfolio and cedant analysis
  • Deliver high-quality catastrophe risk analysis and insights using RMS models and platforms, supporting global insurance and reinsurance clients in making informed, data-driven risk decisions
  • Assess and improve the quality of input data to ensure accuracy and reliability of modeled outputs
  • Generate insights from modeled results and present analysis findings and value-added observations to clients and sophisticated stakeholders
  • Lead projects independently, ensuring timely delivery, process optimization, and clear client communication; document project decisions and exceptions thoroughly
  • Drive process improvements to enhance the utility and efficiency of analytical workflows
  • Mentor and train new analysts; perform quality assurance as needed to uphold team standards
  • Collaborate with client development and technical teams on engagements to deliver integrated and impactful solutions

About the Team
Our Analytical and Data Services team provides integrated data and analytical solutions based on RMS catastrophe models, supporting global insurance and reinsurance clients in underwriting, portfolio management, and risk transfer. We specialize in exposure data analysis, catastrophe modeling, and loss distribution insights, working with Fortune 500 clients and contributing to Moody's mission of helping the world better manage risk. By joining our team, you will be part of a pioneering group in catastrophe risk modeling, contributing to innovative solutions across natural and human-made perils.


Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment:

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Switching and compute fabric: Cisco Catalyst campus switching and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) data-center switching; Cisco UCS X-Series (chassis, Fabric Interconnects, Intersight).
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

title: Inventory Control Coordinator
description:
Rate is $20-$35 per hour

Inventory Control Coordinator

Action Ambulance Service, Inc. | Part-time

Manage approximately 300 stock-keeping units (SKUs), including medical supplies and operational consumables used by ambulance crews and bases. Keep inventory records accurate and make sure crews have the supplies they need to keep ambulances ready for service.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain the item master, including SKU, description, unit of measure, pack size, storage location, vendor and reorder levels.

Receive deliveries, verify quantities against purchase orders and packing slips, and record receipts. Follow up on shortages, damage and incorrect shipments.

Fill supply requests from bases and crews. Record issues, returns and transfers so inventory balances reflect where supplies are held.

Monitor stock levels and usage. Prepare replenishment requests for the designated purchaser, track backorders and promptly escalate shortages of critical items.

Perform scheduled cycle counts, investigate discrepancies and document approved inventory adjustments.

Rotate dated stock so the earliest expiration is used first. Track lot numbers and expiration dates where required, and remove expired, damaged or recalled items from available stock.

Keep stockrooms clean, organized and clearly labeled. Report stockouts, count discrepancies, backorders and upcoming expirations to Operations.

Qualifications

Experience with inventory control, receiving, stockroom operations or a related role.

Comfort using spreadsheets and inventory software to maintain records and reconcile counts.

Attention to detail and ability to prioritize requests and follow up on discrepancies independently.

Experience with EMS or healthcare supplies, barcode scanning or lot tracking is preferred.

Performance Measures

Inventory count accuracy, critical-item stockouts, timely fulfillment of supply requests, cycle-count completion and losses from expired supplies.

title: Instructional Assistant - Hinks
description:
Alpena Public Schools is seeking an Instructional Assistant for Hinks Elementary School. (7 hours a day)

This position is open for 5 days of internal bidding after which it will then be posted externally (EOD November 13th, 2026).

Position Title: Instructional Assistant -Elementary/Secondary

Department: Special Education/General Education (Mixed)

Reports To: Principal

SUMMARY:

Under the supervision of the building administrator and the direction of certificated staff members, the IA performs the necessary duties to assist in the planning and implementation of a program for the regular and special needs of all children in all building areas, including lunchroom, classroom, playground, and other areas as needed. May be responsible for assisting student(s) with personal care, instructional activities, and behavioral issues. May be responsible for implementing IEP and 504 and related accommodation plans for students.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assists student(s) in reaching their maximum potential in becoming independent learner(s).

  • Assists in individual or small group pupil instruction; tutors pupil(s) at teacher's request.

  • Assists teacher in maintaining discipline and other functions.

  • Assists teacher in implementing modifications to curriculum for individual students and small groups.

  • Assists student(s) with set-up, preparation and implementation of materials for instructional units.

  • Assists students with redirection of behaviors and management of inappropriate behavior.

  • Assists teacher in data collection and documentation for individual students.

  • Assists teacher in implementation and documentation of Behavior Intervention Plans (BIPs) and other Tier III interventions.

  • Assists teacher in implementation and documentation of school-wide Check In/Check Out intervention and other Tier II interventions.

  • Operates standard school equipment such as laminator, copier, audiovisual, etc.

  • May escort child(ren) to and from various rooms. May be required to accompany student(s) in lunchroom, to recess, and while attending special classes/programs.

  • Assists and supervises student(s) in boarding and disembarking bus, in gym, and playground activities.

  • Assists and instructs student(s) in personal hygiene, toileting, toothbrushing, and handwashing.

  • Lifts or assists with lifting student(s) from wheelchairs to changing tables or designated areas.

  • Supervises students during non-instructional activities such as breakfast, recess and lunch.

  • Sanitizes classroom and equipment using approved materials.

  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.

  • Follows all Board policies and District procedures.

  • Reviews email communications regularly and responds as needed.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Supervises students under teacher direction and in the absence of the teacher.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

High school diploma or general education degree (GED) is required; Associate degree, 60 semester hours of college credit, or passage of a State of Michigan approved assessment for paraprofessionals is preferred; previous experience with special needs students is preferred. CPI certification or willingness to become CPI certified is preferred at next available opportunity.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence and effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of APS.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

REASONING ABILITY:

Ability to apply common-sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

OTHER SKILLS and ABILITIES:

Ability to work with severely handicapped, emotionally and cognitively impaired students, and other disabled students. Ability to develop effective working relationships with students, staff, and the school community. Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. Ability to perform duties with awareness of all district requirements and Board of Education policies.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk on level and unlevel ground (inside and outside of building), sit, climb stairs, and talk or hear for extended periods of time. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must regularly lift 50 lbs and/or push/pull up to 100 lbs. The employee must be sufficiently mobile to to effectively supervise and assist with students, including ability to escort or restrain students as needed. The employee is required to be computer literate and to have the energy to deal with multiple demands. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee needs to be able to tell where a sound is coming from and hear in a noisy environment. The employee must be able to escort students and, after proper training, restrain students in an emergency situation. The employee must be sufficiently mobile to effectively supervise and assist with students. The employee must be able to escort students and, after proper training, restrain students in an emergency situation.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The noise level in this environment is moderate to loud depending upon the activity in the particular part of the day. Duties are normally performed in a school/classroom environment. Duties may be occasionally performed on field trips away from school, where noise level may vary. While performing the duties of this job, the employee occasionally works near moving mechanical parts in some vocational settings. The employee is frequently exposed to infection at a greater risk than the average person. May be directly responsible for the safety, well-being, and/or work output of students.

The employee shall remain free of any alcohol or non-prescription controlled substance use and/or abuse in the workplace throughout his/her employment in the District.

title: Join us as a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products
description:
Join us as a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products

Would you like to build your technical skills while contributing to solutions used across Nykredit? Then you might be our new Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products.

As a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products, you will play an important role in our team, helping us build reports, automate processes and develop the data flows and platforms that support fund valuation, alternatives and fund accounting.

Nykredit is investing heavily in AI, and our team takes an AI‑first approach. We actively consider how AI can help us code, test and solve problems more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the results.

You will also become part of the Nykredit Group, where we offer opportunities and development for those who are curious and eager to learn. Through our student network, Nykredit Youth, you will be invited to professional events and networking opportunities with other students and young colleagues across the Group.

Are you motivated by data engineering and new technologies?
Then you have come to the right place.

You will work with technologies such as Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark, Azure and Kafka, alongside colleagues using GitHub, Terraform and Grafana for development, deployment and monitoring. These are technologies you will have the opportunity to work with and learn about, not a checklist of things you need to know before applying.

Your tasks will include:

  • Developing and improving reports used by the business.
  • Preparing, transforming and validating financial data.
  • Automating manual tasks using Python and SQL.
  • Helping build and test event‑driven streaming pipelines and integrations using Kafka.Working with SimCorp Dimension and bringing its data into our Wealth Data Hub.
  • Improving monitoring and automation of data flows and operational tasks.
  • Exploring how AI can help us modernise legacy code, automate operations and improve data quality.
  • Investigating data quality issues and improving existing solutions.

You will start with well‑defined tasks and gradually take on more responsibility as you learn, working alongside experienced engineers on real deliveries.

The position is 10–15 hours per week at our headquarters, Nykredit Huset, Sundkrogsgade 25 in Nordhavn, where most of the team is based.

AI as part of your everyday work
We work with an AI‑first approach: when tackling a task, we actively consider how AI can help us solve it better and more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the result.

You will get hands‑on experience with AI‑assisted tools and platforms for coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting. Together with experienced colleagues, you will explore how AI can help modernise legacy code, automate repetitive work and improve data quality.

We encourage you to experiment and bring your own ideas while learning to understand, review and validate AI‑generated output. You do not need experience with specific AI tools before joining us. We will help you get started.

Are you the one we are looking for?
We imagine that you:

  • are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field,
  • have some experience with Python and SQL from coursework, personal projects or a previous student job,
  • enjoy solving problems and working carefully with data,
  • are comfortable asking questions and sharing what you learn,
  • are curious about AI‑assisted development and keen to use it in practice,
  • are willing to experiment with AI while questioning, reviewing and understanding the output and code you work with.

We know you are still studying, so we do not expect you to know everything from day one. No financial background is needed, and familiarity with Git, cloud platforms or reporting projects is useful but not required.

What matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn alongside experienced colleagues. In your application, we would therefore like to hear about a project or assignment you have worked on, how you approached it and what you learned.

Your new team
You will join Fund Accounting Products in Nykredit Wealth Technology, where engineers and specialists work closely with the business.

We are modernising our solutions through the re‑implementation of SimCorp Dimension, new SaaS solutions and the replacement of existing in‑house systems. You will contribute to both existing solutions and new deliveries, with guidance from experienced colleagues and opportunities to learn how financial requirements translate into working code and reliable data.

We look forward to welcoming you as our new colleague.

Want to know more?
You are welcome to contact Development Manager Søren Valther Rasmussen at +45 44 55 51 42 if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

title: Palvelumestari kiinteistönhuoltoon, Turku
description:
Sijainti: Turku, Varsinais-Suomi
Työsuhde: Kokoaikainen, vakituinen
Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan


Kiinteistöhuollon esihenkilö, palvelumestari

Oletko esihenkilö, joka viihtyy lähellä ihmisiä ja käytännön tekemistä? Meillä pääset johtamaan kiinteistöhuollon arkea, tukemaan tiimiäsi ja rakentamaan sujuvaa yhteistyötä asiakkaidemme kanssa!


Mistä on kyse? Palvelumestarina ydintehtävänäsi on vastata kiinteistöhuollon palveluiden päivittäisestä työnjohdosta ja varmistaa, että oman alueesi arki toimii sujuvasti. Vastaat tiimisi johtamisesta ja motivoinnista kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita, riittävän resursoinnin varmistamisesta sekä työturvallisuuden ennakoinnista ja toteutumisesta.

Työskentelet aktiivisesti myös asiakkaidemme kanssa. Huolehdit palvelun laadusta ja sen kehittämisestä sekä siitä, että sovitut huoltotyöt etenevät suunnitellusti. Tapaat sekä työntekijöitäsi että asiakkaitamme kohteissa viikoittain, joten tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan toimivaa arkea yhdessä ihmisten kanssa. Kenttätyön vastapainoksi työpäiviisi kuuluu myös järjestelmien ja hallinnollisten tehtävien parissa työskentelyä. Hyödynnät työssäsi tuotannonohjausjärjestelmiä, asiakkaiden sähköisiä huoltokirjoja, sähköpostia sekä MS Officen ohjelmistoja. Plussaa on kiinnostus tekoälyn hyödyntämiseen ja uusien digitaalisten työkalujen käyttöönottoon sekä halu kehittää niiden avulla työn sujuvuutta, tehokkuutta ja palvelun laatua.

Voisitko se olla Sinä? Omaat paineensietokykyä ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoa: sinulla pysyy langat käsissä, etkä hätkähdä nopeasti muuttuvia tilanteita tai paineen alla työskentelyä. Johdat työtäsi ja tiimiäsi napakasti, mutta ihmislähtöisesti. Sinulta löytyy useamman vuoden kokemus kiinteistöhuollon tehtävistä. Aiempi kokemus esihenkilötyöstä ja operatiivisen arjen pyörittämisestä on eduksi – olet ehkä aiemmin toiminut esihenkilönä, tiiminvetäjänä tai työnjohtajana. Ajokortti on välttämätön, sillä vietät osan työajasta kentällä.

Miksi Luotealle?
* Pääset kehittymään sekä kiinteistöhuollon ammattilaisena että lähijohtajana. Tehtävä antaa sinulle mahdollisuuden syventää alan osaamistasi ja kasvattaa esihenkilötaitojasi käytännönläheisessä ympäristössä.
* Saat ympärillesi osaavan tiimin ja paljon erilaisia yhteistyökumppaneita. Arjessasi työskentelet tiimiläistesi, asiakkaidemme ja muiden Luotean ammattilaisten kanssa. Myös oma esihenkilösi on tukenasi ja sparraamassa sinua.
* Pääset näkemään kiinteistöpalveluiden liiketoimintaa läheltä. Roolissa yhdistyvät ihmiset, asiakkaat ja palvelutuotanto, joten saat hyvän kokonaiskuvan siitä, mistä onnistunut kiinteistöhuollon palvelu rakentuu.
* Saat työssäsi vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa. Pääset kehittämään oman alueesi toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti ja näkemään konkreettisesti oman työsi sekä tiimisi työn tulokset.
* Et jää haastavissakaan tilanteissa yksin. Tukenasi ovat Luotean eri asiantuntijat ja tukitoiminnot muun muassa talouteen, HR:ään ja palkanlaskentaan liittyvissä kysymyksissä.
* Hyvinvointisi on meille tärkeää. Tarjoamme kattavan työterveyshuollon ja sairauskassan, joka korvaa muun muassa hammashoitoa, erikoislääkärikuluja ja silmälaseja.
* Tuemme oppimista ja urakehitystä. Laaja kiinteistötekniikan ja kiinteistöpalveluiden kokonaisuutemme tarjoaa mahdollisuuksia syventää omaa osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi talon sisällä.


Miten haet meille?
Hakemukset kulkevat meillä vain hakulomakkeen kautta: näin varmistamme reilun pelin ja tietosuojan. Klikkaa itsesi hae-painikkeen kautta hakulomakkeelle ja kerro meille, mikä tekisi sinusta meille sopivan palvelumestarin.
Miten rekrytointi etenee?
Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 3.12., mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia hakuajan aikana. Prosessiin kuuluvat haastattelut sekä soveltuvuusarvioinnit.
Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat asiakasryhmän päälliköltä Tony Danielsbackalta, p. +358503856114 (soittoajat 23.11 klo 9.30–11 ja 1.12. klo 13–15).



Avainsanat: kiinteistöpalvelut, kiinteistöhuolto, palvelumestari, työnjohto, työnjohtaja, esihenkilö, esihenkilötyö, lähijohtaminen, tiiminvetäjä, palvelutuotanto, asiakaspalvelu, työturvallisuus, kiinteistöala, Turku, Varsinais-Suomi, Luotea, kokoaikainen, vakituinen

title: Innesäljare
description:
På Derome är vi stolta över att vara ett tryggt, familjeägt företag där gemenskap och omtanke genomsyrar vår kultur. Här får du möjlighet att växa både professionellt och personligt, alltid med stöd från engagerade ledare och kollegor. Hos oss förenas en stark gemenskap med en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där vi värdesätter långsiktighet, enkelhet och ansvarstagande. Nu söker vi medarbetare som delar våra värderingar och vill vara med och driva vår utveckling framåt.

Brinner du för försäljning och vill vara med och bygga relationer som håller?

Hos oss får du vara en nyckelspelare i att skapa affärer och nöjda kunder – varje dag!

Till vår anläggning i Helsingborg söker vi nu en innesäljare. Är det dig vi söker?

Om rollen:

På Derome Bygg & Industri jobbar vi med proffskunder och vårt fokus ligger i att underlätta för våra kunder i deras vardag. Som innesäljare arbetar du med att utveckla affären med våra proffskunder genom att vara aktiv i relationsskapande, service och merförsäljning. Du arbetar i team och samarbetar tätt med anläggningens kundansvariga säljare, framförallt när det gäller orderläggning och leveransbevakning.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

  • Försäljning med orderläggning
  • Aktivt bearbeta kunder och se till att de väljer Derome framför konkurrenter
  • Ha tät dialog med leverantörer
  • Planera logistiken så att materialet kommer ut i tid, i samarbete med regionlager och andra Deromeanläggningar
  • Skriva offerter och presentera priser för kund
  • Hantera reklamationer, returer och krediteringar

Vi söker dig som har:

  • God administrativ förmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt
  • Vana av att arbeta i olika system
  • Erfarenhet av byggbranschen och byggprocessen
  • Vana av att hantera hela säljprocessen
  • Förmåga att planera dina arbetsdagar på ett effektivt sätt

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen som innesäljare är det därför viktigt att du är social, serviceminded och intresserad av försäljning. Du är självgående och ansvarsfull med ett välutvecklat affärsmannaskap, hög energi, god samarbetsförmåga och hög arbetsmoral.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi arbetar för ökad mångfald och en jämn könsfördelning och ser gärna en spridning i ålder och etnisk/kulturell bakgrund hos våra medarbetare.

För att säkerställa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö på Derome genomför vi alltid referenstagning, alkohol- och drogtest samt bakgrundskontroll vid nyanställning.

Vi rekryterar löpande, så om detta låter som rätt möjlighet för dig – vänta inte, skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt kontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag.

Om oss

Derome är mer än bara virke och skruv. Vi förenklar vardagen för våra yrkeskunder och i våra bygg- och industrivaruanläggningar samt på våra maskinuthyrningsdepåer i västra och södra Sverige jobbar vi nära våra kunder.

Hos oss ingår du i ett team som brinner för att utmana – tillsammans hittar vi de bästa lösningarna för yrkesproffs.

Läs mer på derome.se

title: Senior Manager, Business Data Scientist, Search+, GBO Product Finance
location: Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
description:
Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

We provide Global Business Organization (GBO) leadership with strategy and insights, which maximize the value of our business to customers and to Google, through commercial actions we identify, prioritize, monitor and evaluate in partnership with Global Partnerships and Solutions (GPS), GTM and other Finance teams. As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to flex technical, investigative, strategic and business partnering skills to influence executive decisions.

Within GBO Product Finance, the Search+Core team is responsible for partnering with the GPS Search+ organization, and in charge of incrementality and opportunity sizing across products in partnership with Econ, as well as the Google Compute Engine (GCE) team. In addition, we build core infrastructure and tooling to be utilised across the wider analyst community in GBO Finance.

You will have a high degree of curiosity and passion about Google, wanting to positively influence the strategic direction of the Ads business, and how to operate in a changing and at times unstructured environment as part of our globally distributed team with big goals. We are also leading innovation in deploying AI at scale to solve business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Manage a group of experienced data scientists with a portfolio of projects guiding and supporting decision making in the Search+ space.
  • Build strong relationships with the Search+ team leadership and represent a critical and grounded Finance POV in various decision making forums.
  • Help the team solve complex and ambiguous problems through combination of technical, statistical, analytical and business acumen.
  • Nurture strategic partnership with other analytical teams such as Econ, Product Data Science, and GPS strategists to propose exceptional work to our partners.
  • Develop with the team the next generation of AI infrastructure and tooling to increase productivity.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 9 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.
  • 6 years of experience as a people manager within a technical leadership role.
  • Experience managing data sets to solve product or business problems.
  • Experience with coding (e.g., SQL, Python, or R), querying databases, or statistical analysis.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 11 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.
  • Experience with code management concepts (google3, cider, blaze) and a desire to evolve at pace with AI.
  • People management experience, particularly ability to mentor highly technical teams.
  • Knowledge of our product areas and of data science + financial concepts (ROAS, incrementality, inference, etc.).
  • Willingness to teach others and learn new analytical techniques, coding frameworks, etc.
  • Excellent problem solving and analysis skills, with impeccable business judgment and the ability to communicate and partner with a senior management team.

title: Project Manager
description:
About Dalkia UK

At Dalkia, we're driven by a shared purpose: tackling climate change and building a better, more sustainable future. We bring together talented people who share knowledge, challenge each other and grow together.

Backed by EDF, Britain's biggest generator of low carbon electricity, we're a people-first culture. With 5,000+ employees and £600m+ turnover, we combine the strength of a major group with a great culture, innovative mindset and inclusive values making Dalkia a great place to work and grow your career.


Project Manager – Heat Pumps & Decarbonisation

Location: Newcastle & Northumberland | Dalkia Energy Services

Lead the delivery of projects transforming the future of NHS healthcare estates.

Are you a hands-on Project Manager with a strong main contractor background and experience delivering complex mechanical and M&E construction projects?

Do you have the experience and confidence to manage subcontractors, lead site activities and deliver projects within live, operational environments?

Dalkia Energy Services is looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of exciting heat pump installation and decarbonisation projects across sites in Newcastle and Northumberland.

These projects will play an important role in helping healthcare organisations reduce carbon emissions, improve energy efficiency and transition towards more sustainable heating and energy infrastructure.

This is a hands-on construction delivery role. You'll take ownership of projects on site, managing subcontractors, coordinating multiple trades, controlling programmes and budgets, and ensuring works are delivered safely and successfully within complex, live hospital environments.

Working alongside our specialist engineering, design and commissioning teams, you'll be responsible for bringing projects from detailed design and procurement through construction, installation, commissioning and final handover.

What you'll be doing

  • Take ownership of the full project lifecycle, from design coordination and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover.
  • Act as the key day-to-day contact for key stakeholders, building strong working relationships with hospital estates teams and other client representatives.
  • Lead and manage on-site construction activities, taking a proactive, hands-on approach to project delivery.
  • Directly manage subcontractors, specialist installers and site operatives, ensuring productivity, quality and programme commitments are achieved.
  • Coordinate multiple trades, work packages, labour, materials and site resources.
  • Manage project programmes, monitor progress and take ownership of resolving delays and delivery challenges.
  • Take responsibility for project budgets, cost control, forecasting, variations and overall commercial performance.
  • Oversee the installation of heat pump systems, including plant rooms, external plant, pipework, electrical connections, controls and associated building modifications.
  • Coordinate with internal design and engineering teams to ensure designs are practical, buildable and suitable for installation.
  • Maintain high standards of health and safety, reviewing RAMS, undertaking site inspections and ensuring compliance with CDM regulations.
  • Manage site logistics and construction activities around the operational requirements of live hospital environments, ensuring disruption to critical healthcare services is minimised.
  • Coordinate testing, commissioning, snagging and final handover, ensuring all technical documentation and client requirements are completed.
  • Support ongoing project performance, working with the Measurement & Verification team to ensure energy savings and guarantee requirements are achieved.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a commercially astute, delivery-focused Project Manager who has come from a main contractor environment and is confident managing complex construction projects on site.

Essential experience includes:

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager within a main contractor, mechanical or M&E contracting environment.
  • Strong experience managing subcontractors, specialist installers and multiple trades.
  • A genuinely hands-on approach to construction and site management, with direct responsibility for day-to-day delivery.
  • Previous experience delivering projects within live environments, ideally NHS hospitals and hospital estates.
  • Experience working with NHS Trusts, hospital estates teams and associated stakeholders.
  • A strong understanding of mechanical and electrical building services and construction processes.
  • Experience with major plant and equipment, including boilers, chillers, AHUs, pipework, steam and water systems, BMS and associated building services.
  • Strong programme management, commercial awareness and subcontractor management skills.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing RAMS, managing site risks and maintaining high standards of health and safety.
  • Knowledge of NEC or JCT contracts would be advantageous.

A relevant engineering or construction qualification is desirable, alongside professional accreditations such as APM, CIOB, RICS or IET.

Experience with heat pumps, renewable energy and low-carbon technologies would be beneficial.

A full UK driving licence and the right to work in the UK are essential.

Ready to make a difference?

If you're an experienced M&E or Mechanical Project Manager with a main contractor background, strong subcontractor management experience and a track record of delivering projects within live hospital environments, we'd love to hear from you.

Our Values

People First – It starts with health, safety and wellbeing

Better Together – A collaborative team

Trusted Partners – Dedicated to our clients' success

Taking Responsibility – Making a positive difference

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

We're committed to an inclusive and fair recruitment process. If you need any adjustments please let us know, in confidence, our team is here to support you.

title: Vuoropäällikkö / Leipuri

Työssä työskennellään pääosin tiiminä, välillä työ vaatii yksinoloa. Odotamme sinulta kykyä toimia itsenäisesti sekä kantaa vastuu omista tehtävistäsi. Tueksesi saat erinomaiset kollegat ja hyvän perehdytyksen leipomomme toimintaan. Meillä tärkeintä on hyvä asenne.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi 15.11.2026 mennessä sivuillamme olevalla lomakkeella tai sähköpostilla rekry@leipomojuuri.fi.

title: Strategic Partnerships Associate
company: Center for Victims of Torture Human Resources Team
description:
The Center for Victims of Torture is hiring a temporary, part-time (20 hours per week) Strategic Partnerships Associate to support CVT’s institutional fundraising strategy by researching, initiating and managing foundation proposal and reporting processes, providing a range of administrative support to large government and quasi-government contract proposals in both the US and globally, and providing administrative support to the institutional development team to maximize revenue generation.

Position open to:

Candidates located in Arizona, Colorado, District of Columbia, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, or Washington who are authorized to work in the U.S. and will not need CVT to sponsor them on a work visa.

Remote status:

Position is fully remote within the United States.

Benefits:

Employees in non-benefit eligible positions receive paid sick/safe leave hours and participation in CVT’s retirement plan once eligibility criteria are met.

Responsibilities:

Proposal Writing and Proposal Management: Prepare foundation grant applications, and work with program, clinical, research, and finance staff to obtain information for foundation funding proposals. Provide administrative support to government contracts and proposals, including supporting the organization of workflow, managing a timeline, generating and updating checklists, tracking proposal requirements to ensure they’re being met, scheduling relevant meetings, following up with program, clinical, finance and research staff to ensure timely completion of proposal tasks (including budgets and budget summaries), and writing supplemental materials such as draft risk analyses or gender analyses (under the direction of program staff, research staff, or strategic partnership officers).
Program Support: As assigned, partner with program managers to support the contributed revenue needs of individual programs. Keep key connections with the institutional fundraising team, other CVT staff. Participate in phone calls, meetings and field visits needed to support current and potential partner engagements. Conducts research on company, foundation or country background information, sectoral/subject-matter best practices, and other information needed for concept notes, partnership development strategies and proposal design.
Prospect Research: Conduct ongoing research on potential donors including foundations, corporations, religious and civic organizations, bilateral and multilateral donors. Identify connections between donors and CVT Board members, volunteers and staff.
Stewardship: Acknowledge grants personally and formally or assist program managers in this when needed. Invite donors to CVT events and engage CVT staff members and volunteers with donors in cultivation activities. Maintain Raiser’s Edge records for all prospects and donors with meeting notes and actions. Lead the reporting process for current grants as needed.

Qualifications:
Required education, experience, certificates, licenses or registrations

Bachelor’s degree
1 year of full-time experience in institutional fundraising, technical grant writing or proposal development

Preferred education, experience, certificates, licenses or registrations

Master’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in fundraising

3 years of experience in institutional fundraising and technical grant writing
Experience working with international NGOs in proposal development and program design, including implementation

Competencies (knowledge, skills and abilities)

Ability to compile content, write new content, proofread, and edit documents
Ability to work with individuals from diverse backgrounds and institutional cultures
Ability to think creatively and proactively about new institutional opportunities and new project designs that are consistent with organizational culture and mission
Knowledge of local, national, and international donor landscape
Excellent prospect research skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality regarding sensitive donor information
Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communications skills
Proficiency in using Raiser’s Edge or equivalent program to manage donor information
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Word and Excel)
Ability to manage work independently and collaboratively as a member of a team, including ability to take initiative
Ability to participate in multiple proposal projects simultaneously
Excellent skills in organization, attention to detail and time management (including the ability to meet deadlines)
Knowledge in any of the following areas is preferred: human rights, mental health services, public health, transitional justice, refugee resettlement, the US asylum process, or international development
Knowledge of the cultures, ethnic groups, or political dynamics of any of the following locations is preferred: East Africa, Middle East, Mexico, Latin America, South America, Thailand, Burma and the U.S. locations where CVT works (Minnesota, Georgia, Arizona, and Washington, DC)
Proficiency in a language in addition to English desirable: Spanish, Arabic, Swahili or French (speaking or writing)
Ability to travel nationally and internationally up to 5% time

Work Environment (subject to change):

Typical office environment
Time spent on the computer is approximately 90%

title: Truckförare – erfarenhet av Lindhe-truck krävs
description:
Vill du vara en del av ett företag som främjar kreativitet och engagemang? Är du en ansvarstagande och flexibel lagspelare som uppskattar varierande arbetsuppgifter?

Vill du ha ett varierande och givande arbete i ett engagerat team? Trivs du med ett högt arbetstempo, praktiska arbetsuppgifter och att samarbeta med andra? Då kan det här vara tjänsten för dig!

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

Som lagermedarbetare/truckförare arbetar du både på lagret och i produktionen enligt ett roterande schema. Du får en varierad arbetsdag där du växlar mellan olika stationer och arbetsuppgifter.

Ditt huvudsakliga ansvar är att se till att varor och material hanteras säkert, effektivt och noggrant. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

  • Orderplockning och packning av produkter.

  • Hantering av inkommande och utgående leveranser.

  • Lastning och lossning av gods, inklusive långa och skrymmande material såsom plankor och armeringsjärn.

  • Registrering och dokumentation i företagets lagersystem.

  • Truckkörning, främst med motviktstruck och Lindhe-truck med långgafflar.

Erfarenhet av att köra Lindhe-truck med långgafflar är ett krav för tjänsten.

Arbetsplatsen ligger så att du med fördel kan pendla från Järna, Södertälje eller Nyköping med omnejd.

PERSONLIGA EGENSKAPER OCH KVALIFIKATIONER

Vi söker dig som är flexibel, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med ett fysiskt arbete där arbetsuppgifterna varierar och där ett gott samarbete med kollegorna är en viktig del av vardagen.

Du har en god arbetsmoral, tar egna initiativ och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö. Eftersom arbetet innebär hantering av tungt och långsträckt gods är det viktigt att du arbetar säkert, är uppmärksam och har god vana av truckkörning.

Vi ser att du har:

  • Truckkort.

  • Erfarenhet av att köra motviktstruck.

  • Erfarenhet av att köra Lindhe-truck med långgafflar.

  • Vana av att hantera tungt och långsträckt gods.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

  • God fysik och förmåga att hantera ett fysiskt arbete.

  • En flexibel inställning och god samarbetsförmåga.

B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom det underlättar pendling till arbetsplatsen.

OM TJÄNSTEN

Tjänsten är ett konsultuppdrag via Eterni Sweden AB hos vår kund, Företag AB. Uppdraget inleds med en period på sex månader, med goda möjligheter till förlängning.

Omfattningen är heltid eller deltid enligt överenskommelse.

Arbetstiderna är förlagda måndag till fredag och arbetet bedrivs i tvåskift.

Du får en grundlig introduktion i början av anställningen för att komma in i arbetet och få goda förutsättningar att lyckas i rollen.

ÖVRIG INFORMATION

Ansök via www.eterni.se. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. För att vi ska kunna hantera alla ansökningar på bästa sätt tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Arbetstider: 2-skift

title: Associate, Intellectual Property | AWA
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career in intellectual property?

Do you want to work with innovative companies, develop strong client relationships, take increasing responsibility for client matters over time, and grow your career alongside highly skilled colleagues across AWA?

At AWA, we believe great results are created through collaboration, knowledge sharing and a genuine commitment to helping our clients succeed.

About AWA

AWA is one of Europe's leading intellectual property firms, with more than 400 colleagues across 20 offices in Europe and Asia.

We work with innovative companies ranging from ambitious start-ups to some of the world's most recognized brands, helping them create, protect and maximize the value of their intellectual assets.

At AWA, you'll collaborate across disciplines, offices and countries while developing your expertise alongside experienced colleagues.

As an employee-owned company, we share a common commitment to our clients and our future. More than half of our colleagues choose to become shareholders, creating a culture of ownership, entrepreneurship and long-term thinking.

About the role

As an Associate, Intellectual Property, you will advise clients on a wide range of intellectual property matters and support them in navigating both legal and commercial challenges. You'll support clients across a broad range of intellectual property matters, including trademarks, designs, patents, domain names, agreements and disputes. Working closely with attorneys, patent consultants and paralegals, you'll help clients navigate both legal and commercial challenges while developing your own expertise and client relationships.

The role can be based in Lund, Malmö, Helsingborg or Gothenburg (Hybrid).

Your role will include:

  • Advising clients on intellectual property strategy and risk assessment.
  • Supporting clients in matters relating to trademarks, designs, patents and domain names.
  • Handling infringement matters, disputes and enforcement-related issues.
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating IP-related agreements.
  • Representing clients in interactions with authorities and courts.
  • Building client relationships and collaborating with colleagues across AWA.

Who are you?

We believe you are a curious, driven and collaborative legal professional with a genuine interest in intellectual property. You enjoy working in a collaborative and down-to-earth environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork and a low-prestige mindset are valued.

You:

  • Hold a law degree.
  • Have approximately 3-5 years of post-graduation experience, with at least some of this time spent within intellectual property law at a law firm, IP firm, in-house legal department, court or relevant authority.
  • Communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.
  • Enjoy combining legal analysis with practical and commercially relevant advice.
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.
  • Take initiative, ownership and responsibility for your work.
  • Enjoy a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and teamwork are key.
  • Are curious, eager to learn and motivated to continue developing your expertise.
  • Experience of IP disputes, drafting and negotiating agreements, or working directly with clients is an advantage, but not required.

Why join AWA?

At AWA, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow and take on increasing responsibility while working alongside highly skilled colleagues in a collaborative and employee-owned environment.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work with innovative companies ranging from start-ups to global market leaders.
  • Develop your expertise across a broad range of IP matters.
  • Develop strong client relationships and take increasing responsibility for client matters over time.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues and collaborate across disciplines
  • Benefit from continuous professional development, teamwork and knowledge sharing.
  • Join a collaborative and employee-owned company where your ideas and contributions matter.

Interested?

We look forward to receiving your application and will review candidates continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 3 December 2026.

If you have questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Ida Listrup, HR Business Partner, at ida.listrup@awa.com.

title: Special Assistant to Division Vice President
description:

Skills: Possesses advanced computer skills (to include PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and SharePoint) and seeks to use their technical orientation to manage responsibilities of the position with maximum efficiency. Willing to acquire and maintain new skills and stay current on technology tools that can maximize efficiency and effectiveness. Highly organized and detail-oriented; is proactive, self-directed, and able to prioritize assignments for multiple executives. Possesses fundamental project management experience, including development of basic project plans, follow-through and execution. Excellent interpersonal skills; good oral and written communication skills, organizational skills and technical skills (including graphics). Employees may be required to work at CNA headquarters or other work locations resulting in changes to the scheduled telecommuting or hybrid work arrangements. Employees may also be required to work outside of normal business hours.

title: Parts Category Specialist
description:
Parts Category Specialist

ABOUT THE ROLE

As part of the Americas team, SANY is seeking a driven, forward-thinking, and highly motivated Parts Category Specialist, to develop and execute category strategies that drive profitable aftermarket growth across SANY America's parts business. This position owns assigned product categories throughout their lifecycle, including supplier management, pricing, inventory optimization, new product introduction, sales support, and market analysis.

The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Service, Purchasing, Product Support, and suppliers to improve product availability, increase market share, and maximize lifecycle revenue.

With deep investment and backing from SANY Group, the Americas business continues to grow rapidly, and this role is critical to delivering competitive, customer-focused products that support long-term market expansion.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase market share.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Category Management

  • Develop and execute annual category growth strategies.
  • Own assigned product categories throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Identify market opportunities and competitive gaps.
  • Monitor category performance and recommend corrective actions.

Product Development

  • Introduce new aftermarket product lines.
  • Develop business cases for new product offerings.
  • Manage supplier relationships and sourcing activities.
  • Coordinate product launches across internal departments.

Pricing & Profitability

  • Develop pricing recommendations that maximize growth and profitability.
  • Monitor competitive pricing and market positioning.
  • Support promotional pricing initiatives.
  • Analyze margins and recommend pricing improvements.

Inventory & Demand Planning

  • Partner with Parts Planning & Distribution to optimize inventory levels.
  • Improve product availability while minimizing excess inventory.
  • Analyze demand trends and forecast future requirements.

Sales & Dealer Support

  • Train Parts Sales representatives and dealers on assigned product categories.
  • Develop sales tools and product literature.
  • Support key customer opportunities.
  • Assist with technical product inquiries.

Market Intelligence

  • Analyze industry trends and competitor offerings.
  • Identify opportunities to increase aftermarket penetration.
  • Monitor warranty trends and product performance.
  • Recommend continuous product improvements.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in aftermarket parts, product management, category management, purchasing, or technical sales
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Heavy equipment or construction equipment industry experience
  • SAP experience
  • Pricing strategy experience
  • Product launch experience

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Category sales growth
  • Gross margin improvement
  • Successful product launches
  • Inventory performance
  • Market share growth
  • Dealer adoption
  • Pricing effectiveness

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience. It will include a base salary and an annual performance bonus.
